full_text: The names of the nine planets are: the Sun, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Canonical list of the nine Grahas used in Parashari Vedic astrology

claim.text: The nine planets (Navagrahas) are: Sun (Surya), Moon (Chandra), Mars (Mangal), Mercury (Budha), Jupiter (Guru), Venus (Shukra), Saturn (Shani), Rahu (North Node), Ketu (South Node).

full_text: Among the nine planets, the Sun, Saturn, Mars, decreasing Moon, Rahu and Ketu are natural malefics. The rest (Moon when waxing, Jupiter, Venus) are natural benefics.

condition.subject: planet
condition.description: Natural malefic/benefic classification of planets; Moon classified by phase — waning Moon is malefic, waxing Moon is benefic

claim.text: Natural malefics: Sun, Saturn, Mars, waning Moon (Krishna Paksha), Rahu, Ketu. Natural benefics: waxing Moon (Shukla Paksha), Jupiter, Venus. Mercury is conditionally classified (see rule 003).

full_text: Mercury is a malefic if he joins a malefic planet. If Mercury joins only benefics, he is a benefic.

condition.subject: Mercury
condition.description: Mercury's malefic/benefic nature is determined by conjunction: if conjunct any malefic planet → Mercury becomes malefic; if conjunct benefics only or alone → Mercury is benefic

claim.text: Mercury has no fixed malefic/benefic nature. Conjunction with a malefic makes Mercury malefic. Conjunction with benefics only (or no conjunction) keeps Mercury benefic. Exception: Moon and Mercury together are both treated as benefics.

full_text: The Sun is the soul (Atmakaraka) of all beings. His governance is the soul/spirit of the native.

condition.subject: Sun
condition.description: Sun governs the Atman (soul/spirit) of the native

claim.text: Sun represents the soul (Atman) of the native. Strength of Sun indicates maturity of soul and spiritual wellbeing.

full_text: The Moon governs the mind of the native.

condition.subject: Moon
condition.description: Moon governs mind (Manas) — thoughts, emotions, mental disposition

claim.text: Moon represents the mind (Manas) of the native. Strength and condition of Moon governs mental stability, emotional nature, and happiness of mind.

full_text: Mars governs valor and courage (Vikrama/strength).

condition.subject: Mars
condition.description: Mars governs valor, strength, courage, and physical vitality

claim.text: Mars represents valor, courage, and physical strength of the native. A strong Mars gives ability for effort and bravery.

full_text: Mercury governs speech of the native.

condition.subject: Mercury
condition.description: Mercury governs speech, communication, and intellectual expression

claim.text: Mercury represents the native's speech and communication abilities. Mercury's strength governs clarity, eloquence, and intellectual expression.

full_text: Jupiter governs knowledge and happiness (Jnana and Sukha).

condition.subject: Jupiter
condition.description: Jupiter governs wisdom, knowledge, and general happiness

claim.text: Jupiter represents knowledge (Jnana) and happiness (Sukha) of the native. A well-placed Jupiter bestows wisdom and general contentment.

full_text: Venus governs desire (Kama) and potency/reproductive essence (Semen/Veerya).

condition.subject: Venus
condition.description: Venus governs desires, pleasures, and reproductive vitality (Semen/Veerya)

claim.text: Venus represents desires (Kama) and reproductive potency (Veerya/Semen) of the native. Venus governs sensual pleasures and vitality.

full_text: Saturn governs grief (Dukha) of the native.

condition.subject: Saturn
condition.description: Saturn governs grief, suffering, sorrow, and hardship

claim.text: Saturn represents grief and suffering of the native. Saturn's affliction to key houses/planets produces sorrow. A strong but dignified Saturn can reduce grief; an afflicted Saturn magnifies it.

full_text: The Sun and the Moon are of royal status (kings) in the planetary cabinet.

condition.subject: Sun_Moon
condition.description: Sun and Moon occupy the rank of kings in the planetary cabinet hierarchy

claim.text: Sun and Moon hold royal (king) status among planets. Their periods and significations carry kingly/authoritative qualities.

full_text: Mars is the army chief (Senapati) in the planetary cabinet.

condition.subject: Mars
condition.description: Mars holds the rank of army chief / commander in the planetary cabinet

claim.text: Mars is the Senapati (army chief/commander) of the planetary cabinet. This gives Mars a martial, commanding, protective quality.

full_text: Mercury is the prince-apparent (Yuvaraja / heir) in the planetary cabinet.

condition.subject: Mercury
condition.description: Mercury holds the rank of prince-apparent (Yuvaraja) in the planetary cabinet

claim.text: Mercury is the Yuvaraja (crown prince/heir apparent) of the planetary cabinet, reflecting Mercury's youthful, versatile, and communicative nature.

full_text: Jupiter and Venus are ministerial planets (Mantri) in the planetary cabinet.

condition.subject: Jupiter_Venus
condition.description: Jupiter and Venus hold the rank of ministers (Mantri) in the planetary cabinet

claim.text: Jupiter and Venus are Mantris (ministers) — wise, advisory, beneficial planets who counsel the native's decisions and grant prosperity.

full_text: Saturn is a servant (Dasa) in the planetary cabinet.

condition.subject: Saturn
condition.description: Saturn holds the rank of servant (Dasa/Shudra) in the planetary cabinet

claim.text: Saturn is the Dasa (servant) of the planetary cabinet, reflecting Saturn's lowly, laboring, hardship-inducing nature.

full_text: Rahu and Ketu form the planetary army (Sainya) in the planetary cabinet. They represent the masses/soldiers and elephants/animals.

condition.subject: Rahu_Ketu
condition.description: Rahu and Ketu constitute the army (Sainya) — shadow planets, representing masses, chaotic forces, foreign elements

claim.text: Rahu and Ketu are the planetary army (Sainya). Rahu signifies masses, outcaste, and foreign forces; Ketu signifies moksha, the military masses, and mixed ancestry.

full_text: Planetary complexions: Sun = blood-red; Moon = tawny; Mars = blood-red (not very tall); Mercury = green grass hue; Jupiter = tawny; Venus = variegated; Saturn = dark.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Natural color/complexion assigned to each of the seven visible planets

claim.text: Planetary colors: Sun=blood-red, Moon=tawny, Mars=blood-red, Mercury=green, Jupiter=tawny, Venus=variegated/multi-color, Saturn=dark/black.

full_text: Presiding deities (Adhidevatas) of the seven planets from Sun onwards: Fire (Agni), Water (Varuna), Subrahmanya (Lord Shiva's son), Maha Vishnu, Indra, Sachi Devi (consort of Indra), Brahma.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Adhidevata (presiding deity) assigned to each of the seven visible planets

claim.text: Planetary Adhidevatas: Sun=Agni (Fire), Moon=Varuna (Water), Mars=Subrahmanya, Mercury=Maha Vishnu, Jupiter=Indra, Venus=Sachi Devi, Saturn=Brahma. Used for propitiation remedies.

full_text: Mercury and Saturn are neuters (neither male nor female). The Moon and Venus are female planets. The Sun, Mars and Jupiter are male planets.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Gender (sex) classification of the nine planets: male, female, or neuter

claim.text: Planetary gender: Male = Sun, Mars, Jupiter. Female = Moon, Venus. Neuter = Mercury, Saturn. Rahu/Ketu not classified in this sloka (traditionally Rahu=male, Ketu=neuter).

full_text: The five Pancha Bhoota (primordial compounds/elements) are respectively governed by: Fire=Mars, Earth=Mercury, Ether=Jupiter, Water=Venus, Air=Saturn.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Pancha Bhoota (five element) rulership: each of the five elements is assigned to a planet

claim.text: Pancha Bhoota rulers: Mars=Fire (Agni), Mercury=Earth (Prithvi), Jupiter=Ether (Akasha), Venus=Water (Jala), Saturn=Air (Vayu). Sun and Moon govern Atma and Mind rather than elements.

full_text: Planetary castes: Jupiter and Venus are Brahmins. The Sun is royal (Kshatriya). The Moon and Mercury belong to the commercial community (Vaishya). Saturn rules the Shudras (4th caste). Mars is also royal/Kshatriya (by inference from context and standard Parashari enumeration).

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Varna (caste) classification assigned to each planet

claim.text: Planetary Varnas: Jupiter=Brahmin, Venus=Brahmin, Sun=Kshatriya, Mars=Kshatriya (standard enumeration), Moon=Vaishya, Mercury=Vaishya, Saturn=Shudra. Rahu/Ketu=outcaste/mixed (sloka 41).

full_text: Satvik planets are the luminaries (Sun and Moon) and Jupiter. Rajasik planets are Venus and Mercury. Tamasik planets are Mars and Saturn.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Three-Guna (Satwa/Rajas/Tamas) classification of planets

claim.text: Planetary Gunas: Satvik (pure/spiritual) = Sun, Moon, Jupiter. Rajasik (active/passionate) = Venus, Mercury. Tamasik (inert/dark) = Mars, Saturn. Guna of ruling planet influences native's disposition.

full_text: Description of the Sun: The Sun has honey-coloured eyes, a square body, is of clean habits, bilious in constitution, intelligent, and has limited hair on his head.

condition.subject: Sun
condition.description: Physical and temperamental description of the Sun

claim.text: Sun's physical/temperamental nature: honey-coloured eyes, square body, clean habits, bilious (Pitta) constitution, intelligent, sparse hair. Influences native's appearance when Sun is dominant planet.

full_text: Description of the Moon: The Moon is very windy and phlegmatic in temperament. She is learned and has a round body. She has auspicious looks and sweet speech. She is fickle-minded and very lustful.

condition.subject: Moon
condition.description: Physical and temperamental description of the Moon

claim.text: Moon's physical/temperamental nature: windy (Vata) and phlegmatic (Kapha), learned, round body, auspicious appearance, sweet speech, fickle-minded, lustful. Influences native when Moon is dominant.

full_text: Description of Mars: Mars has blood-red eyes, is fickle-minded, liberal, bilious in constitution, given to anger, and has a thin waist and thin physique.

condition.subject: Mars
condition.description: Physical and temperamental description of Mars

claim.text: Mars's physical/temperamental nature: blood-red eyes, fickle-minded, liberal, bilious (Pitta), angry, thin waist and physique. Influences native when Mars is dominant.

full_text: Description of Mercury: Mercury is endowed with an attractive physique and the capacity to use words with many meanings. He is fond of jokes. He has a mix of all three humours (Tridosha).

condition.subject: Mercury
condition.description: Physical and temperamental description of Mercury

claim.text: Mercury's nature: attractive physique, witty speech (uses words with many meanings), humorous, Tridosha (mix of Vata/Pitta/Kapha) constitution. Influences native when Mercury is dominant.

full_text: Description of Jupiter: Jupiter has a big body, tawny hair and tawny eyes. He is phlegmatic in constitution, intelligent, and learned in all shastras.

condition.subject: Jupiter
condition.description: Physical and temperamental description of Jupiter

claim.text: Jupiter's nature: big body, tawny hair and eyes, phlegmatic (Kapha) constitution, highly intelligent, learned in scriptures (shastras). Influences native when Jupiter is dominant.

full_text: Description of Venus: Venus is charming, has a splendorous physique, is excellent in disposition, has charming eyes, is a poet, is phlegmatic and windy in constitution, and has curly hair.

condition.subject: Venus
condition.description: Physical and temperamental description of Venus

claim.text: Venus's nature: charming appearance, splendorous physique, excellent disposition, charming eyes, poetic nature, Kapha-Vata constitution, curly hair. Influences native when Venus is dominant.

full_text: Description of Saturn: Saturn has an emaciated and long physique, has tawny eyes, is windy (Vata) in temperament, has big teeth, is indolent and lame, and has coarse hair.

condition.subject: Saturn
condition.description: Physical and temperamental description of Saturn

claim.text: Saturn's nature: emaciated and long body, tawny eyes, Vata constitution, large teeth, indolent, lame, coarse hair. Influences native when Saturn is dominant.

full_text: Description of Rahu: Rahu has a smoky appearance with a blue-mixed physique. He resides in forests and is horrible/fierce in nature. He is windy in temperament and is intelligent. Ketu is akin to Rahu in nature.

condition.subject: Rahu_Ketu
condition.description: Physical and temperamental description of Rahu and Ketu

claim.text: Rahu's nature: smoky/dark-blue appearance, forest dweller, fierce/horrible, Vata constitution, intelligent. Ketu's nature is similar to Rahu.

full_text: The seven Sapta Dhatus (primary bodily ingredients) are governed by the planets from the Sun onwards in order: Sun=Bones, Moon=Blood, Mars=Marrow, Mercury=Skin, Jupiter=Fat, Venus=Semen, Saturn=Muscles.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Sapta Dhatu (seven bodily tissue) rulership — one Dhatu assigned to each of the seven visible planets in order from Sun

claim.text: Sapta Dhatu rulership: Sun=Bones (Asthi), Moon=Blood (Rakta), Mars=Marrow (Majja), Mercury=Skin (Twak), Jupiter=Fat (Meda), Venus=Semen/Reproductive fluid (Shukra), Saturn=Muscles (Mamsa). Affliction to a planet harms its Dhatu.

full_text: Planetary abodes: Sun=Temple, Moon=Watery place, Mars=Place of fire, Mercury=Sport-ground/playground, Jupiter=Treasure-house, Venus=Bedroom, Saturn=Filthy ground.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Planetary abode/location rulership — primarily for horary astrology to identify where lost objects are found

claim.text: Planetary abodes: Sun=Temple, Moon=Watery place/water body, Mars=Place of fire (kitchen/forge), Mercury=Playground/sport-ground, Jupiter=Treasury/storeroom, Venus=Bedroom/intimate space, Saturn=Filthy/unclean ground. Used in Prashna (horary) to locate lost articles.

full_text: Planetary periods (time durations for event maturation): Sun=Ayana (6 months), Moon=Muhurtha (48 minutes), Mars=Day (one day), Mercury=Ritu (2 months), Jupiter=Month (one month), Venus=Fortnight (15 days), Saturn=Year (one year). Additionally: Rahu=8 months, Ketu=3 months (from notes to sloka 46).

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Planetary time periods — the duration associated with each planet for event fruition, especially in horary astrology

claim.text: Planetary time periods: Sun=6 months (Ayana), Moon=48 minutes (Muhurtha), Mars=1 day, Mercury=2 months (Ritu), Jupiter=1 month, Venus=15 days (fortnight), Saturn=1 year, Rahu=8 months, Ketu=3 months.

full_text: Planetary tastes: Sun=Pungent, Moon=Saline, Mars=Bitter, Mercury=Mixed, Jupiter=Sweet, Venus=Acidulous (sour), Saturn=Astringent.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Six taste (Rasa) rulership assigned to planets from the Sun

claim.text: Planetary Rasas (tastes): Sun=Pungent (Katu), Moon=Saline (Lavana), Mars=Bitter (Tikta), Mercury=Mixed (Kashaya+others), Jupiter=Sweet (Madhura), Venus=Acidulous/Sour (Amla), Saturn=Astringent (Kashaya). Strongest planet indicates native's taste preference.

full_text: Directional strengths (Digbala): Mercury and Jupiter are strong in the East (1st house/ascendant). Sun and Mars are strong in the South (10th house). Saturn is strong in the West (7th house). Moon and Venus are strong in the North (4th house).

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Digbala (directional strength) — each planet attains full directional strength in a specific angular house (East=1st, South=10th, West=7th, North=4th)

claim.text: Digbala positions: Mercury/Jupiter=1st house (East), Sun/Mars=10th house (South), Saturn=7th house (West), Moon/Venus=4th house (North). A planet at its Digbala house gains full positional strength; at opposite house has no Digbala.

full_text: Day and night strengths: Moon, Mars and Saturn are strong during night. Mercury is strong during day and night both. Jupiter, Sun and Venus are strong only during daytime. Malefics are strong during the dark half (Krishna Paksha). Benefics are strong during the bright half (Shukla Paksha).

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Temporal strength by day/night and lunar phase (Paksha Bala components)

claim.text: Temporal strength: Night-strong = Moon, Mars, Saturn. Day+Night = Mercury. Day-only = Jupiter, Sun, Venus. Dark-half strong = malefics (Sun/Saturn/Mars/Rahu/Ketu). Bright-half strong = benefics (Moon/Jupiter/Venus/Mercury when benefic).

full_text: Ayana (hemisphere) strength: Malefics are stronger in Dakshinayana (southern course, Karka-Dhanu). Benefics are stronger in Uttarayana (northern course, Makara-Mithuna).

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Ayana Bala — strength based on the Sun's position in northern or southern course of the zodiac

claim.text: Ayana Bala: Malefics gain strength in Dakshinayana (Cancer-Sagittarius, south course). Benefics gain strength in Uttarayana (Capricorn-Gemini, north course).

full_text: Hora strength order: The lords of year, month, day and Hora are progressively stronger than each other in ascending order. Among planets independently, in ascending order of strength: Saturn, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Moon, Sun.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Comparative natural strength of planets: Sun being strongest, Saturn weakest in Naisargika Bala

claim.text: Natural planetary strength (Naisargika Bala) ascending order: Saturn < Mars < Mercury < Jupiter < Venus < Moon < Sun. Hora (planetary hour) lord is strongest of time lords; year lord weakest.

full_text: Trees ruled by planets: Sun=strong trees with stout trunks; Moon=milky trees (like rubber-yielding plants); Mars=bitter trees (like lemon plants); Mercury=fruitless trees; Jupiter=fruitful trees; Venus=floral plants; Saturn=useless/thorny trees.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Planetary tree/plant rulership — primarily used in Jyotisha for identifying plants in horary/muhurta contexts

claim.text: Planetary tree rulership: Sun=stout-trunked trees, Moon=milky/latex trees, Mars=bitter trees, Mercury=fruitless trees, Jupiter=fruit-bearing trees, Venus=flowering plants, Saturn=useless/dry/thorny trees.

full_text: Rahu rules the outcaste (Chandala). Ketu governs the mixed caste (born of inter-caste union). Saturn and the nodes (Rahu/Ketu) reside in anthills. Rahu denotes multi-coloured cloth. Ketu = lead and blue gems. Planetary fabrics: Sun=saffron/orange cloth, Moon=silken cloth, Mercury=red silken cloth, Mars=white silken cloth, Jupiter=black/dark cloth, Saturn=multi-coloured cloth.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Miscellaneous planetary associations: caste of Rahu/Ketu, habitation, gemstone, fabrics

claim.text: Rahu=Chandala (outcaste), Ketu=mixed caste. Rahu/Saturn=anthills. Gem associations: Rahu=lead/blue gemstone, Ketu=lead/blue gem. Fabrics: Sun=saffron, Moon=silk, Mercury=red silk, Mars=white silk, Jupiter=black, Venus=variegated, Saturn=multi-coloured. Used in remedy prescriptions and horary.

full_text: Planetary seasons (Ritus): Venus=Vasanta (spring, mid-March to mid-May), Mars=Greeshma (summer, mid-May to mid-July), Moon=Varsha (monsoon, mid-July to mid-September), Mercury=Sarat (autumn, mid-September to mid-November), Jupiter=Hemanta (pre-winter, mid-November to mid-January), Saturn=Sisira (winter, mid-January to mid-March). Rahu=8 months, Ketu=3 months (combined season/period association).

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Six Ritu (seasonal) rulership — each of the six Indian seasons assigned to a planet

claim.text: Planetary Ritus: Venus=Vasanta, Mars=Greeshma, Moon=Varsha, Mercury=Sarat, Jupiter=Hemanta, Saturn=Sisira. Sun is co-ruler of Greeshma. Rahu=8 months, Ketu=3 months (their respective period durations). Used in muhurta, horary, and timing of events.

full_text: Dhatu, Moola, and Jeeva classifications: Dhatu planets (metals/minerals) = Rahu, Mars, Saturn, Moon. Moola planets (roots/vegetables) = Sun, Venus. Jeeva planets (living beings) = Mercury, Jupiter, Ketu.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Three-fold classification of planets into Dhatu (matter/metals), Moola (roots/plants), and Jeeva (living beings) — primarily for horary astrology

claim.text: Dhatu/Moola/Jeeva: Dhatu (metals/inorganic) = Rahu, Mars, Saturn, Moon. Moola (roots/organics/plants) = Sun, Venus. Jeeva (living beings) = Mercury, Jupiter, Ketu. Used in horary to identify nature of queried subject.

full_text: Exaltation signs and deep-exaltation degrees for the seven planets from Sun: Sun=Aries-10°, Moon=Taurus-3°, Mars=Capricorn-28°, Mercury=Virgo-15°, Jupiter=Cancer-5°, Venus=Pisces-27°, Saturn=Libra-20°. Each planet's debilitation sign is the 7th from its exaltation sign. The same degrees of deep exaltation apply to deep fall (debilitation).

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Uccha (exaltation) signs and degrees + Neecha (debilitation) signs and degrees for all seven visible planets

claim.text: Exaltation: Sun/Aries-10°, Moon/Taurus-3°, Mars/Capricorn-28°, Mercury/Virgo-15°, Jupiter/Cancer-5°, Venus/Pisces-27°, Saturn/Libra-20°. Debilitation = sign 7th from exaltation, same degree: Sun/Libra-10°, Moon/Scorpio-3°, Mars/Cancer-28°, Mercury/Pisces-15°, Jupiter/Capricorn-5°, Venus/Virgo-27°, Saturn/Aries-20°.

full_text: Sun's dignities in Leo: First 20 degrees of Leo are Moolatrikona; the remaining 10 degrees (20°-30°) are own house (Swakshetra). Sun's other own sign is Cancer (ruled exclusively as Swakshetra, no MT).

condition.subject: Sun
condition.description: Sun's Moolatrikona and Swakshetra (own sign) degree ranges

claim.text: Sun: Moolatrikona = Leo 0°-20°. Swakshetra (own sign) = Leo 20°-30°. Note: Sun's second own sign Cancer is treated as plain Swakshetra.

full_text: Moon's dignities: The entire sign of Taurus (all 30 degrees) is the Moon's Moolatrikona. Moon owns Cancer but no Moolatrikona range is defined there — Cancer is plain Swakshetra.

condition.subject: Moon
condition.description: Moon's Moolatrikona and Swakshetra degree ranges

claim.text: Moon: Moolatrikona = Taurus 0°-30° (entire sign). Swakshetra (own sign) = Cancer (plain, no MT range). Moon in Taurus is Moolatrikona-strength.

full_text: Mars's dignities in Aries: First 12 degrees of Aries are Moolatrikona; remaining 18 degrees (12°-30°) are own house (Swakshetra). Mars also owns Scorpio as plain Swakshetra.

condition.subject: Mars
condition.description: Mars's Moolatrikona and Swakshetra degree ranges

claim.text: Mars: Moolatrikona = Aries 0°-12°. Swakshetra (own sign) = Aries 12°-30° and Scorpio 0°-30°.

full_text: Mercury's dignities in Virgo: First 15 degrees = exaltation zone. Next 5 degrees (15°-20°) = Moolatrikona. Last 10 degrees (20°-30°) = own house (Swakshetra). Mercury also owns Gemini as plain Swakshetra.

condition.subject: Mercury
condition.description: Mercury's exaltation zone, Moolatrikona, and Swakshetra degree ranges in Virgo

claim.text: Mercury: Virgo 0°-15° = Exaltation zone (Uccha). Virgo 15°-20° = Moolatrikona. Virgo 20°-30° = Swakshetra. Gemini 0°-30° = Swakshetra (plain own sign).

full_text: Jupiter's dignities in Sagittarius: First one-third (0°-10°) of Sagittarius is Moolatrikona; remaining two-thirds (10°-30°) are own house. Jupiter also owns Pisces as plain Swakshetra.

condition.subject: Jupiter
condition.description: Jupiter's Moolatrikona and Swakshetra degree ranges

claim.text: Jupiter: Moolatrikona = Sagittarius 0°-10°. Swakshetra = Sagittarius 10°-30° and Pisces 0°-30°.

full_text: Venus's dignities in Libra: First half (0°-15°) of Libra is Moolatrikona; second half (15°-30°) is own house. Venus also owns Taurus as plain Swakshetra.

condition.subject: Venus
condition.description: Venus's Moolatrikona and Swakshetra degree ranges

claim.text: Venus: Moolatrikona = Libra 0°-15°. Swakshetra = Libra 15°-30° and Taurus 0°-30°.

full_text: Saturn's dignities in Aquarius: Same arrangement as Sun in Leo. First 20 degrees (0°-20°) = Moolatrikona; remaining 10 degrees (20°-30°) = own house. Saturn also owns Capricorn as plain Swakshetra.

condition.subject: Saturn
condition.description: Saturn's Moolatrikona and Swakshetra degree ranges

claim.text: Saturn: Moolatrikona = Aquarius 0°-20°. Swakshetra = Aquarius 20°-30° and Capricorn 0°-30°.

full_text: Natural friendship formula: Note the signs which are the 4th, 2nd, 12th, 5th, 9th and 8th from the Moolatrikona sign of a planet. The planets ruling those signs are its natural friends, along with the lord of its exaltation sign. Lords of all other signs (i.e., 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th, 11th from Moolatrikona) are its natural enemies. If a planet becomes both friend and enemy through the two computations, it becomes neutral (equal).

condition.subject: planet
condition.description: Formula to compute natural (permanent) friendship/enmity/neutrality between planets based on Moolatrikona position

claim.text: Natural friendship formula: From any planet's Moolatrikona sign, lords of houses 2, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12 = friends (plus exaltation sign lord). Lords of houses 3, 6, 7, 10, 11 = enemies. A planet appearing in both lists = neutral/equal. This defines Naisargika Maitri.

full_text: Natural friendship table from sloka 55 (Santhanam's enumeration): Sun: Friends=Moon/Mars/Jupiter; Enemies=Venus/Saturn; Equal=Mercury. Moon: Friends=Sun/Mercury; Enemies=none; Equal=Mars/Jupiter/Venus/Saturn. Mars: Friends=Sun/Moon/Jupiter; Enemies=Mercury; Equal=Venus/Saturn. Mercury: Friends=Sun/Venus; Enemies=Moon; Equal=Mars/Jupiter/Saturn. Jupiter: Friends=Sun/Moon/Mars; Enemies=Mercury/Venus; Equal=Saturn. Venus: Friends=Mercury/Saturn; Enemies=Moon/Sun; Equal=Mars/Jupiter. Saturn: Friends=Mercury/Venus; Enemies=Sun/Moon/Mars; Equal=Jupiter.

condition.subject: planet_set
condition.description: Derived natural friendship/enmity/equality table for all seven visible planets as computed by the sloka 55 formula

claim.text: Natural planetary relationships (Santhanam): Sun=F:Moon/Mars/Jup, E:Venus/Saturn, N:Mercury | Moon=F:Sun/Mercury, E:none, N:Mars/Jupiter/Venus/Saturn | Mars=F:Sun/Moon/Jup, E:Mercury, N:Venus/Saturn | Mercury=F:Sun/Venus, E:Moon, N:Mars/Jupiter/Saturn | Jupiter=F:Sun/Moon/Mars, E:Mercury/Venus, N:Saturn | Venus=F:Mercury/Saturn, E:Moon/Sun, N:Mars/Jupiter | Saturn=F:Mercury/Venus, E:Sun/Moon/Mars, N:Jupiter.

full_text: Moon's exception: The Moon does not consider any planet as her natural enemy. The Sun and Mercury are the Moon's friends; all others (Mars, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn) are her neutrals. Per Parasara (Chaukamba edition) and Saravali.

condition.subject: Moon
condition.description: Moon has no natural enemies — all non-friends are neutrals, not enemies. Exception to the general formula.

claim.text: Moon has no natural enemies. Moon's friends = Sun, Mercury. Moon's neutrals = Mars, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn. This is an exception to the standard Moolatrikona formula result.

notes: Santhanam cites Chaukamba edition of BPHS and Saravali as authority for this Moon exception.

full_text: Rahu's natural relationships: Enemies=Sun/Moon/Mars. Friends=Jupiter/Venus/Saturn. Neutral=Mercury.

condition.subject: Rahu
condition.description: Rahu's natural planetary friendship/enmity/neutrality relationships

claim.text: Rahu: Natural friends = Jupiter, Venus, Saturn. Natural enemies = Sun, Moon, Mars. Neutral = Mercury.

full_text: Ketu's natural relationships: Enemies=Sun/Moon (luminaries). Friends=Mars/Venus/Saturn. Neutrals=Mercury/Jupiter.

condition.subject: Ketu
condition.description: Ketu's natural planetary friendship/enmity/neutrality relationships

claim.text: Ketu: Natural friends = Mars, Venus, Saturn. Natural enemies = Sun, Moon. Neutrals = Mercury, Jupiter.

full_text: Temporary (horoscopic) relationship: A planet posited in the 10th, 4th, 11th, 3rd, 2nd or 12th from another planet becomes a mutual temporary friend. If posited otherwise (i.e., in the 1st, 5th, 6th, 7th, 8th, or 9th), there is mutual temporary enmity. This applies for a given horoscope.

condition.subject: planet
condition.description: Formula for computing Tatkalika Maitri (temporary/horoscopic friendship) based on positional distance between planets in a specific chart

claim.text: Temporary friendship formula: Planet A is temporarily friendly to Planet B if B is in houses 2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12 from A. Planet A is temporarily hostile to B if B is in houses 1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 from A. The relationship is mutual — if A is friendly toward B, B is also friendly toward A.

full_text: Compound relationship (5-fold Panchadhavarga Maitri): Natural Friendship + Temporary Friendship = Extreme/Great Friend (Adhi Mitra). Natural Friendship + Temporary Enmity = Neutral (Sama). Natural Enmity + Temporary Friendship = Neutral (Sama). Natural Enmity + Temporary Enmity = Extreme Enemy (Adhi Shatru). Natural Neutral + Temporary Friendship = Friend (Mitra). Natural Neutral + Temporary Enmity = Enemy (Shatru).

condition.subject: planet
condition.description: 5-fold compound relationship table — combines natural and temporary relationships to yield the final relationship for a given chart (Panchadhavarga Maitri)

claim.text: Panchadhavarga Maitri combinations: Friend+Friend=Adhi Mitra (Great Friend). Friend+Enemy=Sama (Neutral). Enemy+Friend=Sama (Neutral). Enemy+Enemy=Adhi Shatru (Great Enemy). Neutral+Friend=Mitra (Friend). Neutral+Enemy=Shatru (Enemy). Astrologer should use this compound relationship for horoscopic deductions.

full_text: Ratio of effects by dignity: A planet in exaltation gives full (100%) auspicious effects. In Moolatrikona it loses one-fourth, giving 3/4 (75%) auspicious effects. In own sign it gives 1/2 (50%) auspicious effects. In a friendly sign it gives 1/4 (25%) auspicious effects. In an equal/neutral sign 1/8 (12.5%) auspicious effects. In debilitation or enemy sign the auspicious effects are nil (0%). Inauspicious effects are exactly reverse (greatest in debilitation/enemy, least in exaltation).

condition.subject: planet
condition.description: Proportional strength/effect scale based on planetary dignity — defines how much of a planet's signification manifests at each dignity level

claim.text: Dignity effect ratios: Exaltation=100% benefic. Moolatrikona=75%. Own sign=50%. Friendly sign=25%. Neutral sign=12.5%. Debilitation/Enemy sign=0% benefic (maximum malefic). This scale applies to how fully a planet delivers its positive significations.

full_text: Upagraha (sub-planet) computation formula — Dhooma: Add 4 signs 13°20' (i.e., 133°20') to the Sun's longitude to get Dhooma.

condition.subject: Dhooma
condition.description: Formula to compute longitude of Dhooma Upagraha from Sun's longitude

claim.text: Dhooma = Sun's longitude + 133°20'. Dhooma is all-inauspicious. It afflicts whichever planet or point it conjuncts or aspects.

full_text: Upagraha computation — Vyatipata: Subtract Dhooma from 12 signs (360°) to get Vyatipata. Equivalently: Vyatipata = 360° - Dhooma.

condition.subject: Vyatipata
condition.description: Formula to compute longitude of Vyatipata Upagraha

claim.text: Vyatipata = 360° - Dhooma. Vyatipata is inauspicious. Equivalently: Vyatipata = Sun + 133°20' then subtracted from 360°, giving (360° - (Sun + 133°20')) = 226°40' - Sun.

full_text: Upagraha computation — Parivesha: Add 6 signs (180°) to Vyatipata to get Parivesha. Parivesha is extremely inauspicious.

condition.subject: Parivesha
condition.description: Formula to compute longitude of Parivesha Upagraha

claim.text: Parivesha = Vyatipata + 180°. Parivesha is extremely inauspicious — considered the most malefic of the five Upagrahas.

full_text: Upagraha computation — Chapa (Indra Dhanus): Subtract Parivesha from 12 signs (360°). Equivalently: Chapa = 360° - Parivesha.

condition.subject: Chapa
condition.description: Formula to compute longitude of Chapa (Indra Dhanus) Upagraha

claim.text: Chapa (Indra Dhanus) = 360° - Parivesha. Chapa is inauspicious.

full_text: Upagraha computation — Upaketu (Sikhi): Add 16°40' to Chapa to get Upaketu. Verification: Upaketu + 30° = Sun's original longitude (completing the cycle).

condition.subject: Upaketu
condition.description: Formula to compute longitude of Upaketu (Sikhi) Upagraha; verification check: Upaketu + 30° = Sun

claim.text: Upaketu (Sikhi) = Chapa + 16°40'. Upaketu is a malefic. Verification: Upaketu + 30° should equal Sun's longitude (confirming correct computation of all five Upagrahas).

full_text: All five Upagrahas (Dhooma, Vyatipata, Parivesha, Chapa, Upaketu) are devoid of splendour (Aprakasa = non-luminous). They are malefics by nature and cause affliction to whatever they contact.

condition.subject: upagraha_set
condition.description: General nature of all five Upagrahas — all are malefic, non-luminous sub-planets

claim.text: All five Upagrahas are Aprakasa Grahas (non-luminous shadow points). All are malefic. Their conjunction with or aspect on any planet or house causes affliction and inauspicious effects to that significator.

full_text: Effects of Upagraha affliction: If an Upagraha afflicts the Sun, the native's dynasty declines and he loses his sons (or there will be no sons). If an Upagraha afflicts the Moon, the native's longevity and wisdom are reduced. If an Upagraha afflicts the ascendant, the native has a short life.

condition.subject: ascendant_or_planet
condition.description: Effect of any of the five Upagrahas conjuncting/afflicting Sun, Moon, or ascendant

claim.text: Upagraha afflicts Sun → dynasty decline, loss/absence of sons. Upagraha afflicts Moon → reduced longevity and reduced wisdom/intelligence. Upagraha afflicts ascendant → short life.

full_text: Kala Vela computation — Day division: The duration of day is divided into 8 equal parts. The first part is governed by the weekday lord. The remaining parts follow in the order of weekday lords (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, repeating). The 8th part is lordless (unlorded).

condition.subject: kala_vela
condition.description: Day-time Kala Vela computation: 8-part equal division of day duration starting from weekday lord

claim.text: Day Kala Vela: Day duration ÷ 8 = one segment. Segment 1 = weekday lord. Segments 2-7 = next 6 weekday lords in sequence. Segment 8 = lordless. The five Kala Velas (Kala, Mrityu, Ardha Prahara, Yamaghantaka, Gulika) occupy specific positions in this sequence (ignoring Moon and Venus's segments when identifying them).

full_text: Kala Vela computation — Night division: The night duration is divided into 8 equal parts. The first part is governed by the planet ruling the 5th weekday lord counted from the birth day. The remaining parts follow in the usual weekday lord order. The 8th part is lordless. The five Kala Velas (Kala, Mrityu, Ardha Prahara, Yamaghantaka, Gulika) are identified in the same manner as for day.

condition.subject: kala_vela
condition.description: Night-time Kala Vela computation: 8-part equal division of night duration starting from the 5th weekday lord

claim.text: Night Kala Vela: Night duration ÷ 8 = one segment. Segment 1 = 5th weekday lord from birth day. Segments follow weekday lord sequence. Segment 8 = lordless. Same five Kala Vela names apply in the same positional slots.

full_text: The five Kala Velas are: Kala, Mrityu, Ardha Prahara, Yamaghantaka, and Gulika (Mandi). They are identified within the 8-part day/night segments by taking the portions belonging to Sun, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mercury respectively (ignoring Moon and Venus segments), which map to the five Kala Vela names in order.

condition.subject: kala_vela
condition.description: Identification of the five Kala Velas within the 8-segment day/night division sequence

claim.text: Five Kala Velas in order (ignoring Moon/Venus segments): Kala (Sun's segment), Mrityu (Mars's segment), Ardha Prahara (Saturn's segment), Yamaghantaka (Jupiter's segment), Gulika (Mercury's segment). Gulika = Mandi — same entity.

full_text: Day/night durations for Kala Vela computation must be calculated for the latitude of birth, not a fixed duration. Variable day/night lengths based on birth latitude and date apply.

condition.subject: kala_vela
condition.description: Latitude-dependent day/night duration for Kala Vela calculation — not a fixed 12-hour day/night

claim.text: Kala Vela computation must use the actual sunrise-to-sunset duration (day) and sunset-to-sunrise duration (night) for the birth latitude and date. Different places on the same date have different Kala Vela timings.

full_text: Gulika's longitude: The degree ascending on the eastern horizon at the time of the START of Gulika's portion (as computed above) is the longitude of Gulika for that nativity. Based on this longitude only, Gulika's effects for a particular nativity should be estimated.

condition.subject: Gulika
condition.description: Formula to convert Gulika's time-segment into a zodiacal longitude for use in chart analysis

claim.text: Gulika longitude = ascending degree (lagna) at the START of Gulika's time-portion. This is the point used for all Gulika predictive rules. Note: Santhanam confirms 'start of portion' is correct per Parasara; some authorities use end of portion.

full_text: Pranapada computation — Step 1: Convert birth time into vighatikas (1 ghati = 60 vighatikas; 1 day = 60 ghatis = 3600 vighatikas). Divide total vighatikas by 15 to get a number in Rasis/degrees (1 Rasi = 15 vighatikas in this formula).

condition.subject: Pranapada
condition.description: Step 1 of Pranapada (Prana Lagna) computation: convert birth time to vighatikas and divide by 15

claim.text: Pranapada step 1: Birth time in vighatikas ÷ 15 = arc value in Rasis/degrees. This arc is then added to the Sun's position with a sign-type adjustment (see rules 072-073).

full_text: Pranapada computation — Sun sign adjustment: If the Sun is in a MOVABLE sign (Aries/Cancer/Libra/Capricorn), add the arc value directly to the Sun's longitude to get Pranapada. If the Sun is in a FIXED sign (Taurus/Leo/Scorpio/Aquarius), add the arc + 240° additionally. If the Sun is in a DUAL sign (Gemini/Virgo/Sagittarius/Pisces), add the arc + 120° additionally.

condition.subject: Pranapada
condition.description: Sign-type (movable/fixed/dual) adjustment for Pranapada computation

claim.text: Pranapada = (birth vighatikas ÷ 15) + Sun's longitude [+ 0° if Sun in movable | + 240° if Sun in fixed | + 120° if Sun in dual sign]. Result modulo 360° = Pranapada longitude.

full_text: Pranapada auspicious houses: Birth is auspicious if Pranapada falls in the 2nd, 5th, 9th, 4th, 10th, or 11th house from the natal ascendant (lagna).

condition.subject: Pranapada
condition.description: Pranapada in houses 2/4/5/9/10/11 from lagna = auspicious birth

claim.text: Pranapada in 2nd/5th/9th/4th/10th/11th from lagna = auspicious birth. The native will have favorable life circumstances and outcomes.

full_text: Pranapada inauspicious houses: If Pranapada falls in any house other than 2nd, 5th, 9th, 4th, 10th, or 11th from the natal ascendant (i.e., in 1st, 3rd, 6th, 7th, 8th, or 12th), it indicates an inauspicious birth.

condition.subject: Pranapada
condition.description: Pranapada in houses 1/3/6/7/8/12 from lagna = inauspicious birth

claim.text: Pranapada in 1st/3rd/6th/7th/8th/12th from lagna = inauspicious birth. Native faces adverse life circumstances.

full_text: Saturn is the eldest among all planets and bestows the maximum number of years in Naisargika (natural/innate) Dasa.

condition.subject: Saturn
condition.description: Saturn's special status as the eldest planet and the planet granting maximum years in Naisargika Dasa

claim.text: Saturn is the eldest planet (highest age designation). Saturn's Naisargika Dasa period is the longest among all planets (19 years in Vimshottari — though Naisargika Dasa is a different system; in Naisargika context Saturn = 19/20 years depending on system).

full_text: The 12 signs of the zodiac in order are: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces.

condition.subject: zodiac_signs
condition.description: Canonical ordered list of the 12 Rasis (zodiacal signs)

claim.text: The 12 Rasis in order: 1=Aries (Mesha), 2=Taurus (Vrishabha), 3=Gemini (Mithuna), 4=Cancer (Karka), 5=Leo (Simha), 6=Virgo (Kanya), 7=Libra (Tula), 8=Scorpio (Vrishchika), 9=Sagittarius (Dhanu), 10=Capricorn (Makara), 11=Aquarius (Kumbha), 12=Pisces (Meena).

full_text: Limbs of Kalapurusha (Time Personified): The 12 signs from Aries correspond to body parts in order — head, face, arms, heart, stomach, hip, space below navel (waist/lower abdomen), privities (genitals), thighs, knees, ankles, and feet.

condition.subject: zodiac_signs
condition.description: Kalapurusha limb assignments for the 12 signs — used to identify which body part a sign/house governs in a given chart

claim.text: Kalapurusha body parts: Aries=Head, Taurus=Face, Gemini=Arms, Cancer=Heart/Chest, Leo=Stomach/Belly, Virgo=Hip/Waist, Libra=Below navel/Lower abdomen, Scorpio=Genitals/Privities, Sagittarius=Thighs, Capricorn=Knees, Aquarius=Ankles, Pisces=Feet. Limbs related to malefic-occupied signs suffer; benefic-occupied limbs are strong and healthy.

full_text: Sign mobility classification: Movable (Chara) signs are Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn. Fixed (Sthira) signs are Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius. Dual (Dwiswabhava/Common) signs are Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces.

condition.subject: zodiac_signs
condition.description: Three-fold mobility (Chara/Sthira/Dwiswabhava) classification of the 12 signs

claim.text: Movable: Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn. Fixed: Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius. Dual: Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces. Governs chart assessment for events, dasa timing, and Pranapada calculation.

full_text: Sign polarity (benefic/malefic): Odd-numbered signs (Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius) are malefic (Krura). Even-numbered signs (Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces) are benefic (Soumya).

condition.subject: zodiac_signs
condition.description: Odd signs = malefic/cruel; even signs = benefic/gentle

claim.text: Odd signs (1/3/5/7/9/11 = Aries/Gemini/Leo/Libra/Sagittarius/Aquarius) are malefic/cruel (Krura/Ugra). Even signs (2/4/6/8/10/12 = Taurus/Cancer/Virgo/Scorpio/Capricorn/Pisces) are benefic/gentle (Soumya/Mrudu).

full_text: Sign gender: Odd-numbered signs (Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius) are male. Even-numbered signs (Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces) are female.

condition.subject: zodiac_signs
condition.description: Male/female gender classification of the 12 signs based on odd/even numbering

claim.text: Male signs: Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius (odd). Female signs: Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces (even). Used in assessing Pranapada, Nisheka Lagna, and gender of co-born.

full_text: Sign temperament (Tridosha): Aries, Leo and Sagittarius (fire trine) are bilious (Pitta). Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn (earth trine) are windy (Vata). Gemini, Libra and Aquarius (air trine) are mixed (Tridosha — bile, wind and phlegm combined). Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces (water trine) are phlegmatic (Kapha).

condition.subject: zodiac_signs
condition.description: Tridosha (humour/temperament) classification of the 12 signs by trine group

claim.text: Sign Doshas: Fire signs (Aries/Leo/Sagittarius) = Pitta. Earth signs (Taurus/Virgo/Capricorn) = Vata. Air signs (Gemini/Libra/Aquarius) = mixed Tridosha. Water signs (Cancer/Scorpio/Pisces) = Kapha. Used for medical astrology and health disposition analysis.

full_text: Aries described: Blood-red complexion. Prominent/big physique. Quadruped sign. Strong during night. Denotes courage. Resides in the East. Related to kings. Wanders in hills. Predominates in Rajo Guna. Rises with its back (Prishtodaya). Fiery. Ruler is Mars.

condition.subject: Aries

claim.text: Aries: Color=blood-red, Body=quadruped/big, Strength=night, Direction=East, Caste=royal/Kshatriya, Guna=Rajasik, Rising=Prishtodaya (back), Element=Fire, Ruler=Mars. Represents hills/forests, kings, courage.

full_text: Taurus described: White complexion. Long/rectangular body. Quadruped sign. Strong during night. Resides in the South. Represents villages and businessmen. Earthy sign. Rises with its back (Prishtodaya). Ruler is Venus.

condition.subject: Taurus
condition.description: Full attribute description of Taurus (Vrishabha Rasi)

claim.text: Taurus: Color=white, Body=quadruped/long, Strength=night, Direction=South, Caste=Vaishya/commercial, Rising=Prishtodaya (back), Element=Earth, Ruler=Venus. Represents villages, businessmen.

full_text: Gemini described: Rises with its head (Shirshodaya). Represents a male and female holding a mace and lute (couple). Lives in the West. Airy sign. Biped sign. Strong during nights. Lives in villages. Windy temperament. Has an even/medium body with a green grass hue. Ruler is Mercury.

claim.text: Gemini: Color=green, Body=biped/medium, Strength=night, Direction=West, Symbol=couple (male+female with mace+lute), Guna=mixed Tridosha/Rajasik, Rising=Shirshodaya (head), Element=Air, Ruler=Mercury.

full_text: Cancer described: Pale red complexion. Resorts to forests. Represents Brahmins. Strong in nights. Has many feet (centipede sign). Bulky body. Satvik in disposition. Watery sign. Rises with its back (Prishtodaya). Ruled by the Moon.

condition.subject: Cancer
condition.description: Full attribute description of Cancer (Karka Rasi)

claim.text: Cancer: Color=pale-red, Body=centipede/bulky, Strength=night, Habitation=forests, Caste=Brahmin, Guna=Satvik, Rising=Prishtodaya (back), Element=Water, Ruler=Moon.

full_text: Leo described: Ruled by the Sun. Satvik in disposition. Quadruped sign. Royal sign. Resorts to forests. Rises with its head (Shirshodaya). Has a large, white body. Resides in the East. Strong during daytime.

condition.subject: Leo
condition.description: Full attribute description of Leo (Simha Rasi)

claim.text: Leo: Color=white/pale, Body=quadruped/large, Strength=day, Direction=East, Caste=royal/Kshatriya, Guna=Satvik, Rising=Shirshodaya (head), Habitation=forests, Ruler=Sun.

full_text: Virgo described: Hill-resorter. Strong in daytime. Rises with its head (Shirshodaya). Medium build. Biped sign. Resides in the South. Has grains and fire in its hands (a Virgin). Belongs to business community. Variegated in nature. Relates to hurricanes/storms. Tamasik disposition. Ruler is Mercury.

condition.subject: Virgo
condition.description: Full attribute description of Virgo (Kanya Rasi)

claim.text: Virgo: Color=variegated, Body=biped/medium, Strength=day, Direction=South, Habitation=hills, Caste=Vaishya, Guna=Tamasik, Rising=Shirshodaya (head), Symbol=Virgin with grains and fire, Ruler=Mercury.

full_text: Libra described: Rises with its head (Shirshodaya). Strong in daytime. Black complexion. Predominates with Rajo Guna. Western direction. Resorts to land. Destructive/mischievous nature. Represents Shudras (4th Varna). Medium build. Biped sign. Ruler is Venus.

condition.subject: Libra
condition.description: Full attribute description of Libra (Tula Rasi)

claim.text: Libra: Color=black, Body=biped/medium, Strength=day, Direction=West, Caste=Shudra, Guna=Rajasik, Rising=Shirshodaya (head), Habitation=land, Ruler=Venus. Symbol: a man holding scales.

full_text: Scorpio described: Slender physique. Centipede sign. Denotes Brahmins. Resides in holes/burrows. Direction is North. Strong in daytime. Reddish-brown complexion. Resorts to water and land. Has a hairy physique. Very sharp/passionate. Ruler is Mars.

condition.subject: Scorpio

claim.text: Scorpio: Color=reddish-brown, Body=centipede/slender/hairy, Strength=day, Direction=North, Caste=Brahmin, Habitation=holes/burrows/water+land, Rising=Shirshodaya, Ruler=Mars. Very passionate/sharp nature.

full_text: Sagittarius described: Rises with its head (Shirshodaya). Lorded by Jupiter. Satvik sign. Tawny hue. Strong during night. Fiery sign. Royal sign. Biped in first half; quadruped in second half. Has an even build. Adorns an arch. Resides in the East. Resorts to land. Splendorous.

claim.text: Sagittarius: Color=tawny, Body=biped(first half)/quadruped(second half)/even, Strength=night, Direction=East, Caste=royal, Guna=Satvik, Rising=Shirshodaya, Element=Fire, Habitation=land, Ruler=Jupiter. Symbol: archer with bow.

full_text: Capricorn described: Lorded by Saturn. Predominance of Tamo Guna. Earthy sign. Southern direction. Strong in nights. Rises with its back (Prishtodaya). Large body. Variegated complexion. Resorts to both forests and lands. First half is quadruped; second half is footless (moves in water).

condition.description: Full attribute description of Capricorn (Makara Rasi)

claim.text: Capricorn: Color=variegated, Body=quadruped(first half)/footless-aquatic(second half)/large, Strength=night, Direction=South, Guna=Tamasik, Rising=Prishtodaya (back), Element=Earth, Habitation=forests+land+water, Ruler=Saturn.

full_text: Aquarius described: Represents a man holding a pot. Deep-brown complexion. Medium build. Biped sign. Very strong in daytime. Resorts to deep water. Airy sign. Rises with its head (Shirshodaya). Tamasik. Rules Shudras (4th Varna) and the West. Ruler is Saturn (the Sun's offspring).

condition.subject: Aquarius
condition.description: Full attribute description of Aquarius (Kumbha Rasi)

claim.text: Aquarius: Color=deep-brown, Body=biped/medium, Strength=day (very strong), Direction=West, Caste=Shudra, Guna=Tamasik, Rising=Shirshodaya (head), Element=Air, Habitation=deep water, Ruler=Saturn.

full_text: Pisces described: Resembles a pair of fish, one tailed with the head of the other. Night-strong sign. Watery sign. Predominant with Satwa Guna. Denotes resoluteness. Water-resorter. Footless. Medium build. Rules the North. Rises with both head and back (Ubhayodaya). Ruled by Jupiter.

condition.subject: Pisces

claim.text: Pisces: Symbol=two fish (head-to-tail), Body=footless/medium, Strength=night, Direction=North, Guna=Satvik, Rising=Ubhayodaya (both head and back), Element=Water, Habitation=water, Ruler=Jupiter.

full_text: Rising method (Udaya) of signs: Shirshodaya (rises head-first) = Gemini, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Aquarius — these are strong in daytime. Prishtodaya (rises back-first) = Aries, Taurus, Cancer, Capricorn — these are strong in nighttime. Ubhayodaya (rises both ways) = Sagittarius and Pisces.

condition.subject: zodiac_signs
condition.description: Rising method (Shirshodaya/Prishtodaya/Ubhayodaya) and corresponding day/night strength classification for all 12 signs

claim.text: Shirshodaya (day-strong): Gemini, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Aquarius. Prishtodaya (night-strong): Aries, Taurus, Cancer, Capricorn. Ubhayodaya (both): Sagittarius, Pisces. Note: Sagittarius is night-strong; Pisces is night-strong despite Ubhayodaya classification — confirm from each sign's individual sloka.

full_text: Nocturnal and diurnal signs: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius and Capricorn are nocturnal (Ratri-bala) signs — strong during nighttime. Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Aquarius and Pisces are diurnal (Dina-bala) signs — strong during daytime. (From translator's notes in context of Nisheka Lagna.)

condition.subject: zodiac_signs
condition.description: Day/night strength classification of signs for use in Nisheka Lagna and chart rectification

claim.text: Nocturnal (night-strong) signs: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius, Capricorn. Diurnal (day-strong) signs: Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Aquarius, Pisces. Used for Nisheka Lagna: Adhana Lagna in nocturnal sign → birth in diurnal sign, and vice versa.

notes: Note: this classification comes from Santhanam's extended notes section on Nisheka Lagna, not from an explicit numbered sloka. The list may vary slightly from the Prishtodaya/Shirshodaya classification in rule 019 — Gemini and Pisces in particular differ. TT verify source.

full_text: Sign Gunas: Cancer, Leo, Sagittarius and Pisces are Satvik (pure). Aries, Libra, and Gemini are Rajasik (active). Virgo, Capricorn, Aquarius are Tamasik (inert). Note: Santhanam gives Satwa/Rajas/Tamas per individual sign sloka; these are explicitly stated in each sign's description.

condition.subject: zodiac_signs
condition.description: Guna (Satwa/Rajas/Tamas) assignment for the 12 signs as given in individual sign descriptions

claim.text: Sign Gunas from individual descriptions: Aries=Rajasik, Cancer=Satvik, Leo=Satvik, Virgo=Tamasik, Libra=Rajasik, Sagittarius=Satvik, Capricorn=Tamasik, Aquarius=Tamasik, Pisces=Satvik. Others not explicitly stated in these slokas.

full_text: Nisheka Lagna (Adhana Lagna — conception ascendant) formula: The duration elapsed between conception (Nisheka/Adhana) and birth equals A + B + C, where: A = angular distance between Saturn and Gulika at birth; B = difference between the ascendant cusp and the 9th house cusp (counted in direct order via 4th and 7th cusps); C = degrees the Moon has moved in her current Rasi IF the birth ascendant lord is in the invisible half (ascendant-to-descendant via nadir). C is zero if the ascendant lord is NOT in the invisible half.

condition.subject: Nisheka_Lagna
condition.description: Nisheka Lagna (Adhana Lagna / conception chart ascendant) computation formula — derives elapsed time from birth back to conception

claim.text: Nisheka Lagna computation: Elapsed time (birth-to-conception) = A + B + C. A=Saturn-Gulika angular distance at birth. B=Ascendant cusp to 9th house cusp distance (direct). C=Moon's degrees in current Rasi (only if ASC lord is in invisible half, i.e., between ASC and DSC via nadir). The result in degrees represents elapsed days (1°=1 day in Savana Mana).

full_text: From the Nisheka Lagna, one can assess effects including longevity and death of the native's parents. The ascendant prevailing at the time of coitus/conception (not just the moment of fertilization) is the Nisheka Lagna.

condition.subject: Nisheka_Lagna
condition.description: Use of Nisheka Lagna for parental longevity assessment and its specific definition

claim.text: Nisheka Lagna (Adhana Lagna) can be used to assess longevity and death timing of the native's parents. Definition: Nisheka = the ascendant at time of sexual union (coitus), not fertilization per se.

full_text: Kalapurusha body part rule: Body parts corresponding to signs occupied by malefic planets suffer defects, adversities, scars or injuries. Body parts corresponding to signs occupied by benefic planets are beautiful, strong and immune to danger.

condition.subject: planet_in_sign
condition.description: Malefic in a sign → that sign's Kalapurusha limb is afflicted. Benefic in a sign → that limb is healthy/beautiful.

claim.text: Malefic occupying a sign → corresponding Kalapurusha limb suffers defects, adversities, or injury (especially in malefic Dasa). Benefic in sign → that limb is healthy, beautiful, and protected.

full_text: The word Hora is derived from Ahoratra (day-and-night combined) after dropping the first and last syllables. Hora remains between day and night. After knowing Hora (the ascendant), the good and bad effects of a native are deduced based on the ascendant and the joining and departing of planets.

condition.subject: lagna
condition.description: Definition and importance of Hora (ascendant/lagna) in Parashari Jyotisha

claim.text: Hora = ascendant (derived from Ahoratra). The ascendant and the planets joining and separating from each other are the basis for determining all good and bad effects for the native. Sri Vishnu (time personified) has the 12 Rasis as his limbs.

full_text: Bhava Lagna computation: From Sunrise to the time of birth, every 5 ghatis (120 minutes) constitute one Bhava Lagna. Divide the birth time (in ghatis and vighatis) from Sunrise by 5. Add the quotient (in signs, degrees etc.) to the Sun's longitude as at Sunrise. The result is Bhava Lagna.

condition.subject: Bhava_Lagna
condition.description: Formula to compute Bhava Lagna (special ascendant that advances 1 sign per 5 ghatis / 120 minutes from sunrise)

claim.text: Bhava Lagna = Sun's longitude at sunrise + (birth time in ghatis from sunrise ÷ 5). Result in signs/degrees. Rate: 1 Rasi per 5 ghatis (120 min). Used with natal chart for bhava (house) strength assessment.

full_text: Hora Lagna computation: From Sunrise to birth, Hora Lagna repeats every 2.5 ghatis (60 minutes). Divide the birth time from Sunrise by 2.5. Add the quotient in signs, degrees etc. to the Sun's longitude at Sunrise. The result is Hora Lagna.

condition.subject: Hora_Lagna
condition.description: Formula to compute Hora Lagna (special ascendant advancing 1 sign per 2.5 ghatis / 60 minutes from sunrise)

claim.text: Hora Lagna = Sun's longitude at sunrise + (birth time in ghatis ÷ 2.5). Rate: 1 Rasi per 2.5 ghatis (60 min). Used for Varnada Dasa computation and wealth/intelligence assessment.

full_text: Ghatika Lagna computation: Ghatika Lagna changes with every Ghati (24 minutes) from Sunrise. Take birth time in ghatis — that number of ghatis equals that many Rasis of Ghatika Lagna. The vighatis are divided by 2 to give degrees and minutes past in that Rasi. Add this total (Rasis + degrees) to the Sun's longitude at Sunrise to get the exact longitude of Ghatika Lagna.

condition.subject: Ghatika_Lagna
condition.description: Formula to compute Ghatika Lagna (special ascendant advancing 1 sign per ghati / 24 minutes from sunrise). Per Narada and other sages.

claim.text: Ghatika Lagna = Sun at sunrise + (birth ghatis as Rasis) + (birth vighatis ÷ 2 as degrees). Rate: 1 Rasi per 1 ghati (24 min). Used for authority, power, and status assessment.

full_text: Use of special ascendants: Keeping the planets at birth as they are, prepare separate bhava charts with respect to each special ascendant (Bhava Lagna, Hora Lagna, Ghatika Lagna) and analyse as done for the natal ascendant. This yields four different bhava charts (including the natal one).

condition.subject: special_ascendants
condition.description: Method of using the three special ascendants: create a bhava chart for each and analyze independently

claim.text: Four bhava charts are assessed: (1) Natal lagna, (2) Bhava Lagna, (3) Hora Lagna, (4) Ghatika Lagna. If a planet remains in the same bhava in all four charts, it fully reveals that bhava's effects. If it changes position across charts, its effects are proportionally altered for that bhava.

full_text: Bhava cusp strength rules (from Chaukamba edition notes): A planet exactly on the cusp (Bhavasphuta) of any Lagna (natal, Bhava, Hora, Ghatika) gives FULL effects of that bhava. A planet in Bhava Sandhi (at the end/junction of a bhava) gives NO results for that bhava. A planet within 15° ahead of the Bhavasphuta (past the cusp) has diminishing effects. A planet within 15° before the cusp has proportionately increasing effects approaching the cusp.

condition.subject: bhava_cusp
condition.description: Planet-to-cusp positional strength rule — determines how fully a planet delivers its bhava effects based on proximity to the bhava cusp

claim.text: Bhava cusp strength: On cusp = 100% bhava effect. Bhava Sandhi = 0% bhava effect. Within 15° past cusp = decreasing. Within 15° before cusp = increasing toward 100% at cusp. Applies equally to all four bhava charts.

notes: From Chaukamba (Benaras) edition of BPHS. Not in all versions. Santhanam treats as authoritative.

full_text: Varnada Rasi computation — Step 1: For the natal ascendant: if it is an ODD sign, count directly (Aries=1) from Aries to the natal ascendant. If it is an EVEN sign, count in reverse (Pisces=1) from Pisces to the natal ascendant. Record this number (Product A). For Hora Lagna: apply the same odd/even counting rule. Record this number (Product B).

condition.subject: Varnada_Rasi
condition.description: Step 1 of Varnada Rasi computation: derive count numbers from natal ascendant and Hora Lagna using odd/even sign direction rule

claim.text: Varnada step 1: Odd lagna → count from Aries forward (Aries=1, Taurus=2... Pisces=12). Even lagna → count from Pisces backward (Pisces=1, Aquarius=2... Aries=12). Obtain Product A (from natal ascendant) and Product B (from Hora Lagna).

full_text: Varnada Rasi computation — Step 2: If Product A and Product B are BOTH ODD or BOTH EVEN: add them. If one is odd and the other is even: take the difference between them. The result is the final product C.

condition.subject: Varnada_Rasi
condition.description: Step 2: Combine Product A and Product B using same-class addition or different-class subtraction

claim.text: Varnada step 2: A and B same class (both odd or both even) → C = A + B. A and B different class (one odd, one even) → C = |A - B|.

full_text: Varnada Rasi computation — Step 3: If Product C is ODD, count C signs from Aries in direct order. If Product C is EVEN, count C signs from Pisces in reverse order. The resulting sign is the Varnada Rasi for the ascendant.

condition.subject: Varnada_Rasi
condition.description: Step 3: Determine the Varnada Rasi sign from Product C using odd/even direction rule

claim.text: Varnada step 3: C is odd → count C signs from Aries forward → Varnada Rasi. C is even → count C signs from Pisces backward → Varnada Rasi. Example: C=12 (even) → count 12 from Pisces backward → Aries = Varnada.

full_text: Varnada Dasa starting and counting direction: Out of natal ascendant and Hora Lagna, whichever is stronger, from there Varnada Dasa starts. If the natal ascendant is an odd sign, the counting of Dasas is CLOCKWISE (direct). If an even sign, ANTI-CLOCKWISE (reverse). Dasa years for Lagna = number of signs intervening between natal ascendant and Varnada Rasi. Similarly for other houses.

condition.subject: Varnada_Dasa
condition.description: Varnada Dasa starting point, direction of counting, and period length formula

claim.text: Varnada Dasa: Start from stronger of (natal lagna, Hora Lagna). Direction = clockwise if natal lagna is odd; anti-clockwise if even. Lagna dasa duration = count of signs from natal ascendant to Varnada (inclusive or exclusive per standard counting — to be verified). Varnada Dasa is specifically used for longevity assessment.

full_text: If a trine from the ascendant's Varnada Rasi is occupied or aspected by a malefic planet, the native will live only up to the Dasa of the said Rasi (the trine occupied/aspected by the malefic). Treat these trine-malefic planets as Rudra planets in the same manner as the Soola Dasa Rudra planet.

condition.subject: Varnada_trine
condition.description: Malefic in or aspecting a trine (1st/5th/9th) from Varnada Rasi → longevity cut to that Rasi's Varnada Dasa

claim.text: Malefic occupying or aspecting a trine from Varnada Rasi = longevity indicator. Native lives only to the Varnada Dasa of that trine's Rasi. Severity equivalent to Soola Dasa Rudra planet.

full_text: Varnada Lagna as a reference point for longevity of relatives: The Varnada Lagna is treated as the native's natal ascendant for relative longevity assessment. 7th from Varnada = spouse's longevity. 11th from Varnada = elder siblings' longevity. 3rd from Varnada = younger siblings' longevity. 5th from Varnada = sons' longevity. 4th from Varnada = mother's longevity. 9th from Varnada = father's longevity.

condition.subject: Varnada_Lagna
condition.description: Varnada Lagna used as reference for longevity of different relatives using house significations

claim.text: Longevity from Varnada Lagna: 7th = spouse, 11th = elder siblings, 3rd = younger siblings, 5th = sons, 4th = mother, 9th = father. Treat Varnada as natal ascendant and assess each relative's longevity from the corresponding house.

full_text: Soola Rasi Dasa inflicts greater evils. The Rudra planet is the one with more strength when the lords of the 2nd and 8th houses are compared. The stronger of these two house lords is the Rudra planet.

condition.subject: Rudra_planet
condition.description: Definition of Rudra planet: stronger of the 2nd lord and 8th lord by strength comparison

claim.text: Rudra planet = stronger of 2nd house lord vs. 8th house lord (by Shadbala or contextual strength). Soola Rasi Dasa (the dasa period of the Soola/Trident Rasi) inflicts the greatest evils, especially related to mortality/death.

full_text: The three special ascendants introduced in this chapter are: (1) Bhava Lagna, (2) Hora Lagna, and (3) Ghatika Lagna.

condition.subject: special_ascendants
condition.description: Named list of the three special ascendants (Visheshha Lagnas) of Parashari system

claim.text: Three Visheshha Lagnas: Bhava Lagna (advances 1 sign per 5 ghatis), Hora Lagna (advances 1 sign per 2.5 ghatis), Ghatika Lagna (advances 1 sign per 1 ghati). All three are computed relative to Sun's longitude at sunrise.

full_text: Alternative Varnada computation (suggested by some scholars): When counting from Aries, begin from zero degrees of Aries. When counting from Pisces (reverse), begin from the 30th degree of Pisces. This accounts for exact degrees of the ascendant and Hora Lagna, not just sign numbers.

condition.subject: Varnada_Rasi
condition.description: Alternative Varnada computation method that incorporates exact degree positions rather than just sign count

claim.text: Some authorities include exact degrees in Varnada computation: count from 0° Aries (not 1° Aries) for odd signs; from 30° Pisces for even signs. This gives a more precise Varnada longitude, not just a Varnada sign.

notes: Santhanam presents this as a secondary suggestion from 'one quarter' — not the primary method. Primary method uses sign count only.

full_text: A planet remaining in the SAME bhava across all four bhava charts (natal, Bhava Lagna, Hora Lagna, Ghatika Lagna) will especially and fully reveal the bhava effects due to it. A planet that changes bhava position across the charts will have proportionally altered effects for that bhava.

condition.subject: multi_chart
condition.description: Multi-chart cross-verification: same bhava position in all four charts = maximum bhava effect

claim.text: Planet in same bhava in all 4 charts (natal + 3 special lagnas) = full and special manifestation of that bhava's effects. Planet shifting bhava across charts = proportionally reduced bhava effect.

full_text: The Bhavasphuta longitudes (cusps) of Bhava Lagna, Hora Lagna and Ghatika Lagna are center-points of those lagnas, just as the natal ascendant cusp is the center of the natal lagna. The planet effect on a bhava increases as it approaches the cusp and decreases as it moves past the cusp.

condition.subject: bhava_cusp
condition.description: The computed longitude for each special lagna is the center of that bhava — gradual effect increase/decrease within 15° either side

claim.text: For all bhava charts: the Bhavasphuta is the center of the bhava. Planetary effects on that bhava increase proportionally as the planet approaches within 15° of cusp (from either side), peak at exact cusp, then decrease 15° past cusp, reaching zero at bhava sandhi.

full_text: Common base for all three special ascendant computations: All three special lagnas (Bhava Lagna, Hora Lagna, Ghatika Lagna) use the Sun's longitude at Sunrise on the birth day as the base longitude, not the Sun's longitude at birth time.

condition.subject: special_ascendants
condition.description: All three special lagnas use Sun's longitude at SUNRISE (not birth moment) as the base for computation

claim.text: Special lagna computation base = Sun's longitude at SUNRISE on the birth day. Birth time from sunrise (in ghatis) is then divided by the respective rate (5 / 2.5 / 1 ghati) and added to Sun's sunrise longitude.

full_text: Varnada Dasa is specifically used for longevity (Ayu) assessment of the native. By knowing Varnada Dasa alone, one can deal with the longevity question.

condition.subject: Varnada_Dasa
condition.description: Varnada Dasa is the primary Parashari longevity Dasa system — used exclusively for Ayu (lifespan) determination

claim.text: Varnada Dasa is a Rasi (sign-based) dasa system. Its primary and specific application is longevity (Ayu) determination for the native and relatives. Not used for general life events — only for lifespan assessment.

full_text: The 16 Vargas (Shodasavarga) as described by Lord Brahma are: (1) Rasi, (2) Hora, (3) Drekkana, (4) Chaturthamsa, (5) Saptamamsa, (6) Navamsa, (7) Dasamsa, (8) Dvadasamsa, (9) Shodasamsa, (10) Vimsamsa, (11) Chaturvimsamsa (Siddhamsa), (12) Saptavimsamsa (Bhamsa), (13) Trimsamsa, (14) Chatvarimsamsa (Khavedamsa), (15) Akshavedamsa, (16) Shashtiamsa.

condition.subject: divisional_charts
condition.description: Canonical list of the 16 Varga divisions of the Parashari system

claim.text: The 16 Shodasavargas in order: Rasi(D1), Hora(D2), Drekkana(D3), Chaturthamsa(D4), Saptamamsa(D7), Navamsa(D9), Dasamsa(D10), Dvadasamsa(D12), Shodasamsa(D16), Vimsamsa(D20), Chaturvimsamsa/Siddhamsa(D24), Saptavimsamsa/Bhamsa(D27), Trimsamsa(D30), Chatvarimsamsa/Khavedamsa(D40), Akshavedamsa(D45), Shashtiamsa(D60).

full_text: Hora (D2): Each sign is divided into two halves (Horas) of 15° each. For an ODD sign: the first half (0°-15°) is ruled by the Sun; the second half (15°-30°) is ruled by the Moon. For an EVEN sign: the first half is ruled by the Moon; the second half is ruled by the Sun. Total: 24 Horas in the zodiac (12 Sun Horas + 12 Moon Horas).

condition.subject: Hora_D2
condition.description: Hora (D2) computation: Sun/Moon Hora lordship based on odd/even sign and first/second half

claim.text: Hora D2: Odd sign 0°-15° = Sun's Hora; 15°-30° = Moon's Hora. Even sign: 0°-15° = Moon's Hora; 15°-30° = Sun's Hora. Size: 15° per Hora.

full_text: Drekkana (D3): One third of a sign (10° each). Each sign has 3 Drekkanas. The 1st Drekkana of a sign is ruled by the lord of that sign itself; the 2nd by the lord of the 5th sign from it; the 3rd by the lord of the 9th sign from it. Total: 36 Drekkanas in the zodiac, repeating thrice at 12 per round. The three Drekkanas are presided over by Narada, Agasthya and Durvasa respectively.

condition.subject: Drekkana_D3
condition.description: Drekkana (D3) computation: lords of the sign, its 5th, and its 9th are the three Drekkana lords

claim.text: Drekkana D3: Size=10° per division. 1st Drekkana lord = sign lord. 2nd Drekkana = lord of 5th from sign. 3rd Drekkana = lord of 9th from sign. This rule applies to all 12 signs uniformly.

full_text: Chaturthamsa (D4): Each sign divided into 4 equal parts of 7°30' each. The four Chaturthamsa lords are the lords of the 4 angular signs (1st/4th/7th/10th) from the sign in question, in order. Starting sign = same sign; then 4th, 7th and 10th from it. Presiding deities: Sanaka, Sananda, Kumara and Sanatana.

condition.subject: Chaturthamsa_D4
condition.description: Chaturthamsa (D4) computation: lords of angular signs (1/4/7/10) from each sign are the four Chaturthamsa lords

claim.text: Chaturthamsa D4: Size=7°30' per division. Lords = sign itself, 4th from sign, 7th from sign, 10th from sign (angular lord sequence). Applies uniformly to all 12 signs.

full_text: Saptamamsa (D7): Each sign divided into 7 equal parts of 4°17'8.57" each. For ODD signs: the 7 Saptamamsas are distributed successively from the same sign itself. For EVEN signs: from the 7th sign from it. Odd sign names in order: Ksheera, Dadhi, Ghritha, Ikshu Rasa, Madhya, Sudha, Sukhala. These are reversed for even signs.

condition.subject: Saptamamsa_D7
condition.description: Saptamamsa (D7) computation: odd sign starts from same sign; even sign starts from 7th sign

claim.text: Saptamamsa D7: Size≈4°17' per division. Odd sign: 7 divisions in successive signs from same sign. Even sign: 7 divisions from 7th sign onward. Used primarily for children/progeny assessment.

full_text: Navamsa (D9): Each sign divided into 9 equal parts of 3°20' each. For MOVABLE signs: 9 Navamsas are distributed from the same sign. For FIXED signs: from the 9th sign from it. For DUAL/COMMON signs: from the 5th sign from it. Designations repeat in cycles: for movable = Deva, Manushya, Rakshasa; fixed = Manushya, Rakshasa, Deva; dual = Rakshasa, Manushya, Deva.

condition.subject: Navamsa_D9
condition.description: Navamsa (D9) computation: movable starts from same sign; fixed from 9th; dual from 5th

claim.text: Navamsa D9: Size=3°20' per division. Movable sign: Navamsas start from same sign. Fixed: from 9th sign. Dual: from 5th sign. 9 Navamsas in successive signs. Most important Varga for marriage, dharma, and overall chart strength.

full_text: Dasamsa (D10): Each sign divided into 10 equal parts of 3° each. For ODD signs: 10 Dasamsas are distributed from the same sign successively. For EVEN signs: from the 9th sign from it. Presiding deities for odd signs: Indra, Agni, Yama, Rakshasa, Varuna, Vayu, Kubera, Isana, Brahma, Anantha. For even signs: reversed order.

condition.subject: Dasamsa_D10
condition.description: Dasamsa (D10) computation: odd sign from same sign; even sign from 9th

claim.text: Dasamsa D10: Size=3° per division. Odd sign: 10 divisions from same sign. Even sign: from 9th sign. Used for career, profession, and karmic action assessment.

full_text: Dvadasamsa (D12): Each sign divided into 12 equal parts of 2°30' each. The reckoning always commences from the same sign itself, for all signs. The 12 Dvadasamsas fall in the 12 successive signs from the sign in question. Presiding deities repeat thrice in the order: Ganesa, Aswini Kumara, Yama, Sarpa.

condition.subject: Dvadasamsa_D12
condition.description: Dvadasamsa (D12) computation: always starts from same sign, 12 successive divisions

claim.text: Dvadasamsa D12: Size=2°30' per division. All 12 signs: divisions start from same sign in successive signs (sign 1→2→3...12). Used for parents (father/mother) assessment.

full_text: Shodasamsa (D16): Each sign divided into 16 equal parts of 1°52'30" each. For MOVABLE signs: 16 Shodasamsas distributed from Aries. For FIXED signs: from Leo. For DUAL/COMMON signs: from Sagittarius. Presiding deities for odd signs: Brahma, Vishnu, Siva, Surya (repeating 4 times). For even signs: reversed.

condition.subject: Shodasamsa_D16
condition.description: Shodasamsa (D16) computation: movable from Aries; fixed from Leo; dual from Sagittarius

claim.text: Shodasamsa D16 (Kalamsa): Size=1°52'30" per division. Movable signs: from Aries. Fixed: from Leo. Dual: from Sagittarius. Used for vehicles/conveyances and material comforts.

full_text: Vimsamsa (D20): Each sign divided into 20 equal parts of 1°30' each. For MOVABLE signs: from Aries. For FIXED signs: from Sagittarius. For DUAL/COMMON signs: from Leo. 20 presiding deities for odd signs (in order): Kaali, Gauri, Jaya, Lakshmi, Vijaya, Vimala, Sati, Tara, Jvalimukhi, Sveta, Lalita, Bagalamukhi, Pratyangira, Sachi, Raudri, Bhavani, Varada, Jaya, Tripura, Sumukhi. For even signs: 20 different deities in different order (Daya, Megha, Chinnasta... etc.).

condition.subject: Vimsamsa_D20
condition.description: Vimsamsa (D20) computation: movable from Aries; fixed from Sagittarius; dual from Leo

claim.text: Vimsamsa D20: Size=1°30' per division. Movable: from Aries. Fixed: from Sagittarius. Dual: from Leo. Used for spiritual practices and religious tendencies.

full_text: Chaturvimsamsa / Siddhamsa (D24): Each sign divided into 24 equal parts of 1°15' each. For ODD signs: 24 Siddhamsas distributed from Leo. For EVEN signs: from Cancer. Presiding deities for odd signs: Skanda, Parsudhara, Anala, Viswakarma, Bhaga, Mitra, Maya, Antaka, Vrishadhwaja, Govinda, Madana, Bhima (repeating twice). For even signs: same list reversed (from Bhima/Bhishma back to Skanda), twice.

condition.subject: Siddhamsa_D24
condition.description: Siddhamsa/Chaturvimsamsa (D24) computation: odd sign from Leo; even sign from Cancer

claim.text: Siddhamsa D24 (Chaturvimsamsa): Size=1°15' per division. Odd sign: from Leo. Even sign: from Cancer. 24 consecutive signs from starting point. Used for education, learning, and academic achievements.

full_text: Bhamsa / Saptavimsamsa / Nakshatramsa (D27): Each sign divided into 27 equal parts of 1°6'40" each. Distribution by MODALITY (CONFIRMED TT-CH06-03 resolved 2026-05-31): MOVABLE signs (Aries/Cancer/Libra/Capricorn) → start at Aries (1). FIXED signs (Taurus/Leo/Scorpio/Aquarius) → start at Cancer (4). MUTABLE signs (Gemini/Virgo/Sagittarius/Pisces) → start at Libra (7). Correction: previous entry used ELEMENT-based (fire/earth/air/water) starting signs — this was incorrect. The correct distribution is modality-based per GAI resolution 2026-05-31. Bhamsa lords are the Nakshatra deities. Used for strength and vitality assessment.

condition.subject: Bhamsa_D27
condition.description: Bhamsa/Nakshatramsa (D27) computation: MODALITY-based starting sign — movable/Aries, fixed/Cancer, mutable/Libra. CORRECTED from element-based (fire/earth/air/water) — TT-CH06-03 resolved 2026-05-31.

claim.text: Bhamsa D27 (Saptavimsamsa): Size=1°6'40" per division. Starting sign by MODALITY: movable signs (Ar/Ca/Li/Cp) → Aries, fixed signs (Ta/Le/Sc/Aq) → Cancer, mutable signs (Ge/Vi/Sg/Pi) → Libra. 27 consecutive divisions from starting sign.
