claim: If Saturn and Rahu are together in a sign of Saturn (Capricorn or Aquarius) which is the 2nd from Upa Pada, the native's wife will suffer from lameness or windy disorders (vata-related conditions).
notes: Sign-conditional: must be Saturn's own sign (Capricorn or Aquarius). Saturn + Rahu in Saturn's sign = vata (wind) imbalance = lameness, paralysis, joint disorders, rheumatism for wife.

title: Rescue condition — benefic aspect/conjunction removes all wife health disorder combinations
claim: All wife health disorder combinations stated for the 2nd from Upa Pada (rules 017-025) will NOT come to pass if there is conjunction with or aspect from a benefic on the afflicting planets or on the 2nd from Upa Pada itself. Even if the affliction is caused by a benefic planet (like Jupiter in rule 023), another distinct benefic aspect/conjunction can counteract the evil.
notes: Universal rescue condition for all wife health disorder rules (017-025). Engine must check for benefic presence before triggering any of these negative health outcomes for spouse.

title: Reference points for Ch30 effects — natal ascendant, Lagna Pada, and 7th from Upa Pada
claim: All effects described in Ch30 (per Narada and others) should be deduced from three reference points simultaneously: (1) the natal ascendant, (2) Lagna Pada (Arudha Lagna), and (3) the 7th from Upa Pada. The lords of these points should also be considered. Effects from multiple reference points reinforce or mitigate each other.
notes: Meta-rule for engine: apply all Ch30 predictive rules from each of these three reference points. Convergence of all three = high confidence outcome.

title: Saturn + Moon + Mercury in 9th from reference point — no sons at all
claim: If Saturn, the Moon and Mercury are together in the 9th from one of the reference points (natal ascendant, Lagna Pada, or 7th from Upa Pada), there will be no sons at all.
notes: Three-planet specific combination for complete absence of male progeny. Reference point = any of the three per rule 027.

title: Sun + Jupiter + Rahu in 9th from reference point — many strong, valorous, successful sons
claim: If the Sun, Jupiter and Rahu are in the 9th from one of the reference points, there will be many sons. Such sons will be strong, valorous, greatly successful and will destroy enemies.
notes: Powerful progeny yoga — not just quantity but exceptional quality of sons. Jupiter = wisdom/nobility; Sun = vitality/leadership; Rahu = ambition/expansion. Sons born under this combination excel in competitive/adversarial contexts.

title: Moon alone in 9th from reference point — one son
claim: If the Moon alone is in the 9th from one of the reference points (natal ascendant, Lagna Pada, or 7th from Upa Pada), the native will have one son.
notes: Moon alone = single son. 'Alone' qualifier important — Moon with other planets shifts outcome per other rules.

title: Mixed planets in 9th from reference point — delay in getting a son
claim: If there is a mixture of benefic and malefic planets in the 9th from one of the reference points, there will be delay in obtaining a son.
notes: Delay — not permanent denial. Son comes but late in life. Mixed signals in 9th = confused/delayed progenic energy.

title: Mars + Saturn in 9th from reference point — no son, or son by adoption
claim: If Mars and Saturn are in the 9th from one of the reference points, there will be no natural son, or a son will be obtained by adoption or a brother's son will come by adoption.
notes: Three outcomes: no biological son; adoption; or brother's son raised as own. Mars + Saturn = obstructing combination for progeny.

title: Sign parity for progeny — odd sign = many sons; even sign = few sons
claim: In all cases of progeny determination from the 9th (rules 028-032), the parity of the sign in the 9th from the reference point modifies the result: odd signs (Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius) = many sons; even signs (Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces) = only a few sons.
notes: Modifier rule — applies to all progeny rules. Odd = productive/expansive; even = restrictive. This is a Jaimini system parity rule.

title: Leo as Upa Pada + Moon aspects it — limited children
claim: If Leo happens to be the Upa Pada and is aspected by the Moon, there will be a limited number of children.
notes: Leo = fixed fire sign; the Moon's fluid nature in Leo = suppresses fiery reproductive power. Few children.

title: Virgo as Upa Pada — many daughters
claim: If Virgo happens to be the Upa Pada, the native will have many daughters.
notes: Sign-specific outcome: Virgo = female/earthy/barren sign as Upa Pada = daughters predominate over sons.

title: Rahu + Saturn in 11th from Lagna Pada — elder co-born destroyed
claim: If Rahu and Saturn are in the 11th from Lagna Pada, the native's elder co-born (elder brothers and sisters) will be destroyed.
notes: 11th from Lagna Pada = elder siblings; Rahu + Saturn there = destruction/death of elder co-born.

title: Rahu + Saturn in 3rd from Lagna Pada — younger co-born destroyed
claim: If Rahu and Saturn are in the 3rd from Lagna Pada, the native's younger co-born (younger brothers and sisters) will be destroyed.
notes: 3rd from Lagna Pada = younger siblings; Rahu + Saturn there = destruction/death of younger co-born. Contrast with rule 036 (11th = elder co-born).

title: Venus in 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada — mother had earlier abortion
claim: If Venus is in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada, there would have been an earlier abortion to the mother (before or after the native's birth).
notes: Maternal history indicator. Venus in co-born houses (3rd/11th) from Lagna Pada = interrupted pregnancies in mother's life. Also applies if Venus is in 8th from natal ascendant (rule 039) or from Lagnarudha.

title: Venus in 8th from natal ascendant or from Lagnarudha — mother had earlier abortion
claim: If Venus is in the 8th from the natal ascendant or from Lagnarudha (Lagna Pada), the same effect applies: there would have been an earlier abortion to the mother.
notes: Extends rule 038. Three positions of Venus that indicate maternal abortion: 3rd from Lagna Pada, 11th from Lagna Pada, 8th from ascendant, 8th from Lagna Pada.

title: Moon/Jupiter/Mercury/Mars in 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada — many valorous co-born
claim: If the Moon, Jupiter, Mercury or Mars (any one or more) are in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada, the native will have many valorous (brave and capable) co-born.
notes: Positive co-born yoga — contrasts with Rahu+Saturn (rules 036-037) and Saturn+Mars (rule 041). Four specific planets each capable of triggering this yoga.

title: Saturn + Mars in 3rd/11th from Lagna Pada or aspecting — younger and elder co-born destroyed respectively
claim: If Saturn and Mars are in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada OR lend aspects to those houses, younger and elder co-born will respectively be destroyed: 3rd = younger co-born; 11th = elder co-born.
notes: Saturn + Mars in 3rd = younger siblings destroyed; in 11th = elder siblings destroyed. Aspect also counts — not just conjunction. Stronger version of rules 036-037 which required Rahu+Saturn.

title: Saturn alone in 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada — native spared, co-born die
claim: If Saturn is alone (without Mars) in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada, the native himself will be spared from harm but the co-born will die.
notes: Saturn alone is less destructive than Saturn + Mars (rule 041). The native survives — only co-born are affected. The qualifier 'alone' (without Mars) is critical for distinguishing this from rule 041.

title: Ketu in 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada — abundant happiness from sisters
claim: If Ketu is in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada, the native will have abundant happiness from sisters.
notes: Ketu specifically associated with sisters (female co-born) rather than brothers. Ketu in 3rd/11th from Lagna Pada = sisters are a source of joy. Contrasts with Ketu's generally malefic associations.

title: Malefic in 6th from Lagna Pada without benefic — native is a thief
claim: If the 6th from Lagna Pada is occupied by a malefic and is bereft of the conjunction or aspect of a benefic, the native will be a thief.
notes: Two conditions required: (1) malefic in 6th from Lagna Pada, AND (2) no benefic association. If a benefic is also present/aspecting, the theft combination is neutralised.

title: Rahu in 7th or 12th from Lagna Pada, or aspecting one of those — spiritual knowledge and very fortunate
claim: If Rahu is placed in the 7th or 12th from Lagna Pada, or aspects one of those houses, the native will be endowed with spiritual knowledge and be very fortunate.
notes: Rahu in dusthana-like positions (7th = maraka, 12th = loss) from Lagna Pada yet producing spiritual and fortunate outcomes. This is the classic Rahu detachment/spiritual elevation pattern in Jaimini system.

title: Mercury in Lagna Pada — lord over the whole country
claim: If Mercury is placed in Lagna Pada (the Arudha Lagna sign itself), the native will lord over the whole country — a sovereignty/dominion yoga.
notes: See also Ch29 rule 029 (Mercury in 2nd from Arudha Lagna = same outcome). This rule: Mercury IN the Lagna Pada sign = king of country. Santhanam cross-references Ch29 verse 30 for confirmation.

title: Jupiter in Lagna Pada — knower of all things
claim: If Jupiter is placed in Lagna Pada (the Arudha Lagna sign itself), the native will be a knower of all things (universal wisdom, encyclopaedic knowledge).
notes: Jupiter in Lagna Pada = supreme wisdom. Contrasts with Mercury (same position = king) — Mercury = worldly power; Jupiter = spiritual/intellectual authority.

title: Venus in Lagna Pada — poet or speaker
claim: If Venus is placed in Lagna Pada (the Arudha Lagna sign itself), the native will be a poet or eloquent speaker.
notes: See also Ch29 verse 30 (Venus in 2nd from Lagna Pada = same). Here it applies when Venus is in the Lagna Pada sign itself. The triad: Mercury=king, Jupiter=wise man, Venus=artist/speaker.

title: Benefics in 2nd from Upa Pada or from Lagna Pada — all kinds of wealth and intelligence
claim: If benefic planets occupy the 2nd from Upa Pada or the 2nd from Lagna Pada, the native will be endowed with all kinds of wealth and be intelligent.
notes: Broad wealth and intelligence indicator. The 2nd house from both Upa Pada and Lagna Pada carries wealth/speech signification.

title: Lord of 2nd from Upa Pada in 2nd house (natal) + malefic — surely a thief
claim: If the lord of the 2nd from Upa Pada is placed in the 2nd house from the natal ascendant and is with a malefic planet, the native will surely (certainly) become a thief.
notes: The word 'surely' (dhruvam) indicates strong certainty. Cross-reference with rule 044 (malefic in 6th from Lagna Pada = thief). Multiple theft combinations reinforce the prediction.

title: Rahu in 2nd from lord of 7th from Upa Pada — long and projected teeth

components.description: Find 7th house from Upa Pada; find that house's lord; find 2nd from that lord's position; Rahu must be there

claim: If Rahu is in the 2nd from the lord of the 7th counted from Upa Pada, the native will have long and projected (protruding) teeth.
notes: Physical appearance indicator. The reference chain: Upa Pada → 7th from it → lord of that 7th → 2nd from that lord's position → Rahu there. Rahu = elongation/expansion; 2nd house = teeth/mouth.

title: Ketu in 2nd from lord of 7th from Upa Pada — stammering

components.description: Same reference chain as rule 051 but with Ketu

claim: If Ketu is in the 2nd from the lord of the 7th counted from Upa Pada, the native will have stammering (speech impediment).
notes: Ketu in 2nd from lord of 7th from Upa Pada = speech defect (stammering). Ketu = confusion/discontinuity; 2nd = speech.

title: Saturn in 2nd from lord of 7th from Upa Pada — ugly appearance

components.description: Same reference chain as rule 051 but with Saturn

claim: If Saturn is in the 2nd from the lord of the 7th counted from Upa Pada, the native will look ugly in appearance.
notes: Physical appearance indicator. Saturn = constriction/dryness/darkness; in 2nd from lord of 7th from Upa Pada = unpleasant facial features.

title: Mixed planets in 2nd from lord of 7th from Upa Pada — mixed physical effects
claim: If there are mixed planets (a combination of those from rules 051-053) in the 2nd from the lord of the 7th from Upa Pada, the effects will be mixed — a combination of the individual planetary outcomes.
notes: General interpolation rule: when multiple planets from rules 051-053 are present together, outcomes blend. Engine should combine: Rahu+Ketu = long teeth + stuttering; Rahu+Saturn = projected teeth + ugly; etc.

title: Taurus as Upa Pada — many wives (from Santhanam's notes)
claim: If Taurus happens to be the Upa Pada, there will be many wives or plurality of marriage. Santhanam notes this in the commentary context alongside the Gemini-as-2nd-from-Upa-Pada rule (rule 010).
notes: This rule appears in Santhanam's notes to slokas 7-12 rather than in the translated sloka text directly. Stored as engine specification with medium confidence. Taurus = Venus's fixed sign = sensual attachment = multiple partners.

title: Argala positions — 4th, 2nd, 11th from a house or planet cause Argala
claim: Planets in the 4th, 2nd and 11th positions (counted from a house or a planet) cause Argala (planetary intervention) for that house or planet. Argala is a force of influence — it intervenes in the affairs of the bhava or planet it operates upon.
notes: Core Argala formation rule. The three primary Argala positions. Argala can be caused by benefics (Subhargala — auspicious) or malefics (Papargala — inauspicious).

title: Argala obstructors — 10th, 12th, 3rd counteract Argala from 4th, 2nd, 11th respectively
claim: Argala obstructor positions CONFIRMED (TT-CH31-01 resolved 2026-05-31, Reading A): Planets in the 10th house (from the ORIGINAL house/planet) counteract 4th-house Argala. Planets in the 12th house counteract 2nd-house Argala. Planets in the 3rd house counteract 11th-house Argala. All positions counted from the ORIGINAL reference house/planet, not from the Argala house. Example: Lagna has Argala from planet in 4th — the obstructor must be in the 10th from Lagna (not 10th from 4th). Jaimini Sutras corroborate this interpretation.
notes: TT-CH31-01 ✅ RESOLVED 2026-05-31: Reading A confirmed — obstructions counted from ORIGINAL house/planet. Verified interpretation: 10th from Lagna obstructs 4th-house Argala; 12th from Lagna obstructs 2nd-house Argala; 3rd from Lagna obstructs 11th-house Argala. Jaimini Sutras explicitly corroborate Reading A. Reading B (count from Argala position) is rejected — minority commentary view not supported by primary texts.

title: Argala prevails if causing planet stronger than obstructor
claim: If the Argala-causing planet is stronger than the obstructing planet, the Argala will prevail (the obstruction fails).
notes: Strength comparison required when both Argala and obstruction positions are occupied. Planet strength from Shadbala or contextual strength assessment.

title: Argala prevails if more Argala-causing planets than obstructors
claim: Alternatively (to the strength comparison), if the number of Argala-causing planets exceeds the number of obstructing planets, the Argala will prevail.
notes: Count-based override for strength comparison. 3 Argala planets vs 1 obstructor = Argala prevails by count, regardless of individual strengths.

title: Vipareeta Argala — 3 or more malefics in 3rd produce very effective, harmless and favourable Argala
claim: If there are 3 or more malefics in the 3rd position (from the house/planet being evaluated), they will cause Vipareeta Argala — an inverted Argala that is MORE effective as an intervention, AND is harmless AND very favourable. The obstruction becomes its own positive Argala.
notes: Vipareeta Argala is paradoxical — the 3rd is normally an obstruction position for 11th-Argala, yet 3+ malefics there produce a favourable, powerful Argala. This is analogous to Viparita Raja Yoga in conventional astrology.

title: 5th also causes Argala; 9th counteracts 5th Argala
claim: The 5th position is also an Argala place (in addition to the primary 4th, 2nd, 11th). A planet in the 9th will counteract the Argala caused from the 5th.
notes: Secondary Argala pair: 5th ↔ 9th. The 5th Argala relates to progeny/intelligence matters. The 9th obstruction corresponds. These are secondary to the primary 3 Argala positions.

title: Rahu and Ketu — Argala and obstructions counted in reverse (retrograde) direction
claim: Because Rahu and Ketu have retrograde motion, their Argalas and obstructions are counted in the reverse (anti-clockwise) direction. When computing Argala FROM Rahu or Ketu, count backwards. When computing Argala caused TO Rahu or Ketu, also count in the reverse manner.
notes: Critical engine rule for node handling. Example from text: from Rahu, 2nd house counted in reverse contains Sun-Mercury (causing Argala to Rahu), obstructed by Mars in 12th from Rahu (counted in reverse manner).

title: Argala quantity — 1 planet = limited effects; 2 = medium; 3 or more = excellent
claim: The quantity of planets causing Argala determines the strength of the Argala effect: 1 Argala-causing planet = limited effects; 2 Argala-causing planets = medium effects; more than 2 Argala-causing planets = excellent/abundant effects.
notes: This is independent of the strength comparison in rule 003. Even if individually strong, the count determines the quality of the Argala.

title: Argala counted from a sign or planet; effects in Dasha of that Rasi or planet
claim: Argala is calculated from (a) a sign (Rasi) or (b) a planet. The effects of Argala will manifest in the Dasha periods of the Rasi or planet in question. Unobstructed Argala will be fruitful; duly obstructed Argala will go astray (fail to produce results).
notes: Timing rule: Argala effects are not natal/sustained — they operate specifically in the Dasha period of the relevant Rasi or planet.

title: Quarter-degree refinement — Argala cancelled only by same-quarter obstructor
claim: The obstruction of Argala is further refined by the degree position within the sign: A planet in the 1st quarter of a sign (0°-7°30') causing Argala is cancelled ONLY by an obstructing planet in the 4th quarter (22°30'-30°) of the respective obstructive sign. Similarly, 2nd quarter Argala (7°30'-15°) is cancelled only by 3rd quarter placement (15°-22°30') of the obstructor. If the obstructor is not in the matching quarter, the Argala stands unobstructed.
notes: Highly precise quarter-degree matching rule. This significantly reduces how often Argala is actually cancelled in practice. TT-CH31-02: Verify matching for 3rd quarter Argala (15°-22°30') → should be cancelled by 2nd quarter obstructor (7°30'-15°) — not stated explicitly in text.
decode_notes: TT-CH31-02 RESOLVED 2026-06-01 via PDF (Ch31 Sloka 10, p.314). The quarter rule applies to the OBSTRUCTOR'S position, NOT the Argala planet's position. 1st-quarter Argala planet → cancelled only by 4th-quarter obstructor in the obstruction sign. 2nd-quarter Argala planet → cancelled only by 3rd-quarter obstructor. Each quarter = 7deg30'. There is NO reduction in Argala strength based on which quarter the Argala planet occupies. The text speaks of full Argala vs successful obstruction only.

title: Argala for Arudha Pada + natal ascendant + 7th from both — native is famous and fortunate
claim: If there is Argala for the Arudha Pada (Lagna Pada), for the natal ascendant, and for the 7th from both (i.e., 7th from Lagna Pada and 7th from natal ascendant), the native will be famous and fortunate.
notes: This is the comprehensive Argala yoga covering four key reference points simultaneously. Famous and fortunate = high status life outcome.

title: Unobstructed Argala (benefic or malefic) aspecting ascendant — native is famous
claim: Whether caused by a malefic or a benefic, if unobstructed Argala aspects the ascendant, the native will become famous.
notes: Fame result applies regardless of benefic/malefic nature of Argala-causing planet. Malefic Argala on ascendant = famous (possibly for negative reasons); benefic = famous for positive reasons.

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 2nd house — acquisition of wealth and grains
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 2nd house denotes acquisition of wealth and grains.
notes: 2nd house = wealth, food (grains). Argala operating on 2nd = influx of resources.

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 3rd house — happiness from co-born
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 3rd house denotes happiness from co-born (siblings).
notes: 3rd house = co-born, siblings. Argala on 3rd = good relationship with and joy from siblings.

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 4th house — residences, quadrupeds, and relatives
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 4th house denotes residences (good homes), quadrupeds (animals, vehicles), and relatives.
notes: 4th house significations: home, mother, land, vehicles (quadrupeds in classical context), comforts, relatives. Argala on 4th = positive outcomes in these domains.

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 5th house — sons, grandsons, and intelligence
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 5th house denotes sons, grandsons and intelligence.
notes: 5th house = progeny, intellect, past-life merit. Argala on 5th = blessed with children and intellectual ability.

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 6th house — fear from enemies
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 6th house denotes fear from enemies.
notes: 6th = enemies, disease, litigation. Argala on 6th activates enemy fears. Unlike other houses where Argala brings positives, the 6th retains its inauspicious signification — Argala amplifies it negatively. Benefic Argala on 6th may reduce this effect per rule 027.

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 7th house — abundant wealth and marital happiness
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 7th house denotes abundant wealth and marital happiness.
notes: 7th = spouse, partnerships, trade. Argala on 7th = dual positive: marriage happiness AND wealth (trade/commerce).

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 8th house — difficulties
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 8th house denotes difficulties (obstacles, adversity, chronic problems).
notes: 8th = longevity, hidden matters, death. Argala on 8th = difficulties manifest. Another dusthana house where Argala activates negative significations.

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 9th house — fortunes
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 9th house denotes fortunes (luck, Bhagya, father's blessings, dharma).
notes: 9th = fortune, father, dharma, higher wisdom. Argala on 9th = increased fortune.

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 10th house — royal honour
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 10th house denotes royal honour (government recognition, professional prestige, career success).
notes: 10th = career, action, government. Argala on 10th = recognition from authority/royalty. In modern context: professional honours, government appointments, public recognition.

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 11th house — gains
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 11th house denotes gains (financial gains, fulfilment of desires).
notes: 11th = gains, Labha, fulfilment of wishes. Argala on 11th = incoming prosperity. Note that 11th is itself one of the primary Argala positions — Argala ON the 11th would come from planets in the 11th's own 4th (2nd from ascendant), 2nd (12th from ascendant), 11th (9th from ascendant).

title: Unobstructed Argala aspecting 12th house — expenses
claim: Unobstructed Argala aspecting the 12th house denotes expenses (outflow of resources, losses, expenditure).
notes: 12th = expenditure, losses, foreign places, liberation. Argala on 12th amplifies 12th house significations — primarily expenses. Benefic Argala on 12th may mean auspicious expenditure (charity, spiritual activity).

title: Argala polarity — benefic Argala = happiness; malefic Argala = malefic effects but mitigated by benefic; both = mixed
claim: Argala polarity operates as follows: (1) Benefic Argala = various kinds of happiness; (2) Malefic Argala = malefic/negative effects; but benefic effects will meddle with (mitigate) malefic Argalas when a benefic is also related; (3) Both benefic and malefic Argala present = mixed results.
notes: Core polarity framework for interpreting Argala quality. Engine must check whether the Argala planet is natural benefic or malefic, then apply this 3-tier system.

title: Subhargala and Papargala — benefic and malefic Argala terminology and interaction
claim: Subhargala = Argala caused by a benefic planet. It can also be caused by a benefic that forestalls a malefic acting against the native (benefic Argala protecting against malefic activity). If the Subhargala is obstructed, the benefic becomes ineffective and the original malefic operates freely. Papargala = Argala caused by a malefic, preventing enjoyment of a benefic's good effects. If Papargala is eliminated (by benefic or malefic obstructor), the original benefic acts freely per its own disposition.
notes: Santhanam's notes to slokas 2-9½. Important for understanding the cascading effect of Argala elimination. Engine must model: (a) Argala-causing planet type (benefic/malefic); (b) what the Argala is operating on; (c) what happens if the Argala is obstructed.

title: Argala for ascendant + 5th + 9th — native doubtlessly becomes king and fortunate
claim: If there is unobstructed Argala for the ascendant, the 5th and the 9th, the native will doubtlessly become a king and be fortunate. The word 'doubtlessly' indicates certainty of this outcome.
notes: The Trikona (1st, 5th, 9th) all having unobstructed Argala = king-of-earth yoga. The 1st+5th+9th are the three Lakshmi sthanas (houses of the goddess of wealth) in classical astrology.

title: Argala applicable to Bhavas (houses) — scope includes house-level computation
claim: Argala is operable with reference to both (a) planets and (b) Bhavas (houses). When computed for a Bhava, the Argala operates on the house's significations. When computed for a planet, it operates on that planet's indications. Both computations are valid and should be evaluated separately.
notes: Explicit scope statement from Santhanam's notes. Engine must implement two Argala computation pathways: one from each natal house position, and one from each planet's position.

title: Gocharavedha parallel — Argala obstruction model is analogous to transit Vedha
claim: The Argala and its obstruction function analogously to the Gocharavedha (transit obstruction) system. Just as a planet in transit at a favourable position is nullified if another planet is simultaneously in the Vedha position, Argala is nullified by its matching obstruction position. Vipareeta Vedha (where the obstructor of an obstructor restores the original effect) also applies — analogous to Vipareeta Argala.
notes: Conceptual cross-reference only. Santhanam uses Gocharavedha tables to validate the Argala obstruction model. Not a separate computation — a confirmation of the existing framework.

title: Argala and house significations — dusthana houses retain negative signification even with Argala
claim: When Argala operates on a dusthana house (6th, 8th, 12th), the Argala amplifies the house's natural significations — which are negative (enemies, difficulties, expenses). Argala on 6th = fear from enemies (not suppression of enemies); Argala on 8th = difficulties; Argala on 12th = expenses. Benefic Argala on these houses may convert the outcome to auspicious forms of those significations (e.g., 12th: charitable expenses; 6th: victory over enemies), but the basic signification remains.
notes: Derived from the pattern in slokas 11-17 where 6th=fear from enemies, 8th=difficulties, 12th=expenses are stated without positive counterparts (unlike houses 1-5, 7, 9-11). The benefic Argala mitigation is inferred from the general rule 024.

title: Atmakaraka Definition — Planet With Highest Degrees Traversed in Its Sign
summary: The planet that has traversed the maximum number of degrees in its current sign (irrespective of which sign) is the Atmakaraka — the soul significator and most important of all Chara Karakas.
full_text: Among all planets from the Sun onwards, whichever has traversed the maximum number of degrees in a particular sign is called Atmakaraka. The Atmakaraka is the most important of the eight Chara Karakas and governs the native's soul and overarching life direction, just as a king governs his subjects and is the head of all affairs.

result.effect: Planet with highest degrees traversed in its sign = Atmakaraka. Most important Chara Karaka — governs soul and overarching life direction.

title: Atmakaraka Tie-Break — Degree Tie Resolved by Arc Minutes
summary: When two planets have identical degrees in their respective signs, the one with more minutes of arc is designated Atmakaraka.
full_text: If the degrees traversed are identical between two planets, then the one with more minutes of arc is designated Atmakaraka. This is the first tie-break rule for Chara Karaka assignment.

result.effect: Degree tie → planet with more arc minutes = Atmakaraka.

title: Atmakaraka Tie-Break — Minutes Tie Resolved by Arc Seconds; Three-Way Tie Creates Anthyakaraka, Madhyakaraka, Upakheta
summary: When both degrees and minutes are identical, the planet with higher seconds of arc is Atmakaraka. When three planets are exactly equal, the three are designated Anthyakaraka, Madhyakaraka, and Upakheta respectively.
full_text: If the minutes of arc are also identical between two planets, the one with higher seconds of arc is Atmakaraka. In the case where three planets are tied at the same degree, minute, and second, these three are called Anthyakaraka, Madhyakaraka, and Upakheta respectively — a special designation for a rare triple tie.

result.effect: Degree+minutes tie → planet with more seconds = Atmakaraka. Three-way tie → Anthyakaraka, Madhyakaraka, Upakheta designations.

title: Rahu Longitude for Chara Karaka — Deduct Position From 30 Degrees
summary: For Rahu, the longitude used in Chara Karaka ranking is obtained by deducting its actual position within the sign from 30 degrees — because Rahu moves retrograde and its effective longitude must be counted from the sign's end.
full_text: In the case of Rahu, deduct his longitude in that particular sign from 30 degrees to obtain the effective longitude for Chara Karaka ranking purposes. Because Rahu is always retrograde, it traverses a sign from the end backward; therefore, a Rahu at 8 degrees in a sign has effectively traversed 22 degrees (30 - 8 = 22) and is ranked accordingly among the eight Chara Karakas.

result.effect: Rahu's Chara Karaka longitude = 30° minus its actual position in sign. Apply this before ranking among the eight Karakas.

title: Atmakaraka Supremacy — Other Karakas Cannot Predominate Over It
summary: The Atmakaraka is supreme among all Chara Karakas. Other Karakas (Amatyakaraka, Putrakaraka, etc.) cannot override it — just as a minister cannot act against the king.
full_text: Just as a minister cannot go against the king, the other karakas (viz. Putrakaraka, Amatyakaraka etc.) cannot predominate over the Atmakaraka in the affairs of the native. The Atmakaraka holds the highest authority among the eight Chara Karakas and its condition fundamentally shapes what other Karakas can deliver.

result.effect: Atmakaraka is the supreme Chara Karaka. No other Karaka can override it in the native's affairs.

title: Adverse Atmakaraka — Other Karakas Cannot Give Full Beneficial Effects
summary: When the Atmakaraka is afflicted or adverse in the chart, the other Karakas are prevented from delivering their full beneficial effects to the native.
full_text: If the Atmakaraka is adverse (afflicted, debilitated, or ill-placed), other Karakas cannot give their beneficial effects fully. The Atmakaraka's adverse condition acts as a ceiling suppressing all Karaka-driven benefits across the chart.

result.effect: Adverse Atmakaraka suppresses all other Karakas — they cannot deliver their full beneficial effects.

title: Favourable Atmakaraka — Other Karakas Cannot Deliver Malefic Effects Fully
summary: When the Atmakaraka is strong and well-placed, other Karakas cannot fully activate their malefic influences — the strong Atmakaraka acts as a protective shield.
full_text: Similarly, if the Atmakaraka is favourable (strong, exalted, or well-placed), other Karakas cannot predominate with their malefic influences. A strong Atmakaraka provides a protective canopy that limits how much damage other Karakas' adverse placements can cause.

result.effect: Favourable Atmakaraka prevents other Karakas from fully activating malefic influences — acts as a protective shield across the chart.

title: 8 Chara Karakas — Sequence Determined by Descending Longitude
summary: The eight Chara Karakas are assigned in strict descending order of longitude (degrees traversed in sign): AK → AmK → BK → MK → PiK → PuK → GK → DK.
full_text: The planet with the highest longitude becomes Atmakaraka (AK); the next becomes Amatyakaraka (AmK); followed by Bhratru Karaka (BK), Matru Karaka (MK), Pitru Karaka (PiK), Putra Karaka (PuK), Gnati Karaka (GK), and finally Dara/Stree Karaka (DK) — the planet with the lowest longitude among the eight. This ranking determines which planet acts as the significator for each relationship in the native's life.

result.effect: 8 Chara Karakas assigned in descending longitude order: AK → AmK → BK → MK → PiK → PuK → GK → DK.

title: 7-Karaka Alternative System — Matru Karaka and Putra Karaka Treated as Identical
summary: Some authorities follow a 7-Karaka system in which Matru Karaka (mother) and Putra Karaka (children) are treated as the same planet, reducing the count from 8 to 7 Chara Karakas.
full_text: Some consider Matru Karaka and Putra Karaka as identical, yielding only seven Chara Karakas instead of eight. This school of thought is referenced by Parashara but not endorsed as the primary system — the 8-Karaka system (which includes Rahu) is the recommended approach.

result.effect: In the 7-Karaka system, Matru Karaka = Putra Karaka (same planet). Only 7 Chara Karakas assigned rather than 8.

title: Chara Karaka Tie — Two Planets With Same Longitude → Both Become Same Karaka → One Karaka Deficit
summary: When two planets have identical longitude to the second of arc, both qualify for the same Karaka position, creating a deficit of one Karaka in the chart.
full_text: If two planets have identical longitude to the second of arc, both of them become the same Karaka (e.g., both become Amatyakaraka). This creates a shortage of one Karaka in the eight-Karaka sequence. In such a case, the constant significator (Sthira Karaka) should be used for the missing relationship.

result.effect: Longitude tie → both planets = same Karaka → one Karaka rank is vacant → use Sthira (constant) significator for the missing relationship.

title: Sthira Karaka — Stronger of Sun and Venus Indicates Father
summary: For the father relationship, the Sthira (constant) Karaka is whichever is stronger between the Sun and Venus in the natal chart.
full_text: Among the constant significators, the stronger of the Sun and Venus indicates the father. If the Sun is stronger, it acts as the karaka for father; if Venus is stronger, Venus takes on this role. This Sthira Karaka assessment supplements (and in Karaka-deficit cases, replaces) the Chara Karaka for the father-relationship judgement.

result.effect: Father's Sthira Karaka = stronger of Sun or Venus in the natal chart.

title: Sthira Karaka — Stronger of Moon and Mars Indicates Mother
summary: For the mother relationship, the Sthira Karaka is whichever is stronger between the Moon and Mars in the natal chart.
full_text: Among the constant significators, the stronger of the Moon and Mars indicates the mother. If the Moon is stronger, it acts as the karaka for mother; if Mars is stronger, Mars takes on this role for mother-relationship judgements.

result.effect: Mother's Sthira Karaka = stronger of Moon or Mars in the natal chart.

title: Sthira Karaka — Mars Signifies Sister, Brother-in-Law, Younger Brother, and Mother
summary: Mars is the constant significator for sister, brother-in-law, younger brother, and also mother (in conjunction with Moon as the primary mother karaka).
full_text: Mars denotes sister, brother-in-law, younger brother, and mother as constant significators. Mars has a dual role: it signifies both the sibling group (sisters, younger brothers, in-laws) and co-signifies the mother alongside the Moon.

result.effect: Mars = Sthira Karaka for sister, brother-in-law, younger brother, and mother.

title: Sthira Karaka — Mercury Signifies Maternal Relatives
summary: Mercury is the constant significator for maternal relatives (maternal uncle, maternal family members).
full_text: Mercury rules maternal relatives as constant significator. When judging matters related to the mother's family and maternal uncle, Mercury's placement, strength, and aspects are the primary indicators.

result.effect: Mercury = Sthira Karaka for maternal relatives.

title: Sthira Karaka — Jupiter Signifies Paternal Grandfather
summary: Jupiter is the constant significator for the paternal grandfather.
full_text: Jupiter indicates the paternal grandfather as constant significator. Jupiter's placement and condition in the chart reflect the karmic and material legacy of the father's lineage.

result.effect: Jupiter = Sthira Karaka for paternal grandfather.

title: Sthira Karaka — Venus Signifies Husband
summary: Venus is the constant significator for the husband (spouse for a female native).
full_text: Husband is respectively denoted by Venus as constant significator. For female natives, Venus represents the husband's quality, character, and marital happiness. Venus's condition in the chart is the primary indicator for judging the husband in a female nativity.

result.effect: Venus = Sthira Karaka for husband.

title: Sthira Karaka — Saturn Signifies Sons
summary: Saturn is the constant significator for sons (male children).
full_text: Sons are denoted by Saturn as constant significator. Saturn's placement, aspects, and strength in the chart indicate the native's relationship with and wellbeing of sons. A strong Saturn supports sons; a weak or afflicted Saturn may indicate difficulties with male progeny.

result.effect: Saturn = Sthira Karaka for sons (male children).

title: Sthira Karaka — Ketu Signifies Wife, Father, Mother, Parents-in-Law, Maternal Grandfather
summary: Ketu is the constant significator for a broad set of relationships: wife, father, mother, parents-in-law, and maternal grandfather.
full_text: From Ketu one notes wife, father, mother, parents-in-law and maternal grandfather as constant significators. Ketu's wide karaka scope covers multiple relationship domains — it is a secondary or supplementary significator for several relationships that other planets primarily govern (e.g., Sun for father, Moon for mother), adding a karmic or past-life dimension to these relationships.

result.effect: Ketu = Sthira Karaka for wife, father, mother, parents-in-law, and maternal grandfather.

title: House From Sthira Karaka — 9th From Sun Indicates Father
summary: The 9th house counted from the Sun's position in the chart indicates the father and father-related matters.
full_text: The 9th from the Sun denotes father. When judging the father's wellbeing, longevity, or character, count the 9th house from the Sun's natal position and assess the planets and sign there. This is a derived house method that supplements the direct use of the 9th natal house.

result.effect: 9th house counted from the Sun = father's signification. Assess this derived house for father-related judgements.

title: House From Sthira Karaka — 4th From Moon Indicates Mother
summary: The 4th house counted from the Moon's position indicates the mother and mother-related matters.
full_text: The 4th from the Moon denotes mother. When judging the mother's wellbeing or character, count the 4th house from the Moon's natal position. This derived house approach is used alongside the 4th natal house for mother-related assessment.

result.effect: 4th house counted from the Moon = mother's signification. Assess this derived house for mother-related judgements.

title: House From Sthira Karaka — 3rd From Mars Indicates Brothers
summary: The 3rd house counted from Mars indicates brothers and sibling-related matters.
full_text: The 3rd from Mars denotes brothers. When judging the sibling group's condition, count the 3rd house from Mars's natal position to derive the bhava relevant to brothers.

result.effect: 3rd house counted from Mars = brothers' signification.

title: House From Sthira Karaka — 6th From Mercury Indicates Maternal Uncle
summary: The 6th house counted from Mercury's position indicates the maternal uncle and maternal-relative matters.
full_text: The 6th from Mercury denotes maternal uncle. Mercury's natal position is the starting point; the 6th house counted from Mercury indicates the maternal uncle's condition and the native's relationship with maternal relatives generally.

result.effect: 6th house counted from Mercury = maternal uncle's signification.

title: House From Sthira Karaka — 5th From Jupiter Indicates Sons
summary: The 5th house counted from Jupiter's position indicates sons and progeny-related matters.
full_text: The 5th from Jupiter denotes sons. Jupiter's natal position is the reference; the 5th house from Jupiter is the derived bhava for children/progeny judgements, used alongside the natal 5th house.

result.effect: 5th house counted from Jupiter = sons/progeny signification.

title: House From Sthira Karaka — 7th From Venus Indicates Wife
summary: The 7th house counted from Venus's position indicates the wife and marriage-related matters.
full_text: The 7th from Venus denotes wife. Venus's natal position is the reference; the 7th house counted from Venus is the derived bhava for spouse judgements, supplementing the natal 7th house.

result.effect: 7th house counted from Venus = wife/spouse signification.

title: House From Sthira Karaka — 8th From Saturn Indicates Death and Longevity
summary: The 8th house counted from Saturn's position indicates death and longevity matters.
full_text: The 8th from Saturn denotes death and longevity. Saturn's natal position is the reference; the 8th house counted from Saturn is the derived bhava for longevity and death-related judgements, supplementing the natal 8th house and the Sun's 9th for such assessments.

result.effect: 8th house counted from Saturn = death and longevity signification.

title: Yoga Karaka Rule 1 — Mutual Angles From Ascendant + Dignity = Co-Workers
summary: Two planets in mutual angular houses counted from the ascendant, and each possessing a dignity (exaltation, own sign, or friendly sign), become Yoga Karakas — co-workers that act on each other's behalf and amplify beneficial results.
full_text: If two planets are in mutual angles from the ascendant (i.e., one is in the 1st and the other in the 4th, 7th, or 10th) and both possess dignities such as exaltation, own sign, or friendly sign, they become Parasparayogakarakas — mutual co-workers. They set aside mutual enmity and act favourably on each other's behalf. Even one of them being in the 10th house makes the effects especially pronounced.

result.effect: Two planets in mutual angles from ASC with dignities = Yoga Karakas. They act as co-workers, amplifying each other's beneficial effects.

title: Yoga Karaka Rule 2 — Mutual Angles Without Dignity = NOT Co-Workers
summary: Two planets in mutual angular positions from the ascendant but lacking any dignity (not in exaltation, own sign, or friendly sign) do NOT form a Yoga Karaka relationship — angular placement alone is insufficient.
full_text: Even though the condition of mutual angularity is fulfilled, if the two planets do not enjoy one of the three required dignities (exaltation, own sign, or friendly sign), then there is no Yoga Karaka or co-worker relationship between them. Mutual angularity without dignity = no Parasparayogakaraka. The dignity requirement is non-negotiable.

result.effect: Mutual angles from ASC without dignity = no Yoga Karaka relationship. Angular placement alone does not create co-workership.

title: Yoga Karaka Rule 3 — Dignity Without Mutual Angularity From Ascendant Still Creates Co-Workers
summary: If two planets both possess dignity (exaltation, own sign, or friendly sign) but are not in mutual angular houses counted from the ascendant, they still act as Yoga Karaka co-workers.
full_text: Even though two planets are not mutually angular from the ascendant, if both are invested with dignities such as exaltation or own sign, they will mutually represent each other and become favourable in their respective Dasa periods. Dignity is the primary qualifier for co-workership; mutual angularity from the ascendant is the secondary qualifier.

result.effect: Both planets in dignity but not mutually angular from ASC → still co-workers in their Dasa periods.

title: Yoga Karaka Result — Even Mean-Born Becomes King; Effects Doubled With More Such Planets
summary: A native with one or more Yoga Karaka co-worker pairs will attain kingly status and affluence regardless of birth station. The more such planets present, the stronger the royal results.
full_text: With such Yoga Karaka planets, even a person of mean birth will become a king and be affluent. One born of royal scion then will surely become a king. The effects are to be doubled considering the number of such co-worker planets present — each additional Yoga Karaka pair amplifies the results.

result.effect: Yoga Karaka co-workers present → kingly status and affluence regardless of birth station. More pairs = amplified results.

title: Yoga Karaka — One of the Pair in 10th House Makes Effects Exceedingly Favourable
summary: When one planet of a Yoga Karaka pair is placed in the 10th house, the Yoga Karaka relationship is exceedingly potent and the native receives especially strong royal/professional results.
full_text: It is specifically stated that the 10th house position for one of the Yoga Karaka planets makes the effects exceedingly favourable. In the example chart, the Sun in the 10th with Parasparayogakaraka qualification in opposition to Saturn gives the Sun an immeasurably fortified role — by virtue of co-workership, its results are amplified far beyond what the Sun in the 10th alone would give.

result.effect: One of the Yoga Karaka pair in the 10th house = exceedingly favourable — career and royal results immeasurably fortified.

title: Yoga Karaka Rule — Not Applied From the Moon; Only From Ascendant
summary: The Yoga Karaka mutual co-worker assessment is made strictly from the ascendant. It is not applied counting from the Moon's position.
full_text: The Yoga Karaka (mutual co-worker) rule is specifically not to be considered from the Moon — only from the ascendant (Lagna). A pair of planets that are in mutual angles from the Moon but not from the ascendant do not form a Yoga Karaka relationship.

result.effect: Yoga Karaka co-worker rule applied from ascendant only — not from the Moon's position.

title: Bhava Karaka — Sun Is Significator of the 1st House (Soul, Self, Constitution)
summary: The Sun is the natural karaka (significator) for the 1st house, representing soul, self-identity, physical constitution, and the native's vitality.
full_text: The first house denotes the soul (and self), and its significator is the Sun. The Sun's condition in the chart reflects the quality of the native's soul, self-expression, physical constitution, and overall vitality. This is the Bhava Karaka assignment for the 1st house.

result.effect: Sun = Bhava Karaka for 1st house (soul, self, constitution).

title: Bhava Karaka — Jupiter Is Significator of the 2nd House (Family, Finance, Wife)
summary: Jupiter is the natural karaka for the 2nd house, representing family, accumulated wealth, and the wife.
full_text: The second house denotes wife, family, and finance, and its significator is Jupiter. Jupiter's condition reflects the native's family happiness, accumulated wealth (Dhana), and the quality of domestic life.

result.effect: Jupiter = Bhava Karaka for 2nd house (family, finance, wife).

title: Bhava Karaka — Mars Is Significator of the 3rd House (Courage, Younger Siblings)
summary: Mars is the natural karaka for the 3rd house, representing courage, physical effort, and younger siblings.
full_text: The third house denotes younger brothers/sisters and courage, and its significator is Mars. Mars's strength and placement reflect the native's courage, physical ability, and the relationship with and wellbeing of younger co-borns.

result.effect: Mars = Bhava Karaka for 3rd house (courage, younger siblings).

title: Bhava Karaka — Moon Is Significator of the 4th House (Mother)
summary: The Moon is the natural karaka for the 4th house, representing mother, home, comforts, and emotional happiness.
full_text: The fourth house denotes mother, and its significator is the Moon. The Moon's condition reflects the native's relationship with and wellbeing of the mother, as well as the quality of domestic comfort and emotional security.

result.effect: Moon = Bhava Karaka for 4th house (mother, home, comforts).

title: Bhava Karaka — Jupiter Is Significator of the 5th House (Progeny)
summary: Jupiter is the natural karaka for the 5th house, representing progeny, children, intelligence, and past-life merit.
full_text: The fifth house denotes progeny, and its significator is Jupiter. Jupiter's strength and placement indicate the native's prospects for children, the children's wellbeing, and the quality of the 5th house's promise regarding intelligence and past-life merit (Purva Punya).

result.effect: Jupiter = Bhava Karaka for 5th house (progeny, intelligence, Purva Punya).

title: Bhava Karaka — Mars Is Significator of the 6th House (Enemies)
summary: Mars is the natural karaka for the 6th house, representing enemies, debts, disease, and litigation.
full_text: The sixth house denotes enemies, and its significator is Mars. Mars's condition in the chart indicates the nature and potency of enemies, conflicts, and the native's capacity to overcome adversaries, debts, and disease.

result.effect: Mars = Bhava Karaka for 6th house (enemies, debts, disease, litigation).

title: Bhava Karaka — Venus Is Significator of the 7th House (Spouse, Conjugal Bliss)
summary: Venus is the natural karaka for the 7th house, representing spouse, marriage, and conjugal happiness.
full_text: The seventh house denotes wife and conjugal bliss, and its significator is Venus. Venus's placement and strength indicate the quality of the marriage partner, marital happiness, and the native's capacity for romantic fulfilment.

result.effect: Venus = Bhava Karaka for 7th house (spouse, marriage, conjugal bliss).

title: Bhava Karaka — Saturn Is Significator of the 8th House (Longevity)
summary: Saturn is the natural karaka for the 8th house, representing longevity, obstacles, death, and hidden matters.
full_text: The eighth house denotes longevity, and its significator is Saturn. Saturn's strength and placement are key indicators for the native's lifespan and the nature of obstacles and transformative events they will encounter.

result.effect: Saturn = Bhava Karaka for 8th house (longevity, death, hidden matters).

title: Bhava Karaka — Jupiter Is Significator of the 9th House (Fortune, Religion)
summary: Jupiter is the natural karaka for the 9th house, representing fortune, dharma, religion, guru, and higher wisdom.
full_text: The ninth house denotes fortunes and religion, and its significator is Jupiter. Jupiter's strength and dignity reflect the native's luck, righteousness, adherence to dharma, and relationship with spiritual teachers and higher knowledge.

result.effect: Jupiter = Bhava Karaka for 9th house (fortune, dharma, religion, guru).

title: Bhava Karaka — Mercury Is Significator of the 10th House (Honour, Career)
summary: Mercury is the natural karaka for the 10th house, representing honour, profession, trade, and the native's public standing.
full_text: The tenth house denotes honour, and its significator is Mercury. Mercury's condition reflects the native's professional reputation, intellectual standing, and capacity to achieve distinction in their chosen career or public role.

result.effect: Mercury = Bhava Karaka for 10th house (honour, profession, public standing).

title: Bhava Karaka — Jupiter Is Significator of the 11th House (Elder Siblings, Gains)
summary: Jupiter is the natural karaka for the 11th house, representing elder siblings (pre-born), gains, and the fulfilment of desires.
full_text: The eleventh house denotes pre-born (elder sibling), gains, and desires, and its significator is Jupiter. Jupiter's condition in the chart reflects the wellbeing of elder siblings and the native's ability to accumulate gains and fulfil aspirations.

result.effect: Jupiter = Bhava Karaka for 11th house (elder siblings, gains, fulfilment of desires).

title: Bhava Karaka — Saturn Is Significator of the 12th House (Expenditure, Loss, Liberation)
summary: Saturn is the natural karaka for the 12th house, representing expenditure, loss, isolation, and ultimately moksha (liberation). Note: Ketu is the karaka for moksha specifically.
full_text: The twelfth house denotes expenditure, and its significator is Saturn. Saturn's condition reflects the native's financial losses, foreign stays, and the general condition of the 12th house matters. However, it is noted that for final emancipation (moksha), Ketu — not Saturn — is the significator of the 12th house's liberation potential.

result.effect: Saturn = Bhava Karaka for 12th house (expenditure, loss). Ketu = karaka for 12th house's moksha dimension.

title: Bhava Karaka Note — Ketu Is Karaka for Moksha (12th House Liberation Dimension)
summary: Ketu, not Saturn, is the karaka for the 12th house's moksha (spiritual liberation) signification. Saturn governs the material/expenditure dimension of the 12th; Ketu governs the emancipation dimension.
full_text: Although Saturn is the general significator of the 12th house, for the specific matter of final emancipation (moksha), Ketu is the karaka. The 12th house has two distinct domains — material loss (Saturn's domain) and spiritual liberation (Ketu's domain). A detailed approach to the 12th house requires judging both karakas.

result.effect: Ketu = Bhava Karaka for the moksha (liberation) dimension of the 12th house.

title: Malefic Bhavas — 11th, 3rd, 8th, 6th, 2nd, 12th Houses Inflict Evils on Associated Planets
summary: The six malefic bhavas (11th, 3rd, 8th, 6th, 2nd, 12th) adversely affect planets that own or occupy them — a planet associated with these houses becomes a functional malefic.
full_text: After knowing the merits of the houses, declare good and bad effects. The six adverse bhavas are the 11th, 3rd, 8th, 6th, 2nd, and 12th. Association with these houses will inflict evils on the planet involved. A planet owning or occupying one of these six houses becomes a functional malefic and an adversary in the chart.

result.effect: Planets owning or occupying the 11th, 3rd, 8th, 6th, 2nd, or 12th house become functional malefics — these bhavas inflict evils on associated planets.

title: Benefic Bhavas — 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th, 10th Houses Turn Even Malefics Auspicious
summary: The six benefic bhavas (angles and trines: 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th, 10th) are auspicious — association with these houses turns even naturally malefic planets into beneficial forces for the native.
full_text: The auspicious bhavas are the angles and trines: 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th. The association of planets with these benefic bhavas turns even naturally evil planets into auspicious ones for that chart. A planet owning or occupying one of these six bhavas becomes a functional benefic.

result.effect: Planets owning or occupying the 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th, or 10th house become functional benefics — even natural malefics turn auspicious through association with these bhavas.

title: Malefic Bhava Association Overridden by Angle or Trine Placement — Evil Converted to Auspicious
summary: When a planet is connected to both a malefic bhava and an angle or trine, the angle/trine association predominates and converts the evil into auspiciousness.
full_text: Angles and trines are superior bhavas — the association with which turns even evils into auspiciousness. When a planet simultaneously owns or tenants both a malefic bhava (11, 3, 8, 6, 2, 12) and an angular or trinal bhava (1, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10), the angle or trine association dominates and the planet delivers net beneficial results.

result.effect: Planet simultaneously linked to malefic and angular/trinal bhavas → angle/trine dominates → net auspicious result.

title: Bhava Karaka Contextual Note — Same House Has Multiple Karakas Depending on the Matter Judged
summary: A single house can have different karakas depending on the specific matter being judged from it. The 9th house's karaka is the Sun for father, but Jupiter for fortune/religion. The 12th house's karaka is Saturn for expenditure, but Ketu for moksha.
full_text: Although each bhava has a stated significator, each bhava signifies more than what is stated and the significator can differ based on what specific matter is being judged. For example, Jupiter is the karaka for the 9th house — but when the question of father arises from the 9th house, the significator is the Sun. Or, for the 12th house: Saturn is the general significator, but for final emancipation (moksha), Ketu is the indicator. A detailed approach to signification through bhavas is required — one karaka per house is a simplification.

result.effect: Bhava karakas are matter-specific. 9th house = Jupiter for fortune, Sun for father. 12th house = Saturn for expenditure, Ketu for moksha. One karaka per house is an oversimplification.

title: Karakamsa Definition — Navamsa Occupied by Atmakaraka at Birth
summary: Karakamsa is the Navamsa sign (one of 12 divisions of the zodiac, each 3°20') occupied by the Atmakaraka planet at the time of birth. The sign of this Navamsa is the foundation of Ch33 effects.
full_text: Karakamsa is defined as the Navamsa division occupied by the Atmakaraka planet at birth. The Atmakaraka is the planet with the highest degree traversed in its sign (see Ch32). The Navamsa sign holding the Atmakaraka becomes the Karakamsa Lagna — a special ascendant from which a range of life effects are read, including the native's spiritual path, profession, health, family life, and longevity.

result.effect: Karakamsa = Navamsa sign occupied by the Atmakaraka at birth. This becomes a secondary Lagna from which Ch33 effects are read.

title: Atmakaraka in Aries Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Nuisance From Rats and Cats
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Aries Navamsa (making Aries the Karakamsa), the native experiences persistent nuisance from rats and cats. A malefic joining this position increases the nuisance.
full_text: If Atmakaraka be in Aries Navamsa, there will be nuisance from rats and cats at all times. A malefic joining will further increase the nuisance. The Aries Navamsa is associated with the animal kingdom's more troublesome members — rodents and felines — causing recurring practical disturbances in life.

result.effect: Persistent nuisance from rats and cats. Malefic joining Karakamsa in Aries Navamsa = more severe nuisance.

title: Atmakaraka in Taurus Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Happiness From Quadrupeds
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Taurus Navamsa, the native gains happiness and benefit from quadruped animals (cattle, horses, livestock).
full_text: Should Atmakaraka be in Taurus Navamsa, happiness from quadrupeds will result. The Taurus Navamsa, ruled by Venus and associated with material prosperity and earthly comforts, gives the native a fortunate relationship with cattle and other livestock — a source of wealth, nourishment, and joy.

result.effect: Happiness and prosperity from quadrupeds (cattle, horses, livestock).

title: Atmakaraka in Gemini Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Afflicted by Itch and Skin Diseases
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Gemini Navamsa, the native is afflicted by itch and similar skin conditions.
full_text: Should the Atmakaraka be in Gemini Navamsa, the native will be afflicted by itch etc. Gemini Navamsa's airy, skin-related qualities produce dermatological afflictions — particularly itching and similar surface conditions.

result.effect: Afflicted by itch and similar skin conditions.

title: Atmakaraka in Cancer Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Fear From Water
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Cancer Navamsa, the native experiences fear from water — fear of drowning, flooding, or water-related dangers.
full_text: If the Atmakaraka is in Cancer Navamsa, there will be fear from water etc. Cancer is the watery sign par excellence; the Atmakaraka here brings a persistent threat or phobia related to water, aquatic creatures, or flooding throughout the native's life.

result.effect: Fear from water, risk of drowning or water-related dangers.

title: Atmakaraka in Leo Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Fear From Tiger or Wild Animals
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Leo Navamsa, the native experiences fear from tigers or other wild predatory animals.
full_text: If Atmakaraka is in Leo Navamsa, fear will be from tiger etc. Leo, the sign of the lion and fierce predators, places the native in circumstances involving danger from wild beasts — particularly tigers, lions, or other large predators. This may manifest literally in forest regions or symbolically as fear of powerful, aggressive adversaries.

result.effect: Fear from tiger and wild animals.

title: Atmakaraka in Virgo Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Itch, Corpulence, and Fire Troubles
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Virgo Navamsa, the native is troubled by itch, corpulence (obesity), and fire-related dangers.
full_text: If the Atmakaraka is in Virgo Navamsa, itch, corpulence, and fire etc. will cause trouble. Virgo Navamsa combines skin ailments (itch), metabolic issues (corpulence), and heat-based dangers (fire) as its characteristic afflictions.

result.effect: Troubled by itch, corpulence, and fire-related dangers.

title: Atmakaraka in Libra Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Trader and Skilled in Making Robes
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Libra Navamsa, the native becomes a trader and is skillful in making robes, garments, and textiles.
full_text: In Libra Navamsa, the Atmakaraka will make the native a trader and skillful in making robes etc. Libra, the sign of balance, commerce, and fine craftsmanship, channels the Atmakaraka's energy into trade and textile-related skills.

result.effect: Trader and skilled in making robes and textile products.

title: Atmakaraka in Scorpio Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Troubles From Snakes and Affliction to Mother's Breasts
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Scorpio Navamsa, the native faces troubles from snakes and the mother suffers breast-related afflictions.
full_text: Scorpio Navamsa holding the Atmakaraka will bring troubles from snakes etc. and also affliction to mother's breasts. Scorpio, the sign of hidden dangers and transformation, links to venomous reptiles on one hand and to the mother's physical wellbeing (breasts) on the other — reflecting Scorpio's rulership over reproductive and secretive anatomy.

result.effect: Troubles from snakes; mother suffers from affliction to breasts.

title: Atmakaraka in Sagittarius Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Falls From Height and Conveyances
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Sagittarius Navamsa, the native faces danger of falls from heights and from vehicles or conveyances.
full_text: There will be falls from height and conveyances etc. if it is Sagittarius Navamsa that is occupied by Atmakaraka. Sagittarius, the sign of the archer and associated with swift movement, horses, and elevation, predisposes the native to accidents involving heights (falls) or vehicles/conveyances.

result.effect: Risk of falls from height and accidents involving conveyances/vehicles.

title: Atmakaraka in Capricorn Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Gains From Water-Dwelling Creatures, Pearls, Conch, Coral
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Capricorn Navamsa, the native gains from water-dwelling creatures and from marine products such as pearls, conch shells, and coral.
full_text: Capricorn Navamsa in this respect denotes gains from water-dwelling beings and conch, pearl, coral etc. Capricorn's association with the sea-goat and aquatic depths channels the Atmakaraka's influence toward marine-based livelihoods, trade in precious ocean products, and fishing industries.

result.effect: Gains from water-dwelling creatures and marine products (pearls, conch, coral).

title: Atmakaraka in Aquarius Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Constructs Tanks and Public Water Works
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Aquarius Navamsa, the native constructs tanks, reservoirs, or other public water-related infrastructure works.
full_text: If it is Aquarius Navamsa holding the Atmakaraka, the native will construct tanks etc. Aquarius, associated with water-carrying and communal welfare, channels the Atmakaraka's energy toward civic construction projects — particularly water-storage facilities, tanks, wells, or irrigation works that benefit the community.

result.effect: Constructs tanks, reservoirs, and public water-related infrastructure.

title: Atmakaraka in Pisces Navamsa (Karakamsa) — Final Emancipation (Moksha)
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in Pisces Navamsa, the native will attain final emancipation (moksha) — the highest spiritual liberation.
full_text: In Pisces Navamsa, the Atmakaraka will grant final emancipation. Pisces, the sign of dissolution, spirituality, and the final stages of the soul's journey, is the most auspicious Navamsa for the Atmakaraka. It indicates a soul that has completed its karmic cycle and will attain liberation from the cycle of birth and death.

result.effect: Final emancipation (moksha) — liberation from the cycle of birth and death.

title: Benefic Aspect on Karakamsa Sign — Removes Evils of That Sign's Effects
summary: A benefic planet's aspect on the Karakamsa sign removes or mitigates the adverse effects produced by that sign's karakamsa placement.
full_text: A benefic's aspect will remove evils from the Karakamsa sign's effects. Whatever negative outcome is indicated by the Atmakaraka's Navamsa sign — fear from water, snakes, wild animals, etc. — a benefic (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, or waxing Moon) aspecting that Navamsa position will reduce or eliminate the harm.

result.effect: Benefic aspect on Karakamsa sign removes the adverse effects of that sign's karakamsa indication.

title: Malefic Joining Karakamsa — Causes No Good; Intensifies Adverse Effects
summary: A malefic planet joining the Karakamsa position (alongside the Atmakaraka in the Navamsa) causes no beneficial effects and intensifies the harmful indications of that sign.
full_text: A malefic joining the Karakamsa will cause no good and will intensify adverse effects of the Karakamsa sign. For example, if Atmakaraka is in Aries Navamsa (nuisance from rats/cats), a malefic joining this position further increases the nuisance. This rule applies across all 12 Navamsa signs.

result.effect: Malefic joining Karakamsa position = no beneficial effect + intensification of the sign's adverse indications.

title: Only Benefics in Karakamsa + Benefic Aspect on Navamsa Lagna — Native Becomes King
summary: When only benefic planets occupy the Karakamsa and the Navamsa Lagna is also aspected by benefics, the native will undoubtedly become a king (person of great power and authority).
full_text: If there be only benefics in the Karakamsa and the Navamsa of Lagna and be aspected by benefics, the native will undoubtedly become a king. The double benefic influence — in the Karakamsa and in the Navamsa ascendant — creates an exceptionally powerful yoga for royal status and authority.

result.effect: Native becomes a king (person of great authority and power) — undoubtedly.

title: Benefics in Angles/Trines From Karakamsa Without Malefic Association — Wealth and Learning
summary: When the angular and trinal houses counted from Karakamsa are occupied by benefic planets without malefic association, the native is endowed with wealth and learning.
full_text: Should the angles/trines from the Karakamsa be occupied by benefics devoid of malefic association, the native will be endowed with wealth and learning. The combination of benefic and malefic in this context will yield mixed results.

result.effect: Benefics in angles/trines from Karakamsa without malefic = wealth and learning. Mixed planets = mixed results.

title: Upakheta in Exaltation/Own/Friendly Sign Without Malefic Aspect — Attains Heaven After Death
summary: When the Upakheta (a shadow planet or upagraha) is in its exaltation sign, own sign, or friendly sign, and is free from malefic aspect, the native will attain heaven after death.
full_text: If the Upakheta (upagraha — see sloka 5, Ch.32) is in its exaltation sign, or own/friendly sign, and is devoid of malefic aspect, the native will go to heavens after death. The Upakheta's dignified and unafflicted position promises a positive posthumous destination for the soul.

result.effect: Attains heaven after death when Upakheta is in exaltation/own/friendly sign without malefic aspect.

title: Atmakaraka in Moon/Mars/Venus Navamsa Division — Native Goes to Others' Wives
summary: When the Atmakaraka is in the Navamsa division of Moon, Mars, or Venus, the native will be inclined toward other men's wives (adultery tendency).
full_text: If the Atmakaraka is in the divisions of the Moon, Mars, or Venus, the native will go to others' wives. Otherwise, the contrary will prevail. The Navamsa divisions of the Moon (Cancer), Mars (Aries, Scorpio), and Venus (Taurus, Libra) when occupied by the Atmakaraka create a disposition toward liaisons with married women. In other Navamsa divisions the opposite tendency — faithfulness — prevails.

result.effect: Inclination toward others' wives (adultery tendency). Contrary holds in other Navamsa divisions.

title: Sun in Karakamsa — Royal Assignments and Government Service
summary: When the Sun is placed in the Karakamsa position, the native will be engaged in royal assignments — government service, administration, or work associated with authority and rulership.
full_text: If the Sun is in the Karakamsa, the native will be engaged in royal assignments. The Sun, as the planet of authority, kings, and government, placed in the Karakamsa directs the native's soul-force toward service to the state, administration, or positions of official authority.

result.effect: Engaged in royal assignments — government service and positions of authority.

title: Full Moon in Karakamsa — Pleasures and Scholarship; Enhanced With Venus Aspect
summary: The Full Moon in Karakamsa gives the native pleasures and scholarly ability. If Venus additionally aspects this position, both qualities are heightened.
full_text: If the Full Moon is in Karakamsa, the native will enjoy pleasures and be a scholar — more so if Venus aspects. The Full Moon's brightness and mental clarity in the Karakamsa produce a love of learning and sensory enjoyment. Venus's aspect enriches both the aesthetic pleasures and the scholarship.

result.effect: Pleasures and scholarship. Venus aspect on this position = heightened pleasures and learning.

title: Strong Mars in Karakamsa — Uses Spear, Lives Through Fire, and Is an Alchemist
summary: When strong Mars occupies the Karakamsa, the native uses weapons (spear), is associated with fire-related environments, and practices alchemy.
full_text: Should strong Mars be in Karakamsa, the native will use the weapon spear, will live through fire and be an alchemist. A strong Mars in Karakamsa channels the native's soul-force into martial arts, weapons use, heat-based processes (metallurgy, fire), and alchemical or transformative crafts.

result.effect: Uses weapons (spear), associated with fire environments, practices alchemy.

title: Strong Mercury in Karakamsa — Skilled in Arts, Trading, Intelligence, and Education
summary: When strong Mercury occupies the Karakamsa, the native is skillful in arts and trade, intelligent, and well-educated.
full_text: Should strong Mercury be in Karakamsa, the native will be skillful in arts and trading, intelligent, and educated. Mercury's intellectual and commercial qualities channeled through the Karakamsa produce a versatile, sharp-minded native who excels in both artistic pursuits and commercial dealings.

result.effect: Skillful in arts and trading, intelligent, well-educated.

title: Jupiter in Karakamsa — Good Acts, Spiritualism, and Vedic Learning
summary: When Jupiter occupies the Karakamsa, the native performs good deeds, is endowed with spiritualism, and has deep Vedic learning.
full_text: Jupiter in Karakamsa denotes one doing good acts, endowed with spiritualism and Vedic learning. Jupiter's dharmic and expansive qualities in the Karakamsa orient the native's soul toward righteousness, spiritual knowledge, and study of the Vedas and sacred texts.

result.effect: Performs good acts, endowed with spiritualism and Vedic learning.

title: Venus in Karakamsa — 100-Year Longevity, Sensuous Nature, and State Affairs
summary: When Venus occupies the Karakamsa, the native enjoys a 100-year lifespan, is sensuous, and is involved in state affairs.
full_text: One will be endowed with a longevity of 100 years, be sensuous, and will look after state affairs if Venus is in Karakamsa. Venus's life-giving, pleasurable, and socially refined qualities in the Karakamsa produce an exceptionally long-lived, pleasure-oriented native who participates in governance or public administration.

result.effect: Longevity of 100 years, sensuous nature, involvement in state affairs and governance.

title: Saturn in Karakamsa — Livelihood Follows Family Tradition
summary: When Saturn occupies the Karakamsa, the native will earn a livelihood in the same manner as is traditional or customary in his family.
full_text: Saturn in Karakamsa will give such livelihood as due to the native's family. Saturn as the karaka of continuity, duty, and legacy ensures that the native follows the hereditary occupation or family trade rather than innovating a new path. The profession is thus ancestral and stable, if conservative.

condition.notes: house = karakamsa (Navamsa sign of Atmakaraka)

result.effect: Native follows family tradition/hereditary occupation in livelihood.

title: Rahu in Karakamsa — Thief, Bowman, Machinery Maker, Poison Doctor
summary: When Rahu occupies the Karakamsa, the native is associated with one or more of: theft, archery/weaponry, mechanical engineering, or the medical treatment of poisonous afflictions.
full_text: Rahu in Karakamsa denotes a thief, a bowman, a machinery maker, and a doctor treating poisonous afflictions. Rahu is a karaka for foreign, unconventional, and dangerous matters. In Karakamsa, he manifests as one who operates outside normal bounds — whether through theft, weapons, heavy machinery, or dealing with toxic substances. Multiple career dimensions may apply simultaneously.

condition.notes: house = karakamsa (Navamsa sign of Atmakaraka)

result.effect: Thief, bowman/weapons handler, machinery maker, or doctor treating poison-related ailments.

title: Ketu in Karakamsa — Deals in Elephants and Inclined to Theft
summary: When Ketu occupies the Karakamsa, the native will deal in elephants (trade/handling of large animals or related goods) and also tends toward theft.
full_text: If Ketu be in Karakamsa, one will deal in elephants and be a thief. Ketu as karaka for moksha, elephants (in some traditions), and unconventional behaviour places the native in proximity to large animals and/or covert activities. The elephant trade in ancient India was a royal and mercantile vocation; Ketu here thus also connects to prestige through animal dealings.

condition.notes: house = karakamsa (Navamsa sign of Atmakaraka)

result.effect: Deals in elephants (large animals/related goods); also inclined to theft.

title: Rahu and Sun in Karakamsa — Fear From Snakes
summary: When both Rahu and the Sun are in the Karakamsa together, the native will experience fear from snakes.
full_text: Should Rahu and the Sun be in Karakamsa, there will be fear from snakes. Rahu has a natural association with serpents (he is the severed serpent body in mythology), and the Sun in combination intensifies the threat. The base effect is a sustained fear or danger from serpents — which may be literal or may extend to venomous/dangerous encounters.

condition.notes: Both Rahu and Sun in Karakamsa

result.effect: Fear from snakes; danger from serpents.

title: Rahu and Sun in Karakamsa — Benefic Aspect Removes Snake Fear
summary: When Rahu and the Sun are in Karakamsa and a benefic planet aspects this combination, the fear from snakes (rule 029) is negated — no such fear will manifest.
full_text: If a benefic aspects the Rahu-Sun combination in Karakamsa, there will be no fear from snakes. A benefic aspect (from Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, or waxing Moon) acts as a protective shield, overriding the malefic snake-fear indicated by the Rahu-Sun conjunction in the Karakamsa. This is a direct modification of rule 029.

condition.notes: Benefic aspects Rahu+Sun in Karakamsa — negates snake fear

result.effect: No fear from snakes; benefic aspect removes the snake-danger of Rahu-Sun in Karakamsa.

title: Rahu and Sun in Karakamsa — Malefic Aspect Causes Death Through Serpents
summary: When Rahu and the Sun are in Karakamsa and a malefic planet aspects this combination, the snake fear escalates to actual death caused by serpents.
full_text: A malefic aspect on the Rahu-Sun combination in Karakamsa will bring death through serpents. Where a benefic aspect (rule 030) removes the danger, a malefic aspect (from Saturn, Mars, or other malefics) intensifies the Rahu-Sun combination to its worst expression — actual death from snake bite or serpentine venom. This is the most severe form of rule 029.

condition.notes: Malefic aspects Rahu+Sun in Karakamsa — death through serpents

result.effect: Death caused by serpents/snake bite.

title: Rahu and Sun in Benefic Shadvargas in Karakamsa — Doctor Treating Poison Afflictions
summary: When Rahu and the Sun are in Karakamsa AND occupy benefic Shadvargas (6 divisional charts), the native becomes a doctor who treats poisonous afflictions.
full_text: If Rahu and the Sun occupy benefic Shadvargas, being in Karakamsa, one will be a doctor treating poisonous afflictions. The Shadvargas are six key divisional charts (Rasi, Hora, Drekkana, Navamsa, Dwadashamsa, Trimshamsa). When Rahu and Sun are well-placed in these divisions, the dangerous Rahu-serpent energy is transmuted into healing — specifically, expertise in treating venomous and toxic conditions.

condition.notes: Rahu+Sun in Karakamsa AND in benefic Shadvargas

result.effect: Doctor specialising in treatment of poisonous afflictions and toxic conditions.

title: Rahu and Sun in Karakamsa — Mars Aspect Causes House Burning
summary: When Rahu and the Sun are in the Karakamsa and Mars aspects this combination, the native will burn either his own house or the house of others.
