full_text: The aspect from Mars on the Rahu-Sun combination in Karakamsa denotes that the native will burn either his own house or that of others. Mars as karaka of fire, aggression, and destruction combined with Rahu (smoke, sudden events) and the Sun (fire) creates an explosive configuration that manifests as arson or accidental house fire — involving the native's own dwelling or property belonging to others.

condition.notes: Rahu+Sun in Karakamsa with Mars aspect

result.effect: Burning of own house or house of others — arson or fire accident.

title: Rahu and Sun in Karakamsa — Mercury Aspect Does Not Cause House Burning
summary: When Mercury aspects the Rahu-Sun combination in Karakamsa instead of Mars, the house-burning effect (rule 033) does not occur.
full_text: Mercury's aspect, instead of that of Mars, will not cause the house-burning effects. Mercury is an intellectual, neutral planet without Mars's fiery, destructive energy. His aspect on Rahu-Sun in Karakamsa does not produce the conflagration that Mars would. This rule is a direct negation/exception to rule 033.

condition.notes: Mercury aspect on Rahu+Sun in Karakamsa — negates house-burning

result.effect: House-burning does not occur; Mercury aspect negates the Mars-arson outcome.

title: Rahu and Sun in Karakamsa in Malefic Sign — Jupiter Aspect Causes Burning Neighbour's House
summary: When Rahu and the Sun are in Karakamsa, placed in a malefic's sign, and Jupiter aspects this combination, the native will burn a neighbouring house.
full_text: If Rahu and the Sun be in Karakamsa and be in a malefic's sign in aspect to Jupiter, one will burn a neighbouring house. The combination of Rahu-Sun in a malefic's sign (owned by Saturn, Mars, or Rahu/Ketu) with Jupiter's expansive aspect creates a specific arson outcome — directed at a neighbour's property rather than one's own.

condition.notes: Rahu+Sun in Karakamsa in a malefic's sign with Jupiter aspect

result.effect: Burns a neighbouring house — arson or fire incident involving neighbour's property.

title: Rahu and Sun in Karakamsa in Malefic Sign — Venus Aspect Does Not Cause House Burning
summary: When Rahu and the Sun are in Karakamsa in a malefic sign and Venus aspects this combination, the burning of a neighbouring house (rule 035) does not occur.
full_text: The aspect of Venus will not cause such an event (burning neighbouring house). Venus, as a benefic karaka of comfort and harmony, counteracts the destructive fire energy of Rahu-Sun in malefic signs. This is a direct negation of the Jupiter-aspect scenario in rule 035.

condition.notes: Venus aspect on Rahu+Sun in Karakamsa in malefic sign — negates neighbour house-burning

result.effect: Burning of neighbouring house does not occur; Venus aspect negates the fire outcome.

title: Full Moon Aspects Gulika in Karakamsa — Loss of Wealth to Thieves or Becomes a Thief
summary: When Gulika is in the Karakamsa and the Full Moon aspects Gulika, the native either loses his wealth to thieves or will himself become a thief.
full_text: Should the Full Moon aspect the Karakamsa-placed Gulika, the native will lose his wealth to thieves or will himself be a thief. Gulika (son of Saturn) is an upagraha associated with poison, misfortune, and malefic energy. When the Full Moon — normally benefic — aspects Gulika in the Karakamsa, it activates this sinister energy, producing either victimisation by thieves (wealth loss) or participation in theft.

condition.notes: Gulika in Karakamsa, aspected by Full Moon

result.effect: Loses wealth to thieves OR becomes a thief.

title: Gulika in Karakamsa Unaspected — Administers Poison or Dies From Poisoning
summary: When Gulika is in the Karakamsa and is unaspected by any other planet, the native will either administer poison to others or will die from poisoning himself.
full_text: If Gulika is in Karakamsa but is unaspected by others, one will administer poison to others or will himself die of poisoning. Gulika's inherent poison nature, when unchecked by any planetary aspect (even malefic ones), expresses itself in its most unmediated form: either the native poisons others or is himself poisoned — with fatal or near-fatal consequences. Mercury's aspect alone modifies this, per the next rule.

condition.notes: Gulika in Karakamsa with no planetary aspects

result.effect: Administers poison to others OR dies from poisoning.

title: Gulika in Karakamsa — Mercury Aspect Gives Large Testicles
summary: When Gulika is in the Karakamsa and Mercury aspects Gulika, the native will have abnormally large testicles (physical anomaly).
full_text: Mercury's aspect in this context (Gulika in Karakamsa) will give large testicles. Mercury as karaka of the nervous system and subtle body pathways, when aspecting the upagraha Gulika, redirects the Gulika energy away from poison/theft (rules 037-038) into an unusual physical manifestation — enlarged reproductive glands. This is a body-level expression of Gulika's Saturnian heaviness.

condition.notes: Gulika in Karakamsa, Mercury aspects Gulika

result.effect: Abnormally large testicles (physical anomaly at birth or developing).

title: Ketu in Karakamsa — Malefic Aspect Causes Ear Mutilation or Ear Disease
summary: When Ketu is in the Karakamsa and a malefic aspects Ketu, the native's ears will be severed/mutilated or he will suffer from serious ear diseases.
full_text: If Ketu is in Karakamsa in aspect of a malefic, one's ears will be severed or he will suffer from diseases of ears. Ketu is a karaka for the ears in classical Jyotish. A malefic aspect on Ketu in Karakamsa directs this Ketu-ear association toward physical damage (amputation of ears — a classical punishment in ancient India) or persistent ear pathology.

condition.notes: Ketu in Karakamsa with malefic aspect

result.effect: Ears severed/mutilated or chronic ear diseases.

title: Ketu in Karakamsa — Venus Aspect Initiates Native Into Religious Order
summary: When Ketu is in the Karakamsa and Venus aspects Ketu, the native will be initiated into a religious order (becomes a monk, sannyasi, or religious initiate).
full_text: Venus aspecting Ketu in Karakamsa denotes one initiated into a religious order. Venus as karaka of love and devotion combined with Ketu (moksha, renunciation) in the Karakamsa produces a spiritually ordained life — the native enters a monastic or initiate tradition. The combination of Venus's devotional quality with Ketu's otherworldly renunciation leads to formal religious vows.

condition.notes: Ketu in Karakamsa with Venus aspect

result.effect: Initiated into a religious order — monastic vows, formal religious initiation.

title: Ketu in Karakamsa — Mercury and Saturn Aspect Causes Devoid of Strength
summary: When Ketu is in the Karakamsa and both Mercury and Saturn aspect Ketu together, the native will be devoid of physical or inner strength.
full_text: One will be devoid of strength if Mercury and Saturn aspect Ketu in Karakamsa. Mercury (nervous system, intellect) combined with Saturn (restriction, depletion) both aspecting Ketu (dissolution, withdrawal) in the Karakamsa creates a configuration of systemic weakening — the native lacks the vitality, courage, or physical power expected of his position. This is a constitutional weakness rather than an acute illness.

condition.notes: Ketu in Karakamsa with Mercury AND Saturn both aspecting

result.effect: Devoid of strength — constitutionally weak in body or vital energy.

title: Ketu in Karakamsa — Mercury and Venus Aspect Indicates Son of Female Slave or Remarried Woman
summary: When Ketu is in the Karakamsa and both Mercury and Venus aspect Ketu, the native will be the son of a female slave or of a woman who has remarried.
full_text: With Mercury and Venus aspecting Ketu in Karakamsa, he will be the son of a female slave or of a female remarried. This rule speaks to birth lineage and social status at origin. Mercury's duality and Venus's sensual nature combined with Ketu (past-karma, ambiguous origins) in the Karakamsa indicates a birth circumstance where the mother was socially disadvantaged (enslaved or remarried, thus of uncertain lineage). This may affect the native's social standing and self-identity.

condition.notes: Ketu in Karakamsa with Mercury AND Venus both aspecting

result.effect: Son of a female slave or of a woman who has remarried — ambiguous or low-status birth lineage.

title: Ketu in Karakamsa — Saturn Aspect Causes Penance, Servitude, or False Asceticism
summary: When Ketu is in the Karakamsa and Saturn alone aspects Ketu, the native will perform penance, be a servant, or will be a pseudo-ascetic (one who outwardly appears an ascetic but is not).
full_text: With Saturn's aspect on Ketu in Karakamsa, one will perform penance or be a servant or will be a pseudo-ascetic. Saturn as karaka of hard work, servitude, and renunciation combined with Ketu (spiritual withdrawal) creates a forced or inauthentic spiritual/service path. The native may undergo penance (austerities) voluntarily, or be pressed into service as a subordinate, or adopt the outward guise of an ascetic without genuine realisation.

condition.notes: Ketu in Karakamsa with Saturn aspect only

result.effect: Performs penance/austerities, works as a servant, or is a pseudo-ascetic (pretends to be a renunciant).

title: Ketu in Karakamsa — Venus and Sun Together Aspecting Causes Service to the King
summary: When Ketu is in the Karakamsa and both Venus and the Sun together aspect Ketu, the native will serve the king (or state/government authority).
full_text: Venus and the Sun together aspecting Ketu in Karakamsa will make one serve the king. The Sun (royalty, government, authority) and Venus (diplomacy, luxury, statecraft) together aspecting Ketu (detachment, service) in the Karakamsa creates a configuration of devoted, loyal service to those in power. The native becomes a functionary or officer in royal/governmental service.

condition.notes: Ketu in Karakamsa with Venus AND Sun together aspecting

result.effect: Serves the king or government — royal/state service career.

title: 2nd From Karakamsa in Venus or Mars Division — Addiction to Others' Wives
summary: When the 2nd house from the Karakamsa falls in a Navamsa division belonging to Venus or Mars, the native will be addicted to other men's wives (extramarital involvement).
full_text: If the 2nd from Karakamsa falls in the divisions of Venus/Mars, one will be addicted to others' wives. The 2nd from Karakamsa represents accumulated desires and acquisitions arising from the Karakamsa Lagna. When this 2nd falls in a division of Venus (desire, women) or Mars (passion, conquest), the native's acquisitive desire is directed toward the wives/women of others. This is a sustained natal disposition.

condition.notes: 2nd from Karakamsa falls in Venus or Mars Navamsa division

result.effect: Addiction to other men's wives — persistent extramarital desires.

title: Venus or Mars Aspecting the 2nd From Karakamsa — Addiction to Others' Wives Persists Till Death
summary: When Venus or Mars aspects the 2nd house from the Karakamsa (in addition to or instead of it falling in their division), the addiction to other women persists throughout the native's entire lifetime.
full_text: If Venus or Mars aspect the said 2nd (from Karakamsa), the tendency will last till death. The aspect of Venus or Mars on the 2nd from Karakamsa converts the natal disposition (rule 046) into a lifelong and unresolvable pattern. The native will pursue others' wives until the end of his life — reinforced by the planetary aspect's constant influence on the 2nd house Karakamsa.

condition.notes: Venus or Mars aspects the 2nd from Karakamsa — addiction persists till death

result.effect: Addiction to others' wives persists throughout the native's lifetime — unabated till death.

title: Ketu in 2nd From Karakamsa in Venus or Mars Division — No Addiction to Others' Wives
summary: When Ketu is in the 2nd from Karakamsa placed in a division of Venus or Mars, the addiction to other men's wives does NOT prevail — the usual Venus/Mars result is negated.
full_text: If Ketu is the 2nd from Karakamsa in a division of Venus/Mars, such addiction will not prevail. Ketu's presence in this position — even in a division that would normally trigger the Venus/Mars adultery pattern — overrides the sensual drive with renunciation, detachment, or abstinence. Ketu's nature of withdrawal and spiritual withdrawal neutralises the carnal pull of the Venus/Mars divisional placement.

condition.notes: Ketu in the 2nd from Karakamsa, in a Venus or Mars Navamsa division

result.effect: No addiction to other men's wives — Ketu's detachment negates the Venus/Mars pull.

title: Jupiter in 2nd From Karakamsa (in Venus or Mars Division) — Causes Addiction to Others' Wives
summary: When Jupiter is in the 2nd from Karakamsa (in a division of Venus or Mars), the native WILL have the adultery addiction — Jupiter's presence here causes this evil rather than preventing it.
full_text: The position of Jupiter (in the 2nd from Karakamsa in a Venus/Mars division) will cause such an evil. Unexpectedly, Jupiter's placement here produces the undesirable outcome of addiction to others' wives. Jupiter's expansive nature in a sensually charged position (Venus/Mars division) at the 2nd from Karakamsa amplifies the desire rather than restraining it — this is a counter-intuitive result that highlights Jupiter's dual role as an expansive principle.

condition.notes: Jupiter in 2nd from Karakamsa in Venus or Mars division — causes adultery inclination

result.effect: Addiction to other men's wives — Jupiter in this position causes the adultery tendency.

title: Rahu in 2nd From Karakamsa — Destroys Wealth
summary: When Rahu is in the 2nd house from the Karakamsa, the native's accumulated wealth is destroyed.
full_text: Rahu in the said (2nd from Karakamsa) case will destroy wealth. The 2nd from Karakamsa governs the native's accumulated assets and material gains arising from the Karakamsa Lagna. Rahu's disruptive, eclipsing energy in this position swallows up wealth — through sudden losses, illusions, foreign drain, or unconventional spending patterns that ultimately deplete the native's financial base.

condition.notes: Rahu in 2nd from Karakamsa

result.effect: Wealth is destroyed — financial losses and depletion of accumulated assets.

title: Malefic in 3rd From Karakamsa — Native is Valorous
summary: When a malefic planet occupies the 3rd house from the Karakamsa, the native will be valorous, courageous, and bold.
full_text: A malefic in the 3rd from Karakamsa will make one valorous. The 3rd house governs courage, siblings, and effort. A malefic here charges the 3rd with fighting energy — the native becomes daring, combative, and courageous. This is the classic beneficial placement of malefics in the 3rd (upachaya house), here applied from the Karakamsa Lagna.

condition.notes: Any malefic in 3rd from Karakamsa

result.effect: Valorous — bold, courageous, and combative by nature.

title: Benefic in 3rd From Karakamsa — Native is Timid
summary: When a benefic planet occupies the 3rd house from the Karakamsa, the native will be timid, cowardly, or lacking in boldness.
full_text: A benefic in the 3rd from Karakamsa will make one timid. This is consistent with classical Jyotish doctrine where benefics in the 3rd weaken courage rather than strengthen it (unlike malefics in the 3rd which are considered good). From the Karakamsa Lagna, a benefic in the 3rd softens the native's will to fight and produces a timid, risk-averse character.

condition.notes: Any benefic in 3rd from Karakamsa

result.effect: Timid — lacking courage and boldness; risk-averse nature.

title: Venus and Moon in 4th From Karakamsa — Palatial Residence
summary: When Venus and the Moon are together in the 4th house from the Karakamsa, the native will own palatial or large, luxurious buildings.
full_text: If the 4th from Karakamsa be occupied by Venus and the Moon, one will own palatial (or large) buildings. Venus as karaka of beauty, luxury, and fine living, combined with the Moon (karaka of the 4th house of home and comfort) in the 4th from Karakamsa, creates an ideal configuration for magnificent residential wealth. The native will live in and own grand, palatial homes.

condition.notes: Venus and Moon together in 4th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Owns palatial, large, or luxurious buildings/residences.

title: Exalted Planet in 4th From Karakamsa — Palatial Residence
summary: When an exalted planet occupies the 4th house from the Karakamsa, the native will similarly own palatial or large buildings.
full_text: Similar is the effect of an exalted planet in the said 4th (from Karakamsa). Any planet in exaltation in the 4th from Karakamsa replicates the palatial-home result of Venus-Moon. The exaltation dignifies the 4th house from the Karakamsa Lagna, indicating the native's residence is grand and impressive, regardless of which specific planet is exalted there.

condition.notes: Any exalted planet in 4th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Owns palatial or large buildings — exaltation in 4th from Karakamsa grants grand residence.

title: Rahu and Saturn in 4th From Karakamsa — House Made of Stone
summary: When Rahu and Saturn are in the 4th house from the Karakamsa, the native's house will be made of stone.
full_text: A house made of stones is denoted by the occupation of Rahu and Saturn in the 4th from Karakamsa. Saturn and Rahu both carry associations with hardness, weight, earth, and endurance. Their presence in the 4th from Karakamsa specifies the building material of the native's dwelling — stone, which is cold, heavy, durable, and ancient. This is a material descriptor for the residential environment.

condition.notes: Rahu and Saturn together in 4th from Karakamsa

result.effect: House made of stone — native lives in a stone-constructed dwelling.

title: Mars and Ketu in 4th From Karakamsa — House Made of Brick
summary: When Mars and Ketu are in the 4th house from the Karakamsa, the native's house will be made of bricks.
full_text: Mars and Ketu indicate a house made of bricks in the 4th from Karakamsa. Mars is associated with fired material and kiln-baked substances; Ketu with rough, earthy, or unconventional materials. Together in the 4th from Karakamsa they specify a brick-built dwelling — sturdy but not palatial. Brick (fired clay) is a step up from grass or wood but below stone or marble.

condition.notes: Mars and Ketu together in 4th from Karakamsa

result.effect: House made of bricks — native lives in a brick-built dwelling.

title: Jupiter in 4th From Karakamsa — House Made of Wood
summary: When Jupiter is in the 4th house from the Karakamsa, the native's house will be made of wood.
full_text: Jupiter denotes one (living in a house) made of wood when in the 4th from Karakamsa. Jupiter governs trees, forests, and abundance of natural materials. A wooden house in classical times indicated a comfortable but natural dwelling — neither the grandeur of stone nor the poverty of grass. Jupiter brings a wholesome, nature-connected residential environment.

condition.notes: Jupiter in 4th from Karakamsa

result.effect: House made of wood — native lives in a timber-built dwelling.

title: Sun in 4th From Karakamsa — House Made of Grass or Thatched Roof
summary: When the Sun is in the 4th house from the Karakamsa, the native's house will be made of grass — a thatched or humble dwelling.
full_text: The Sun so related (in 4th from Karakamsa) will give a house of grass. The Sun, despite being the king of planets, in the 4th from Karakamsa indicates the humblest type of dwelling — grass-thatched or simple agricultural shelter. In classical context, a grass house represents the hermit/brahmana lifestyle where material comfort is deliberately minimal. The Sun here confers solar fire but minimal worldly residential luxury.

condition.notes: Sun in 4th from Karakamsa

result.effect: House made of grass — humble, thatched, or minimally constructed dwelling.

title: Moon in 4th From Karakamsa — Union With Wife in Uncompounded (Open) House
summary: When the Moon is in the 4th house from the Karakamsa, the native will have conjugal union with his wife in an uncompounded or open house — lacking proper walls or enclosure.
full_text: If the Moon be in the 4th from Karakamsa, one will have union with his wife in an uncompounded house. The Moon in the 4th from Karakamsa indicates a domestic environment without proper enclosure — an uncompounded house (without a compound wall or boundary). This suggests either social poverty, a rural setting, or a dwelling that lacks the privacy associated with walled homes. The conjugal intimacy takes place in an exposed setting.

condition.notes: Moon in 4th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Conjugal life conducted in an uncompounded/open house — lack of residential privacy.

title: Rahu and Mars in 5th From Karakamsa — Pulmonary Consumption (Tuberculosis)
summary: When Rahu and Mars are together in the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will suffer from pulmonary consumption (tuberculosis or chronic lung disease).
full_text: If Rahu and Mars are in the 5th from Karakamsa, one will suffer from a pulmonary consumption. Rahu is associated with hidden/chronic ailments and respiratory system weaknesses; Mars governs the blood and inflammatory conditions. Together in the 5th from Karakamsa they produce a consumptive lung disease — the classical 'rajayakshma' or TB-type illness characterised by wasting and respiratory failure.

condition.notes: Rahu and Mars together in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Pulmonary consumption — chronic lung disease (tuberculosis-type wasting illness).

title: Moon Aspects Rahu and Mars in 5th From Karakamsa — Pulmonary Consumption Made Certain
summary: When Rahu and Mars are in the 5th from Karakamsa AND the Moon aspects this combination, the pulmonary consumption affliction is made certain (guaranteed to manifest).
full_text: More so if the Moon aspects them (Rahu and Mars in 5th from Karakamsa), the pulmonary consumption will be certain. The Moon's aspect on the Rahu-Mars combination in the 5th from Karakamsa removes any doubt about the consumption affliction — it becomes an assured outcome rather than a possibility. The Moon's emotional/fluid nature may aggravate the respiratory condition further through damp-cold phlegmatic factors.

condition.notes: Rahu+Mars in 5th from Karakamsa with Moon aspect — consumption is certain

result.effect: Pulmonary consumption is certain — Moon's aspect confirms the lung disease manifestation.

title: Mars Aspect on 5th From Karakamsa — Boils and Ulcers
summary: When Mars aspects the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will suffer from boils or ulcers.
full_text: The aspect of Mars on the said house (5th from Karakamsa) will bring boils or ulcers. Mars as karaka of blood, skin inflammation, and surgical conditions, when aspecting the 5th from Karakamsa, produces cutaneous eruptions — boils (abscesses), ulcers, or inflammatory skin lesions. This is Mars's characteristic heat-based affliction applied from the Karakamsa Lagna.

condition.notes: Mars aspects the 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Boils or ulcers — inflammatory skin eruptions and ulcerations.

title: Ketu Aspect on 5th From Karakamsa — Dysentery and Water-Borne Diseases
summary: When Ketu aspects the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will suffer from dysentery and diseases caused by impure water.
full_text: Ketu's aspect on the said house (5th from Karakamsa) will cause dysentery and said-diseases caused by (impure) water. Ketu is associated with intestinal disorders, parasites, and hidden toxins. His aspect on the 5th from Karakamsa produces gastrointestinal disease — specifically dysentery (bloody diarrhoea) and waterborne illnesses arising from contaminated water sources.

condition.notes: Ketu aspects the 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Dysentery and waterborne diseases — gastrointestinal illness from impure water.

title: Rahu and Gulika in 5th From Karakamsa — Fear From Mean People and Poison
summary: When Rahu and Gulika are together in the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will experience fear from mean/low-class people and also danger from poison.
full_text: If Rahu and Gulika be in the (5th) house there will be fear from mean people and poison. Rahu (shadow/deceptive) and Gulika (son of Saturn, upagraha of poison and misfortune) together in the 5th from Karakamsa combine their malefic energies to produce fear of enemies from lower stations and exposure to poisonous threats — whether from toxic substances, venomous animals, or malicious low-born persons.

condition.notes: Rahu and Gulika together in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Fear from mean/low-class people and danger from poison.

title: Mercury in 5th From Karakamsa — Ascetic of Highest Order or Staff-Holding Ascetic
summary: When Mercury is in the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will be an ascetic of the highest spiritual order, or one who holds a staff (danda-dharin) as a symbol of renunciation.
full_text: Should Mercury be in the said house (5th from Karakamsa), the native will be an ascetic of the highest order or one holding staff. Mercury in the 5th from Karakamsa diverts intellectual capacity toward spiritual attainment — the native becomes a learned sannyasi, the most exalted type of renunciant, or at minimum a brahmacharin who carries the traditional staff of the ascetic life. This is a high spiritual destiny.

condition.notes: Mercury in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Ascetic of highest order or staff-bearing renunciant (danda-dharin/sannyasi).

title: Sun in 5th From Karakamsa — Uses a Knife (Weapons Profession)
summary: When the Sun is in the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will use a knife — indicating a profession or character involving bladed weapons.
full_text: The Sun in the said house (5th from Karakamsa) denotes one using a knife. The Sun as karaka of sharp metals, royalty, and authority in the 5th from Karakamsa produces a person associated with knives — whether as a soldier, a butcher, a surgeon, or a craftsman who works with cutting tools. The Sun's fiery nature and association with metallic implements is expressed through the knife as primary tool or weapon.

condition.notes: Sun in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Uses a knife — profession or character involving bladed weapons or cutting instruments.

title: Mars in 5th From Karakamsa — Uses a Spear or Arrow (Weapons Profession)
summary: When Mars is in the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will use a spear or arrow — indicating a warrior or military profession.
full_text: Mars in the said house (5th from Karakamsa) denotes one using a spear. Mars as the natural karaka of weapons, combat, and military life in the 5th from Karakamsa produces a person whose livelihood or character involves spears and arrows — a soldier, a hunter, or a martial-arts practitioner. Mars in the 5th from Karakamsa represents direct offensive weaponry.

condition.notes: Mars in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Uses a spear or arrow — warrior, soldier, or hunter profession.

title: Saturn in 5th From Karakamsa — Bowman (Archery Profession)
summary: When Saturn is in the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will be a bowman — one who uses a bow and arrow as a primary tool or weapon.
full_text: Saturn denotes a bowman in this context (5th from Karakamsa). Saturn's association with slow, calculated, long-distance effort in the 5th from Karakamsa points to archery — the weapon of patience, distance, and precision. Unlike Mars (spear — close quarters) or Sun (knife — direct), Saturn's archery represents the disciplined, methodical approach to combat or hunting.

condition.notes: Saturn in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Bowman — archery profession; uses bow and arrow.

title: Rahu in 5th From Karakamsa — Machinist or Mechanical Engineer
summary: When Rahu is in the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will be a machinist or mechanical engineer — one who works with heavy machinery.
full_text: Rahu in the said house (5th from Karakamsa) denotes a machinist. Rahu governs machines, electricity, unconventional technologies, and industrial processes. In the 5th from Karakamsa, Rahu channels its mechanical and technological associations into the native's vocation — producing an engineer, machinist, or operator of heavy industrial equipment.

condition.notes: Rahu in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Machinist or mechanical engineer — works with heavy machinery or industrial equipment.

title: Ketu in 5th From Karakamsa — Watch Maker or Craftsman of Precision Instruments
summary: When Ketu is in the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will be a watch maker or craftsman who makes precision timekeeping or mechanical instruments.
full_text: Ketu in the said house (5th from Karakamsa) denotes a watch maker. Ketu governs fine detail, mathematical precision, and mysterious/hidden mechanisms. In the 5th from Karakamsa, Ketu's energy is directed toward the crafting of delicate mechanical devices — especially timepieces and precision instruments. This connects to Ketu's classical association with calculations, astronomy, and hidden inner workings.

condition.notes: Ketu in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Watch maker or maker of precision instruments — craftsman of fine mechanical devices.

title: Venus in 5th From Karakamsa — Poet and Eloquent Speaker
summary: When Venus is in the 5th house from the Karakamsa, the native will be a poet and an eloquent speaker.
full_text: Venus in the said house (5th from Karakamsa) will make one a poet and an eloquent speaker. Venus governs beauty, art, eloquence, and aesthetic expression. In the 5th from Karakamsa — the house of creativity, intelligence, and expression — Venus produces a person gifted in poetic composition and oratory. The native's words carry beauty, rhythm, and persuasive power.

condition.notes: Venus in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Poet and eloquent speaker — gifted in verse composition and oratory.

title: Jupiter and Moon in Karakamsa or 5th Therefrom — Author (Highest Writing Ability)
summary: When Jupiter and the Moon are together in the Karakamsa or in the 5th house from it, the native will be a distinguished author with highest-order literary capability.
full_text: If Jupiter and the Moon are in Karakamsa or the 5th thereof, the native will be an author. Jupiter as karaka of knowledge, wisdom, and written learning combined with the Moon (mind, imagination, fluency) in either the Karakamsa or its 5th produces the highest grade of authorship — a prolific, learned writer whose works carry depth and inspiration. This is the apex of writing ability from the Karakamsa.

condition.notes: Jupiter and Moon together in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Prominent author — highest-grade literary and writing ability.

title: Venus in Karakamsa or 5th Therefrom — Ordinary Writer (Second Grade)
summary: When Venus is in the Karakamsa or in the 5th house from it, the native will be a writer of ordinary (second-grade) literary capability — less distinguished than the Jupiter-Moon combination.
full_text: Venus in the said place (Karakamsa or 5th therefrom) will make one an ordinary writer. Venus represents aesthetic writing — poetry, romantic literature, and artistic prose — but at a level below the Jupiter-Moon combination. The native writes, but his output lacks the profundity and universal acclaim of the highest-order author. This is described as a comparative descent from the Jupiter-Moon peak.

condition.notes: Venus in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Ordinary writer — literary output of second-grade ability; functional but not distinguished.

title: Mercury in Karakamsa or 5th Therefrom — Still Lesser Writing Ability (Third Grade)
summary: When Mercury is in the Karakamsa or the 5th house from it, the native will be a writer of still lesser — third-grade — literary capability, below both Jupiter-Moon and Venus.
full_text: Mercury will give still lesser effects (in writing) in this respect (in Karakamsa or 5th therefrom). Mercury governs technical writing, commerce, and functional communication but lacks the creative depth of Venus or the philosophical height of Jupiter-Moon. The native can write but at the most basic functional level — correspondence, records, or minor compositions rather than literature. Parsahara ranks the three: Jupiter-Moon > Venus > Mercury.

condition.notes: Mercury in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Writing ability of third grade — functional but minimal literary capacity.

title: Jupiter Alone in Karakamsa or 5th — Knower of Everything, Vedic Scholar, Not an Orator or Grammarian
summary: When Jupiter alone (without Moon) is in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it, the native will be a universal knower, writer, and Vedas/Vedanta scholar — but will NOT be an orator or grammarian.
full_text: Should Jupiter be alone in the said house (Karakamsa or 5th therefrom), one will be a knower of everything, be a writer, and be versed in Vedas and Vedanta philosophy, but not an oratorian or a grammarian. Jupiter alone — without Moon's emotional and imaginative supplement — produces pure philosophical and encyclopaedic learning. The native masters all subjects and writes extensively, but lacks the Moon's fluency for oratory or the Mercury-quality precision of grammatical expertise.

condition.notes: Jupiter alone (not with Moon) in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Knower of all subjects, writer, Vedas/Vedanta scholar — but NOT an orator or grammarian.

title: Mars in Karakamsa or 5th Therefrom — Logician (Justice or Reasoner)
summary: When Mars is in the Karakamsa or the 5th house from it, the native will be a logician — one skilled in argumentation, reasoning, and law.
full_text: Mars in this respect (Karakamsa or 5th therefrom) denotes a logician. Mars brings combative intellectual energy — the native argues, debates, and reasons with force. In classical Jyotish context, a logician also refers to one versed in Nyaya (the Hindu philosophy of logic and epistemology) or one who practises legal reasoning. Mars in the 5th from Karakamsa sharpens the intellect into a weapon of argument.

condition.notes: Mars in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Logician — skilled in argumentation, Nyaya philosophy, or legal reasoning.

title: Mercury in Karakamsa or 5th — Mimamsaka (Follower of Mimamsa Philosophy)
summary: When Mercury is in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it, the native will be a Mimamsaka — a follower of the Mimamsa system of Hindu philosophy (ritualistic exegesis and Vedic interpretation).
full_text: Mercury in this context (Karakamsa or 5th therefrom) denotes a Mimamsaka — follower of Mimamsa philosophy (one of the six chief systems of Hindu philosophy, emphasising Vedic rituals and their correct interpretation). Mercury's precision, analytical nature, and mastery of scriptural interpretation make him the perfect karaka for Mimamsa — a highly technical philosophical tradition requiring detailed textual analysis.

condition.notes: Mercury in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Mimamsaka — follower/practitioner of Mimamsa philosophy; skilled in Vedic ritual exegesis.

title: Saturn in Karakamsa or 5th — Dull-Witted in Assembly
summary: When Saturn is in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it, the native will be dull-witted or ineffective in public assemblies — unable to debate or present ideas forcefully.
full_text: Saturn in this context (Karakamsa or 5th therefrom) denotes one dull-witted in the assembly. Saturn's slow, heavy, and reserved energy in the 5th from Karakamsa suppresses the native's expressive and intellectual performance in public forums. While Saturn may grant persistence and depth, in assemblies and debates the native stumbles, speaks poorly, or fails to make an impact. This is a limitation of public intellectual expression.

condition.notes: Saturn in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Dull-witted in assembly — poor performance in public debates and intellectual gatherings.

title: Sun in Karakamsa or 5th — Musician
summary: When the Sun is in the Karakamsa or the 5th house from it, the native will be a musician.
full_text: The Sun in this context (Karakamsa or 5th therefrom) denotes a musician. The Sun governs sound (Nada Brahman), rhythm, and creative arts tied to the divine. In the 5th from Karakamsa, the Sun manifests its creative artistry through music — the native becomes skilled in musical performance, composition, or theory. The Sun's brightness and resonance find expression in the harmonic arts.

condition.notes: Sun in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Musician — skilled in musical performance, composition, or theory.

title: Moon in Karakamsa or 5th — Sankhya Philosopher, Rhetorician, and Singer
summary: When the Moon is in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it, the native will be a follower of Sankhya Philosophy, skilled in rhetorics, and a singer.
full_text: The Moon in this context (Karakamsa or 5th therefrom) denotes a follower of Sankhya Philosophy (of sage Kapila, enumerating 25 true principles with emphasis on final bliss), and versed in rhetorics and singing. The Moon's imaginative, emotional, and fluid nature in the 5th from Karakamsa produces a triple gift: philosophical contemplation in the Sankhya tradition (enumeration of consciousness and matter), the art of rhetoric (persuasive speaking), and singing (the musical expression of emotion).

condition.notes: Moon in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Sankhya philosopher, skilled rhetorician, and singer — triple gifts of philosophy, oratory, and vocal music.

title: Ketu or Rahu in Karakamsa or 5th — Astrologer
summary: When Ketu or Rahu is in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it, the native will be an astrologer.
full_text: Ketu or Rahu in this context (Karakamsa or 5th therefrom) denotes an astrologer. Rahu and Ketu — the shadow planets that govern eclipses, cycles, and hidden time — naturally make the native skilled in reading planetary cycles and predicting the future. Their presence in the Karakamsa or its 5th grants mastery of Jyotish (astrology) as a vocation or deep practice. Ketu in particular carries a mathematical quality aligned with astrological calculation.

condition.notes: Ketu OR Rahu in Karakamsa OR in 5th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Astrologer — practitioner or master of Jyotish (Vedic astrology).

title: Jupiter Related to the 5th from Karakamsa — All Learning Effects Effectively Manifest
summary: When Jupiter is related (by aspect or conjunction) to the 5th from Karakamsa (in addition to whichever planet is placed there), the specific learning effect already indicated will effectively and strongly come to pass.
full_text: Should Jupiter be related to the said positions (caused by others than him), the effected stated will effectively come to pass. Jupiter as the great benefic and karaka of all learning acts as a confirmer and amplifier. When Jupiter is related to the planet already placed in the Karakamsa or its 5th — whether by aspect or conjunction — he guarantees that the stated learning/career outcome will manifest fully. Without Jupiter, the effect may be partial; with him, it is assured.

condition.notes: Jupiter related (by aspect or conjunction) to whatever planet is in Karakamsa or 5th therefrom

result.effect: Learning/career effect of the 5th-from-Karakamsa planet is confirmed and fully manifest — Jupiter ensures the outcome.

title: 2nd From Karakamsa Also to Be Considered Similarly for Learning Effects
summary: Some authorities hold that the 2nd from the Karakamsa should also be examined in the same way as the 5th for learning and intellectual effects.
full_text: Some say that the 2nd from Karakamsa be also similarly considered (for learning effects as the 5th). This is a secondary doctrine noted by Parasara as an alternative or supplementary view. The 2nd from Karakamsa governs speech, accumulated knowledge, and Vak Siddhi — making it a natural companion to the 5th (intelligence/learning) for assessing the native's literary and intellectual path. This allows the rules of slokas 41-45 to be applied also to the 2nd from Karakamsa.

condition.notes: Alternative doctrine: 2nd from Karakamsa also applicable for learning effects

result.effect: 2nd from Karakamsa to be read for learning/career effects in the same manner as the 5th.

title: Malefic in 6th From Karakamsa — Agriculturist
summary: When a malefic planet is in the 6th house from the Karakamsa, the native will be an agriculturist — a farmer or someone engaged in agricultural work.
full_text: If the 6th from Karakamsa is occupied by a malefic, the native will be an agriculturist. The 6th house governs hard work, service, and land-related activities. A malefic in the 6th from Karakamsa gives the native the constitution and inclination to work the land — tilling fields, farming, and sustaining through agricultural labour. This is considered a respectable but physically demanding vocation.

condition.notes: Any malefic in 6th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Agriculturist — farmer or one engaged in agricultural work.

title: Benefic in 6th From Karakamsa — Indolent; 3rd From Karakamsa Similarly Considered
summary: When a benefic planet is in the 6th house from the Karakamsa, the native will be indolent and lazy. The text also specifies that the 3rd from Karakamsa should be similarly considered for this rule.
full_text: He will be indolent if a benefic is there (6th from Karakamsa). The 3rd from Karakamsa be also similarly considered. A benefic in the 6th from Karakamsa weakens the drive to work — the native avoids effort and becomes lazy or passive. Unlike malefics (which energise the 6th with working energy), benefics here soften the constitution into inertia. The same principle applies when examining the 3rd from Karakamsa for valour/timidity.

condition.notes: Any benefic in 6th from Karakamsa; 3rd from Karakamsa similarly considered

result.effect: Indolent — lazy, avoids effort; benefic in 6th from Karakamsa weakens working drive.

title: Moon and Jupiter in 7th From Karakamsa — Very Beautiful Wife
summary: When the Moon and Jupiter are together in the 7th house from the Karakamsa, the native will obtain a very beautiful wife.
full_text: If the Moon and Jupiter are in the 7th from Karakamsa, the native will beget a very beautiful wife. The 7th from Karakamsa describes the native's spouse as seen from the Karakamsa Lagna. Moon (beauty, charm, grace) and Jupiter (dignity, nobility, proportionate form) together in the 7th produce the most beautiful type of wife — physically attractive and endowed with Jupiter's benign character and the Moon's natural allure.

condition.notes: Moon and Jupiter together in 7th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Very beautiful wife — spouse is exceptionally attractive and gracious.

title: Venus in 7th From Karakamsa — Sensuous Wife
summary: When Venus is in the 7th house from the Karakamsa, the native's wife will be sensuous — deeply driven by physical pleasures and sensual enjoyment.
full_text: Venus in the said house (7th from Karakamsa) denotes a sensuous wife. Venus as karaka of sensuality, pleasure, and desire in the 7th from Karakamsa colours the spouse with Venus's strongest quality — a deeply sensual, pleasure-seeking nature. The wife will be attractive and passionate, but primarily oriented toward material and sensory enjoyment.

condition.notes: Venus in 7th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Sensuous wife — spouse is pleasure-seeking, sensually oriented, and passionate.

title: Mercury in 7th From Karakamsa — Wife Versed in Arts
summary: When Mercury is in the 7th house from the Karakamsa, the native's wife will be skilled and accomplished in the arts.
full_text: Mercury in the said house (7th from Karakamsa) indicates a wife versed in arts. Mercury governs arts, crafts, skill, learning, and fine intellectual abilities. In the 7th from Karakamsa, Mercury indicates a spouse who is accomplished in artistic disciplines — music, dance, painting, literature, or other refined creative skills. The wife brings intellectual and artistic refinement to the household.

condition.notes: Mercury in 7th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Wife versed in arts — spouse is accomplished in artistic and creative disciplines.

title: Sun in 7th From Karakamsa — Wife Confined to Domestic Care
summary: When the Sun is in the 7th house from the Karakamsa, the native's wife will be primarily focused on domestic duties and household management.
full_text: The Sun so related (7th from Karakamsa) will give a wife confining (herself to) domestic core. The Sun in the 7th from Karakamsa produces a wife oriented entirely toward domestic management — household duties, cooking, managing the home, and the domestic sphere. She does not venture into public roles; her domain is the household. This is the Sun's authoritative, self-contained quality expressed through the spouse's domestic confinement.

condition.notes: Sun in 7th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Wife confined to domestic care — spouse focused on household duties and domestic management.

title: Saturn in 7th From Karakamsa — Wife of Higher Age Bracket or Pious/Sick Wife
summary: When Saturn is in the 7th house from the Karakamsa, the native's wife will either be older than the native in age, or will be pious and religious, or will be sickly.
full_text: Saturn in this context (7th from Karakamsa) denotes a wife of a higher age bracket, or a pious/sick wife. Saturn as karaka of old age, discipline, and chronic conditions in the 7th from Karakamsa brings a spouse who is either chronologically older than the native (or seems older), or carries Saturn's religious-austerity quality (pious, ascetic), or is afflicted by chronic illness. All three are Saturnian expressions in the marital sphere.

condition.notes: Saturn in 7th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Wife of higher age bracket, or a pious/religious wife, or a chronically sick wife.

title: Rahu in 7th From Karakamsa — Marries a Widow
summary: When Rahu is in the 7th house from the Karakamsa, the native will marry a widow (a woman previously married whose husband has died).
full_text: Rahu in this context (7th from Karakamsa) will bring a widow in marriage. Rahu's association with the past, karma, and foreign/unconventional situations in the 7th from Karakamsa produces a marital union with a widow — a woman who has already been married and whose first husband has died. This may reflect a karmically complex marital relationship involving prior life entanglements.

condition.notes: Rahu in 7th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Marries a widow — spouse is a previously married woman whose husband has died.

title: Benefic or 8th Lord in 8th From Karakamsa — Long Life
summary: When a benefic planet or the lord of the 8th house (from Karakamsa) is placed in the 8th from the Karakamsa, the native will be long-lived.
full_text: If a benefic or the planet owning the 8th from Karakamsa be in the 8th from Karakamsa, the native will be long-lived. The 8th from Karakamsa governs longevity as seen from the Karakamsa Lagna. A benefic or the 8th lord in its own house creates a supportive environment for longevity — the house of lifespan is occupied by a friendly or empowered influence, extending the native's years.

condition.notes: Benefic planet OR lord of 8th from Karakamsa is in the 8th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Long-lived — full or extended lifespan.

title: Malefic in 8th From Karakamsa — Reduced Life Span
summary: When a malefic planet is in the 8th house from the Karakamsa, the native's life span will be reduced.
full_text: A malefic so placed (in 8th from Karakamsa) will reduce the life span. A malefic's occupation of the 8th from Karakamsa — the house governing lifespan from the Karakamsa Lagna — directly damages the longevity indicators, cutting the native's life short. The severity depends on the specific malefic, its strength, and whether benefic aspects mitigate.

condition.notes: Any malefic in 8th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Reduced life span — shortened longevity.

title: Both Benefics and Malefics in 8th From Karakamsa — Medium Life Span
summary: When both benefic and malefic planets are together in the 8th house from the Karakamsa (aspect or conjunction of both), the native will have a medium span of life.
full_text: Aspect/conjunction of both benefics and malefics (in the 8th from Karakamsa) will yield a medium span of life. The conflicting influences of benefics (extending life) and malefics (cutting it short) cancel each other out at the 8th from Karakamsa, producing a moderate, average lifespan — neither long-lived (rule 092) nor short-lived (rule 093). The native lives a middle span of years.

condition.notes: Both benefics and malefics in 8th from Karakamsa (by aspect or conjunction)

result.effect: Medium span of life — average lifespan, neither long nor short.

title: Benefic Aspecting or Occupying 9th From Karakamsa — Truthful, Devoted to Elders, and Attached to Own Religion
summary: When a benefic aspects or occupies the 9th house from the Karakamsa, the native will be truthful, devoted to his elders, and deeply attached to his own religion.
full_text: If the 9th from Karakamsa is aspected or occupied by a benefic, the native will be truthful, devoted to elders and attached to his own religion. The 9th from Karakamsa represents dharma, father, and religious conviction as seen from the Karakamsa Lagna. A benefic here strengthens these qualities: the native speaks truth, respects his teachers and elders, and adheres firmly to the faith and traditions of his birth.

condition.notes: Benefic aspecting or occupying 9th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Truthful, devoted to elders, and steadfastly attached to own religion throughout life.

title: Malefic Aspecting or Occupying 9th From Karakamsa — Religious in Youth, Turns to Falsehood in Old Age
summary: When a malefic aspects or occupies the 9th from the Karakamsa, the native will be attached to religion in boyhood but will take to falsehood and deception in old age.
full_text: If a malefic is so related as above (9th from Karakamsa), one will be attached to his religion in boyhood but will take to falsehood in old age. A malefic's influence on the 9th from Karakamsa produces a spiritually split life: genuine piety and religious attachment in youth and childhood, followed by moral deterioration — dishonesty, deception, and abandonment of dharmic principles — as old age sets in. The malefic's corroding effect is delayed but inevitable.

condition.notes: Malefic aspecting or occupying 9th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Religious and pious in boyhood; falls into falsehood and deception in old age.

title: Saturn and Rahu Related to 9th From Karakamsa — Betrays Elders and Averse to Ancient Learning
summary: When both Saturn and Rahu are related to (aspect or occupy) the 9th from the Karakamsa, the native will betray his elders and be averse to traditional/ancient learning.
full_text: If Saturn and Rahu are so related as above (9th from Karakamsa), one will betray his elders and be averse to ancient learning. Saturn (restriction, defiance of authority) and Rahu (rebellion, foreign influences, disruption) together afflicting the 9th from Karakamsa produce a native who rejects traditional wisdom and elder authority — betraying mentors and teachers, and showing contempt for classical or ancient knowledge.

condition.notes: Saturn and Rahu both related (aspect or conjunction) to 9th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Betrays elders and teachers; averse to ancient, traditional, or classical learning.

title: Jupiter and Sun Related to 9th From Karakamsa — Betrays and Disobeys Elders
summary: When both Jupiter and the Sun are related to (aspect or occupy) the 9th from the Karakamsa, the native will betray his elders and be disobedient to them.
full_text: If Jupiter and the Sun are so related as above (9th from Karakamsa), one will betray his elders and will be disobedient to them. Jupiter (expansion) and the Sun (ego, authority) together in the 9th from Karakamsa create an inflated sense of personal authority — the native believes himself superior to his teachers and elders, leading to disobedience and betrayal of those who guided him. This is a counter-intuitive result where two individually positive planets create negative character traits through their combined influence.

condition.notes: Jupiter and Sun both related (aspect or conjunction) to 9th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Betrays and disobeys elders and teachers — inflated ego overrides deference to authority.

title: Mars and Venus Related to 9th From Karakamsa in Six Identical Vargas — Female Relative Dies
summary: When Mars and Venus are related to the 9th from the Karakamsa AND are in six identical Navamsa vargas (Shadbala), a female ill-related (adversely related) to the native will die.
full_text: Should Mars and Venus be so related as above (9th from Karakamsa), and joining in six identical vargas, a female ill-related to the native will die. The specific condition of six identical vargas (Shadvargas — all six divisional charts showing the same sign for both Mars and Venus) creates an extreme configuration. When this coincides with their relation to the 9th from Karakamsa, it signals the death of a female who is adversarially connected to the native — a hostile female relative.

condition.notes: Mars and Venus related to 9th from Karakamsa AND in six identical Shadvargas

result.effect: Death of a female adversarially related to the native (hostile female relative).

title: Mercury and Moon Related to 9th From Karakamsa — Imprisonment Due to Association With Another's Wife
summary: When Mercury and the Moon are related to the 9th from the Karakamsa, the native will be imprisoned due to his association with a woman who is not his own wife.
full_text: Mercury and the Moon so related (9th from Karakamsa) will cause imprisonment of the native due to association with a female not of his own. Mercury (intellect, communication, social connections) and the Moon (emotional drives, women) together related to the 9th from Karakamsa produces a scenario where the native's pursuit of an illicit female relationship results in legal entanglement — specifically imprisonment. The dharmic 9th house afflicted by this combination brings karmic legal consequences.

condition.notes: Mercury and Moon both related (aspect or conjunction) to 9th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Imprisonment due to illicit association with another man's wife or an unrelated woman.

title: Jupiter Alone Related to 9th From Karakamsa — Addicted to Females and Sensual Enjoyments
summary: When Jupiter alone is related to the 9th house from the Karakamsa (by aspect or conjunction, without other co-planets), the native will be addicted to women and devoted to sensual pleasures.
full_text: If Jupiter is alone related to the 9th from Karakamsa by aspect or by conjunction, the native will be addicted to females and be devoted to sensual enjoyments. Jupiter alone in the 9th from Karakamsa (without Saturn, Rahu, Sun etc.) expands the 9th house's emotional and indulgent dimension — the native's dharmic 9th from Karakamsa becomes a seat of sensual desire rather than spiritual discipline. Jupiter's expansive quality here amplifies desire for women and pleasure.

condition.notes: Jupiter alone related (aspect or conjunction) to 9th from Karakamsa — no co-malefic

result.effect: Addicted to females and devoted to sensual enjoyments — persistent sensual indulgence.

title: Benefic Aspecting or Occupying 10th From Karakamsa — Firm Riches, Sagacious, Strong, and Intelligent
summary: When a benefic aspects or occupies the 10th house from the Karakamsa, the native will have firm (steady) riches, be sagacious, strong, and intelligent.
full_text: If the 10th from Karakamsa be aspected or conjoined by a benefic, the native will have firm riches, be sagacious, strong and intelligent. The 10th from Karakamsa represents career, authority, and public life. A benefic here stabilises the native's financial base (firm riches — not easily lost), sharpens wisdom (sagacious), strengthens constitution, and brightens intellect. This is the ideal 10th-from-Karakamsa configuration.

condition.notes: Benefic aspecting or occupying 10th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Firm, stable riches; sagacious wisdom; physical strength; sharp intelligence.

title: Malefic Aspecting or Occupying 10th From Karakamsa — Harm to Profession and Loss of Paternal Bliss
summary: When a malefic aspects or occupies the 10th from the Karakamsa, the native will experience harm to his profession and will be deprived of paternal bliss.
full_text: A malefic so related (10th from Karakamsa) will cause harm to his profession and deprive him of paternal bliss. A malefic in the 10th from Karakamsa attacks the native's vocational life — career setbacks, professional failures, or loss of livelihood — and simultaneously damages the relationship with or blessings from the father. Both professional and paternal dimensions of the 10th are adversely affected.

condition.notes: Malefic aspecting or occupying 10th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Harm to profession; deprived of paternal blessings and happiness from father.

title: Mercury and Venus Related to 10th From Karakamsa — Many Gains in Business and Great Deeds
summary: When Mercury and Venus are related to (aspect or occupy) the 10th from the Karakamsa, the native will gain many profits in business/profession and will accomplish great deeds.
full_text: Mercury and Venus so related (10th from Karakamsa) will confer many gains in business (or profession) and will make him do many great deeds. Mercury (commerce, transactions, communication) and Venus (luxury, artistic enterprise, wealth) together in the 10th from Karakamsa create a highly successful commercial and professional environment. The native profits extensively from trading or professional activities and performs distinguished deeds that earn wide recognition.

condition.notes: Mercury and Venus both related (aspect or conjunction) to 10th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Many gains in business/profession; accomplishes great and distinguished deeds.

title: Sun and Moon (Luminaries) in 10th From Karakamsa With Jupiter Aspect — Acquires Kingdom
summary: When the Sun and Moon (the luminaries) are related to the 10th from the Karakamsa AND are in aspect to or conjunct Jupiter, the native will acquire a kingdom (royal power, high governance).
full_text: The luminaries so related to the 10th from Karakamsa and if be in aspect to or conjunction with Jupiter, the native will acquire a kingdom. The Sun (royalty, sovereignty) and Moon (mind, public favour) together in the 10th from Karakamsa represent the maximum kingly potential from this Lagna. When Jupiter — the granting planet and teacher of the gods — aspects or joins this configuration, the native's royal potential is actualised into real governance and kingdom-level authority.

condition.notes: Sun and Moon in 10th from Karakamsa with Jupiter aspect/conjunction

result.effect: Acquires a kingdom — royal authority, high governance, or equivalent peak power in society.

title: Benefic Aspecting or Occupying 11th From Karakamsa — Happiness From Co-Borns and Gains in Every Undertaking
summary: When a benefic aspects or occupies the 11th house from the Karakamsa, the native will enjoy happiness from co-born (siblings) and will gain in every undertaking he pursues.
full_text: If the 11th from Karakamsa be aspected by or conjunct a benefic, the native will enjoy happiness from co-born apart from gaining in every undertaking of his. The 11th from Karakamsa governs fulfilment of desires, income, and elder siblings. A benefic here blesses all three: harmonious sibling relationships, financial gains from all endeavours, and the fulfilment of aspirations.

condition.notes: Benefic aspecting or occupying 11th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Happiness from siblings; gains in every undertaking — all endeavours succeed financially.

title: Malefic in 11th From Karakamsa — Gains by Questionable Means, Famous, and Valorous
summary: When a malefic planet is in the 11th house from the Karakamsa, the native will gain wealth by questionable or unconventional means, will be famous, and will be valorous.
full_text: If a malefic is in the said 11th (from Karakamsa) the native will gain by questionable means, be famous and valorous. A malefic in the 11th from Karakamsa activates the upachaya energy of the 11th but through dubious channels — income comes through morally questionable or legally grey methods. However, this comes with fame (the malefic's sharp, visible energy making the native conspicuous) and valour (fighting spirit in the 11th). Gains are assured but the methods are ethically ambiguous.

condition.notes: Any malefic in 11th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Gains by questionable/dubious means; achieves fame and is valorous.

title: 12th From Karakamsa — Benefic Gives Good Expenses, Malefic Gives Bad Expenses, Vacant Gives Good
summary: The 12th from Karakamsa governs expenditure: a benefic there produces good (meritorious) expenses; a malefic produces bad (wasteful/harmful) expenses; if vacant, good effects in expenses still follow.
full_text: If the 12th from Karakamsa has a benefic, the expenses will be on good account while a malefic will cause bad expenses. If the said 12th be vacant then also good effects (in respect of expenses) will follow. The 12th from Karakamsa governs the native's expenditure and the nature of his outflows. Benefic = money spent on dharmic, charitable, or meritorious purposes. Malefic = money wasted, spent on vices, or lost. Vacant = the 12th house is unoccupied but still yields positive expenditure patterns.

condition.notes: 12th from Karakamsa: benefic = good expenses; malefic = bad; vacant = good

result.effect: Benefic: meritorious expenditures. Malefic: wasteful or harmful expenditures. Vacant: good expenditure patterns.

title: Benefic in Exaltation or Own House in 12th From Karakamsa — Attains Heaven After Death
summary: When a benefic planet is in exaltation or in its own sign in the 12th house from the Karakamsa, the native will attain heavens (svarga) after death.
full_text: If there be a benefic planet in exaltation or in own house in the 12th from Karakamsa, one will attain heavens after death. The 12th from Karakamsa governs the native's final liberation or post-death state. A benefic in maximum strength (exaltation or own sign) in the 12th from Karakamsa projects the native's soul into heavenly realms (svarga loka) after physical death. This is a meritorious afterlife outcome.

condition.notes: Benefic in exaltation OR own sign in 12th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Attains heavens (svarga loka) after death — meritorious post-death state.

title: Ketu in 12th From Karakamsa With Benefic Aspect or Conjunction — Attains Heaven After Death
summary: When Ketu is in the 12th house from the Karakamsa and is aspected by or conjunct a benefic, the native will attain heavens after death.
full_text: If Ketu is so placed (12th from Karakamsa) and aspected by or conjunct a benefic, one will attain heavens after death. Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa represents a moksha-oriented placement (Ketu is karaka for final liberation, the 12th governs the afterlife). When a benefic's supportive energy qualifies Ketu here, the native's spiritual path leads to heavenly attainment post-death. The benefic tempers Ketu's harsh austerity into a meritorious outcome.

condition.notes: Ketu in 12th from Karakamsa with benefic aspect or conjunction

result.effect: Attains heavens after death — beneficial post-death state with Ketu aspected by benefic.

title: Ketu in 12th From Karakamsa in Aries or Sagittarius With Benefic Aspect — Final Emancipation (Moksha)
summary: When Ketu is in the 12th from Karakamsa, placed specifically in Aries or Sagittarius, and aspected by a benefic, the native will attain final emancipation (moksha) — liberation from the cycle of rebirth.
full_text: One will attain final emancipation if Ketu is in the 12th (from Karakamsa) identical with Aries/Sagittarius and is aspected by a benefic. This is the highest possible spiritual attainment from the Karakamsa — not merely heaven (svarga), but moksha (final liberation). Ketu in Aries (the trailblazing fire sign associated with initiation) or Sagittarius (the sign of dharma, higher philosophy, and liberation) in the 12th from Karakamsa, qualified by a benefic's grace, produces complete liberation from the cycle of birth and death.

condition.notes: Ketu in 12th from Karakamsa in Aries or Sagittarius with benefic aspect

result.effect: Final emancipation (moksha) — liberation from the cycle of rebirth; highest spiritual attainment.

title: Ketu in 12th From Karakamsa With Malefic Aspect — No Final Emancipation
summary: When Ketu is in the 12th from the Karakamsa and is aspected by or conjunct a malefic, the native will NOT attain final emancipation — moksha is denied.
full_text: If Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa and be with aspect/conjunction of a malefic one will not attain final emancipation. A malefic's influence on Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa corrupts the liberation pathway — Ketu's moksha potential is blocked by the malefic's binding, material, or destructive energy. The native remains in the cycle of rebirth. This is the direct negation of the benefic-aspect scenario (rules 110-111).

condition.notes: Ketu in 12th from Karakamsa with malefic aspect or conjunction

result.effect: Final emancipation denied — malefic aspect blocks moksha; native remains in cycle of rebirth.

title: Sun and Ketu in 12th From Karakamsa — Worships Lord Shiva

full_text: If the Sun and Ketu are in the said 12th (from Karakamsa) the native will worship Lord Siva. The Sun (fiery, self-luminous, destruction of ignorance) combined with Ketu (transcendence, moksha-seeking, association with Shiva) in the 12th from Karakamsa points to the native's chosen deity being Lord Shiva — the destroyer, the ascetic, and the lord of moksha. This is a Shaiva spiritual orientation.

condition.notes: Sun and Ketu together in 12th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Devotee of Lord Shiva — Shaiva spiritual orientation and worship.

title: Moon and Ketu in 12th From Karakamsa — Worships Gauri (Consort of Shiva)

full_text: The Moon and Ketu in the said 12th (from Karakamsa) denotes a worshipper of Gauri (a consort of Lord Siva). The Moon (feminine, nourishing, mind-oriented) combined with Ketu (transcendence, Shiva-association) in the 12th from Karakamsa produces devotion to Gauri — the goddess of grace, purity, and marital bliss, and the divine feminine consort of Shiva. This is a Shakta-Shaiva orientation focused on the divine mother aspect.

condition.notes: Moon and Ketu together in 12th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Devotee of Gauri (divine mother, consort of Shiva) — Shakta-Shaiva spiritual orientation.

title: Venus and Ketu in 12th From Karakamsa — Worships Lakshmi and Becomes Wealthy

full_text: Venus and Ketu in the said 12th (from Karakamsa) denotes a worshipper of Lakshmi (a consort of Lord Vishnu) and a wealthy person. Venus (luxury, beauty, wealth, Lakshmi energy) combined with Ketu (spiritual orientation) in the 12th from Karakamsa produces devotion to Goddess Lakshmi — the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and auspiciousness, consort of Vishnu. title: Mars and Ketu in 12th From Karakamsa — Worships Lord Subramanya (Kartikeya)
summary: When Mars and Ketu are together in the 12th house from the Karakamsa, the native will worship Lord Subramanya (Kartikeya/Murugan) — the warrior god, offspring of Lord Shiva.
full_text: Mars and Ketu in the said 12th (from Karakamsa) denotes a worshipper of Lord Subramanya (an offspring of Lord Siva). Mars (courage, war, fire) combined with Ketu (Shiva's energy, transcendence) in the 12th from Karakamsa points to devotion to Lord Subramanya/Kartikeya — the divine general of the gods, son of Shiva, commander of the celestial army. This is a martial-spiritual orientation.

condition.notes: Mars and Ketu together in 12th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Devotee of Lord Subramanya (Kartikeya/Murugan) — martial-spiritual orientation.

title: Rahu in 12th From Karakamsa — Worships Durga or Mean Deity
summary: When Rahu is in the 12th house from the Karakamsa, the native will worship Durga or a mean/low deity.
full_text: Rahu in the 12th from Karakamsa will make one worship Durga or some mean deity. Rahu's shadowy, foreign, and non-conformist energy in the 12th from Karakamsa produces worship of either Durga (the fierce warrior goddess, destroyer of evil) or — in a more negative expression — worship of a lesser, mean deity (a local or inferior spiritual entity). The ambivalence reflects Rahu's dual nature as both powerfully protective (Durga) and chaotically misguided (mean deity).

summary: When Ketu is alone (without other planets) in the 12th house from the Karakamsa, the native will worship Lord Subramanya (Kartikeya) or Lord Ganesha.
full_text: Ketu alone in the said 12th (from Karakamsa) denotes Subramanya's or Ganesa's worshipper. Ketu alone — without the influence of any other planet — in the 12th from Karakamsa points to worship of either Lord Subramanya or Lord Ganesha. Both are sons of Shiva, and Ketu's placement in the 12th house of moksha alone (without additional planetary colour) produces a Shaiva-family devotional orientation focused on Shiva's divine offspring.

condition.notes: Ketu alone (no other planets) in 12th from Karakamsa

result.effect: Devotee of Lord Subramanya or Lord Ganesha — Shaiva-family spiritual orientation.

title: Saturn in 12th From Karakamsa in Malefic Sign — Worships Mean Deities
summary: When Saturn is in the 12th house from the Karakamsa placed in a malefic's sign, the native will worship mean or inferior deities.
full_text: If Saturn is in the said 12th (from Karakamsa) in a malefic's sign one will worship mean deities. Saturn in a malefic's sign (Saturn, Mars, or Rahu/Ketu ruled) in the 12th from Karakamsa produces a degraded spiritual orientation — the native worships lower-order deities, local spirits, or entities of questionable spiritual merit rather than the principal Vedic deities. summary: When two malefic planets are placed in a trine (5th or 9th) from the Karakamsa, the native will possess knowledge of Mantras (sacred spells) and Tantras (mystical formularies for deity worship).
full_text: O Brahmin, if there are two malefics in a trine from Karakamsa, the native will have knowledge of Mantras (sacred spells) and Tantras (mystical formularies for the worship of deities for attainment of super-human powers). Two malefics in a trine from Karakamsa creates a concentrated, intense spiritual-occult configuration. The trines (5th and 9th) from Karakamsa govern spiritual knowledge and practice. Two malefics here — rather than producing harm — produce power through esoteric knowledge: Mantra (sacred syllables) and Tantra (systematic mystical practice for deity propitiation).

result.effect: Knowledge of Mantras (sacred spells) and Tantras (mystical ritual formularies for deity attainment and super-human powers).

full_text: If a malefic simultaneously aspects the said yoga (two malefics in trine from Karakamsa), the native will use these learnings for malevolent purposes. The additional malefic aspect on the two-malefic trine corrupts the powerful Mantra/Tantra knowledge into destructive use — the native employs esoteric powers for harm, cursing, black magic, or other malevolent ends rather than for spiritual advancement or public good.

full_text: A benefic's aspect will make him use the same (Mantra/Tantra knowledge) for public good. A benefic's aspect on the two-malefic trine from Karakamsa purifies the powerful Mantra/Tantra energy — the native employs his esoteric learning for healing, protection, spiritual guidance, and the welfare of society rather than for personal gain or harm. This is the ideal expression of the two-malefic trine's spiritual power.

result.effect: Mantra/Tantra knowledge used for public good — healing, protection, and benevolent spiritual service.

The Moon (mind, fluidity, transformation) in the Karakamsa, aspected by Venus (the planet of chemistry, beauty, and material refinement in Jyotish), produces a practitioner of alchemy — the ancient science of transmuting base metals into gold, or creating Rasayana (rejuvenating elixirs). In classical India, alchemy (Rasa Vidya) was a respected science combining metallurgy and medicine.
