title: 5th-From-Karakamsa Effects Also Apply to 2nd, 3rd, and Karakamsa Itself
summary: All the learning and career effects described for the 5th from Karakamsa (rules 065-082, 141-142) apply equally when the same planets are placed in the 2nd from Karakamsa, 3rd from Karakamsa, or in the Karakamsa itself.
full_text: All these as well apply to the 2nd/3rd from Karakamsa and to the Karakamsa itself apart from applying to the 5th from Karakamsa. This is a comprehensive scope extension: every rule about planets in the 5th from Karakamsa for learning and career (Mars=logician, Mercury=Mimamsaka, Saturn=dull-witted, Sun=musician, Moon=Sankhya yogi, Venus=poet, Jupiter=all-knowing, Ketu=mathematician/astrologer etc.) is also applicable when the same planets are in the Karakamsa, the 2nd from Karakamsa, or the 3rd from Karakamsa.

condition.notes: Scope extension: 5th-from-Karakamsa learning rules apply to Karakamsa itself, 2nd, and 3rd from Karakamsa as well

result.effect: 5th-from-Karakamsa career/learning rules also apply when planets are in the Karakamsa, 2nd, or 3rd from Karakamsa.

title: Ketu in 2nd or 3rd From Karakamsa — Defective in Speech
summary: When Ketu is in the 2nd or 3rd house from the Karakamsa, the native will be defective in speech — having a speech impediment, stutter, or inability to express clearly.
full_text: Should Ketu be in the 2nd/3rd from Karakamsa, the native will be defective in speech. The 2nd house governs speech (Vak Bhava) and the 3rd governs communication and throat. Ketu's shadowy, dissolving energy in either of these positions from the Karakamsa Lagna introduces defects into the native's speech — stuttering, muteness, unclear articulation, or a physical speech impairment.

condition.notes: Ketu in 2nd OR 3rd from Karakamsa

result.effect: Defective in speech — speech impediment, stutter, or unclear articulation.

title: Malefic Aspects Ketu in 2nd/3rd From Karakamsa — Speech Defect Made More Severe
summary: When Ketu is in the 2nd or 3rd from Karakamsa (causing speech defect) and a malefic additionally aspects Ketu, the speech defect is made more severe.
full_text: More so if a malefic aspects Ketu as above (Ketu in 2nd/3rd from Karakamsa). A malefic's aspect on Ketu in the 2nd/3rd from Karakamsa intensifies the speech defect beyond the baseline level. The native's speech impediment or communication difficulty is compounded — potentially to the point of near-muteness or severe dysfunction.

condition.notes: Ketu in 2nd or 3rd from Karakamsa with a malefic additionally aspecting — speech defect more severe

result.effect: Speech defect made more severe — compounded by malefic aspect on Ketu.

title: Kemadruma Yoga — Malefics in Karakamsa, Arudha Lagna, and Their 2nd and 8th
summary: When malefics are placed in the Karakamsa, the Arudha Lagna, and in the 2nd and 8th from each of these — Kemadruma Yoga is formed, causing severe adverse effects.
full_text: If malefics be in the Karakamsa, Arudha Lagna and the 2nd and 8th from these places, there will be Kemadruma yoga. This is a specific form of Kemadruma Yoga (a malefic formation causing destitution or severe misfortune) defined in terms of the Karakamsa and Arudha Lagna. The simultaneous affliction of the Karakamsa (soul indicator), the Arudha Lagna (social/material manifestation), and the 2nd and 8th from both (wealth and longevity axes) by malefics creates a comprehensive malefic formation. Effects will be especially severe if the Moon also aspects this configuration (see rule 147).

condition.notes: Malefics in Karakamsa, Arudha Lagna, and 2nd and 8th from both

result.effect: Kemadruma Yoga — severe adverse effects on all life dimensions; effects manifest in Dasa periods of the Rasis or planets concerned.

title: Kemadruma Yoga With Moon Aspect — Effects Made Still More Severe
summary: When the Kemadruma Yoga (rule 146) is aspected by the Moon, the adverse effects of the yoga are made still more severe.
full_text: The effects due for these yogas will be still severer if the Moon's aspect be there. The Moon's aspect on the Kemadruma formation amplifies the misfortune — the Moon's emotional sensitivity and mind-body connection intensifies the suffering indicated by the malefic configuration. This serves as a confirming and magnifying influence.

condition.notes: Kemadruma Yoga (rule 146) additionally aspected by Moon — effects more severe

result.effect: Kemadruma Yoga effects made still more severe by Moon's aspect.

title: Kemadruma Yoga Activates Additionally When Current Dasa Rasi Has Malefics in 2nd and 8th
summary: Kemadruma Yoga also operates when the Rasi whose Dasa is currently running has malefics in its 2nd and 8th houses — an additional trigger beyond the natal configuration of rule 146.
full_text: Kimadruma Yoga will operate additionally if there are malefics in the 2nd and 8th from the Rasi whose Dasa will be in currency. The results of such yoga will also be inauspicious. This is a Dasa-period triggered variant of Kemadruma: even if the natal chart does not have the full Kemadruma formation (rule 146), if the Rasi currently running its Dasa has malefics in its 2nd and 8th, Kemadruma activates for that period. The inauspiciousness of Kemadruma manifests during that Dasa.

condition.notes: Malefics in 2nd and 8th from the Rasi whose Dasa is running — Kemadruma activates for that Dasa period

result.effect: Kemadruma Yoga activates during the Dasa of a Rasi that has malefics in its 2nd and 8th — inauspicious results throughout that Dasa period.

title: Kemadruma Yoga Operates Throughout Dasa When 2nd and 8th of the Dasa-Start Chart Have Malefics
summary: If the 2nd and 8th houses in the chart cast for the beginning of a particular Dasa contain malefics, Kemadruma Yoga prevails throughout the entire Dasa period — a Dasa-chart diagnostic.
full_text: If the 2nd and 8th in the chart cast for the beginning of a Dasa have malefics, then also Kemadruma prevails throughout the Dasa. This is a Dasa-inauguration chart (Dasa Pravesh or Dasa Kundali) diagnostic: when a Dasa begins, a chart is cast for that moment, and if that chart shows malefics in the 2nd and 8th, Kemadruma Yoga operates for the full duration of the Dasa — affecting the native's financial stability and lifespan throughout the period.

condition.notes: Chart cast for Dasa beginning has malefics in 2nd and 8th — Kemadruma throughout that Dasa

result.effect: Kemadruma Yoga prevails throughout the entire Dasa — determined from the Dasa-start chart.

title: Chapter 33 Closing Statement — Karakamsa Effects Summarised
summary: The concluding verse of Chapter 33 indicates that all the effects of Karakamsa have now been told briefly by Parasara, signalling the end of the Karakamsa section.
full_text: Thus, O Brahmin, are told briefly the effects of Karakamsa. This closing sloka is a textual marker indicating that Ch33 is complete and the topic of Karakamsa effects has been exhaustively covered. It contextualises the preceding rules as a summary (brief) treatment — implying that a fuller expansion might be available in the traditional oral/guru transmission. For KE purposes this serves as the chapter-close anchor rule.

condition.notes: Chapter 33 closing statement — textual end marker

result.effect: Chapter 33 (Effects of Karakamsa) is complete — all Karakamsa effects told briefly.
